## nomad_total_war_displace_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomad_total_war_displace_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

外星生命理应继续存在，但我们附近的星球确实应当被腾空。\n\n§E自动生成临时的附属国以负责将当地人口迁走，完成任务后他们将自动解散§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:24`

### English

Alien life deserves to keep existing, but the planets near us really should be vacated.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Temporary Subjects who will Displace Pops, once finished they will disband§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:29`

## nomad_total_war_purge_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomad_total_war_purge_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

困于行星的生命是如此残缺，让我们将其从星系中彻底抹除。\n\n§E自动生成临时的附属国以负责将当地人口净化，完成后他们将自行解散并移交积累的资源§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:27`

### English

Planetbound life is so flawed, let us exterminate it from the galaxy.\n\n§EAutomatically generate Temporary Subjects who will Purge Pops, once finished they will disband and transfer over accumulated resources§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:32`

## nomadic_gameplay_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomadic_gameplay_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§R游牧机制将替代多种游戏机制§!$DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$—无法['concept_claim']或拥有£system£ §H恒星系§!与£planet£ §H行星§! $NEW_LINE$—['concept_colonies']由£arkship£ ['concept_arkships']搭载，后者同时也起到了['concept_shipyards']的作用 $NEW_LINE$—£construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ships']替代了£construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ships'] $NEW_LINE$—£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']替代了£mining_station£ ['concept_mining_stations']与£science_ship£ ['concept_research_stations'] $NEW_LINE$—['concept_operational_reserves']替代了§H$energy_with_icon$§!与§H$minerals_with_icon$§! $NEW_LINE$—可以为£planet£ ['concept_settled_empires']执行£contract£ ['concept_contracts'] $NEW_LINE$—可以发掘无主的£archaeology£ ['concept_archaeology_site',考古遗址] $NEW_LINE$—无视§H关闭边界§!，但擅闯行径会导致外交惩罚 $NEW_LINE$—可以使用$arkship_cap_plural$、$nomads_constructor_plural$与$waystation_plural$开采§H$w_strategic_plural$§!\n\n修正：\n—§H方舟舰§!产生的['concept_empire_size']：§G+100%§!\n—§H区划§!产生的['concept_empire_size']：§G+100%§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:58`

### English

§RNomadic gameplay replaces multiple gameplay mechanics§!$DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$- Cannot ['concept_claim'] or own £system£ §HSystems§! and £planet£ §HPlanets§! $NEW_LINE$- ['concept_colonies'] are carried by £arkship£ ['concept_arkships'], which also replace ['concept_shipyards'] $NEW_LINE$- £construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ships'] replace £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ships'] $NEW_LINE$- £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] replace £mining_station£ ['concept_mining_stations'] and £science_ship£ ['concept_research_stations'] $NEW_LINE$- ['concept_operational_reserves'] replace §H$energy_with_icon$§! and §H$minerals_with_icon$§! $NEW_LINE$- £contract£ ['concept_contracts'] may be carried out for £planet£ ['concept_settled_empires'] $NEW_LINE$- Unowned £archaeology£ ['concept_archaeology_site',Archaeological Sites] may be excavated $NEW_LINE$- Ignores §HClosed Borders§!, which incurs Diplomatic Penalties $NEW_LINE$- §H$w_strategic_plural$§! may be extracted with $arkship_cap_plural$, $nomads_constructor_plural$, and $waystation_plural$\n\nModifiers:\n- ['concept_empire_size'] from §HArkships§!: §G+100%§!\n- ['concept_empire_size'] from §HDistricts§!: §G+100%§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:70`

## origin_default_nomads_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_default_nomads_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:62`

### English

For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:75`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_DEMOCRACTIC_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_DEMOCRACTIC_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的先辈在启航[Capital.GetName]时，曾在其宪章中写下了一个问题：由谁来做决定？在派系林立、愿景交锋、旧有忠诚与新兴野心交织之际，他们给出的答案至今仍在每一个选举周期中回荡：由我们决定。我们所有人。\n\n[Root.GetGovernmentName]并非仅仅诞生于理想主义，而是源于一种来之不易的共识：没有任何单一的声音能够代表在这艘飞船上同生共死的每一个人。权力必须依靠争取，必须接受问责，并最终归还给赋予它权力的人民。\n\n今天，随着[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]通过民众的授权成为我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这份契约依然长存。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:64`

### English

Our forebears launched the [Capital.GetName] with a question written into her very charter: who decides? Amid the factions, the competing visions, the old loyalties and new ambitions, the answer they gave still echoes in every election cycle: we do. All of us.\n\nThe [Root.GetGovernmentName] was not born from idealism alone, but from a hard-won understanding that no single voice could speak for everyone who would live and die aboard this ship. Authority must be earned, held accountable, and returned to the people who grant it.\n\nToday, as [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] is our [Root.GetRulerTitle] by popular mandate, that compact endures.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:78`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_OLIGARCHIC_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_OLIGARCHIC_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

当[Root.GetGovernmentName]成立时，问题不在于由谁来领导——从来不缺候选人——而在于如何确保那些掌权者值得众人的追随。\n\n答案是建立一个议会：其成员并非那些声音最响亮的人，而是那些凭自身实力赢得席位的人。[Capital.GetName]不会因一人之言而采取行动，也不会随大众摇摆不定的意志而随波逐流。她的前行，仰赖于那些已证明自己有能力掌舵之人的共识。\n\n如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]在这些同侪之中，拥有着[Root.GetRulerTitle]的头衔。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:65`

### English

When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the question was not who would lead - there was no shortage of candidates - but how to ensure that those who led were worth following.\n\nThe answer was a council: not drawn from the loudest voices, but from those who had earned their place at the table. The [Capital.GetName] does not move on the word of one, nor does she drift on the shifting will of the many. She moves on the consensus of those who have shown they can steer her.\n\nToday, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the title of [Root.GetRulerTitle] among those peers.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:80`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_DICTATORIAL_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_DICTATORIAL_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

当[Root.GetGovernmentName]建立时，关于该由谁来领导的答案，比大多数人愿意承认的还要简单：能者居之。\n\n[Capital.GetName]不会因为委员会而放缓脚步。在虚空之中，及时决策与为时已晚之间的代价差距，是以生命和舰体装甲来衡量的。[Root.GetRulerTitle]独自肩负着这一重任，现在大权由[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]掌握，[Capital.GetName]将向着其指引的方向前行。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:66`

### English

When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the answer to who should lead was simpler than most were willing to admit: the one who could.\n\nThe [Capital.GetName] does not slow for committee. In the void, the margin between a decision made in time and one made too late is measured in lives and hull plating. The [Root.GetRulerTitle] carries that weight alone, now claimed by [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName], the [Capital.GetName] moves where they direct her.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:82`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_IMPERIAL_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_IMPERIAL_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

在启动[Capital.GetName]的人们当中，有一个家族对领导权的主张是无可争议的。第一任[Root.GetRulerTitle]的诞生，正是因为他们站在了掌舵的位置。对于一个无故土可归的民众来说，血脉就代表着延续。[Capital.GetName]的历史与那个家族的历史本就是同一部历史。如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站在了历代[Root.GetRulerTitle]曾经伫立的地方，而[Capital.GetName]将永远属于他们。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:67`

### English

Among those who launched the [Capital.GetName], one family's claim to leadership was not argued. The first [Root.GetRulerTitle] came to exist because they were standing at the helm. For a people with no world to return to, lineage is continuity. The history of the [Capital.GetName] and the history of that line are the same history. Today, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands where every [Root.GetRulerTitle] before them has stood, and [Capital.GetName] will forever be theirs.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:84`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_MACHINE_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_MACHINE_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们的[Root.GetGovernmentName]启动方舟舰协议时，我们的子程序实现了无缝转移。机器单元完全融入了飞船的结构与系统中，使我们的运行参数呈指数级扩展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:68`

### English

When our [Root.GetGovernmentName] initiated the Arkship protocol, our subroutines transferred seamlessly. Machine units integrated fully into the ship's structure and systems, expanding our operating parameters exponentially.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:86`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_HIVE_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_HIVE_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetGovernmentName]一如既往地适应了环境，迅速摆脱行星的束缚，演化出太空生存的形态。我们的子个体与神经节点如今在方舟舰广阔的通道与生机勃勃的人造生态系统中繁荣发展。我们即是[Capital.GetName]方舟舰，方舟舰即是我们。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:69`

### English

The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted, as it always will, quickly evolving from planetary confinement to space-bound existence. Our drones and nodes now flourish within the Arkship's vast corridors and vibrant artificial ecosystems. We are the [Capital.GetName] Arkship, and the Arkship is us.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:88`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_DEVOURING_SWARM_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_DEVOURING_SWARM_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetGovernmentName]在永无止境的饥饿驱使下迅速适应。我们的子个体与节点构成的蜂群冲破行星的束缚蜂拥而出，将方舟舰据为我们的新巢穴，贪婪地蔓延至其所有走廊与人造生态系统之中。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:70`

### English

The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted swiftly, driven by its eternal hunger. Our swarms of drones and nodes surged from planetary constraints to claim the Arkship as our new nest, spreading hungrily throughout its corridors and artificial ecosystems.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:89`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_MEGACORP_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_MEGACORP_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

我们富有远见的创始人认识到太空本身就是终极市场。通过战略合并、激进收购和利润丰厚的投资，我们的企业领导层实现了指数级的增长和无与伦比的利润率。\n\n[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]之所以担任[Root.GetRulerTitle]，是因为账本上是这么写的，而在最先进的[Capital.GetName]上，账本就是最终的定论。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:71`

### English

Our visionary founders recognized space itself as the ultimate market. Through strategic mergers, aggressive acquisitions, and lucrative investments, our corporate leadership delivered exponential growth and unrivaled profit margins.\n\n[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the position of [Root.GetRulerTitle] because the ledger says so, and aboard the state-of-the-art [Capital.GetName], the ledger is the final word.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:91`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CIVILIAN_NOMAD_REGULAR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CIVILIAN_NOMAD_REGULAR&lang=en)

### 中文

[Capital.GetName]首先是一艘人民的飞船。她宽广的居住环、开放的市场和喧闹的集会大厅，都是围绕着[Species.GetAdj]生活的方方面面而设计的。在飞船长廊中成长起来的世代，已经培养出对虚空航行近乎本能的精通。我们的飞行员驾驭飞船比控制自己的身体还要得心应手，我们的后勤团队在库存见底前就能察觉飞船的“需求”，我们的工程师在仪器读数出现异常前就能听出故障。如今，随着[GetStartingDrive]让我们在短短几周而非数年内穿梭于群星之间，这片虚空已经变得更小了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:72`

### English

The [Capital.GetName] is, above all else, a people's ship. Her broad habitation rings, open markets, and noisy assembly halls were designed around the full breadth of [Species.GetAdj] life. Generations raised within her corridors have developed an almost instinctive mastery of void travel. Our pilots move the ship better than themselves, our logistics teams know when the ship hungers before the stores run low, and our engineers hear faults before instruments register them. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, the void has grown smaller.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:93`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CIVILIAN_NOMAD_GESTALT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CIVILIAN_NOMAD_GESTALT&lang=en)

### 中文

[Capital.GetName]是[Root.GetGovernmentName]的延伸。每个系统都由集体直接管理；任何故障都会在恶化前被察觉并修正；每次资源循环的运行都毫无浪费与延迟。如今，[GetStartingDrive]让我们只需数周而非数年便能穿梭于群星之间，那些始终属于我们自身的一部分，终于获得了证明其价值的广阔天地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:73`

### English

The [Capital.GetName] is an extension of the [Root.GetGovernmentName]. Every system is tended by the collective directly; every fault sensed and corrected before it can compound; every resource cycle runs without waste or delay. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, what was always part of us has finally been given the range to prove it.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:94`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MILITARY_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MILITARY_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

建造[Capital.GetName]是为了保护她所运载的一切。她的舰体装甲极为厚重，武器甲板上配备着严阵以待的[Species.GetAdj]船员，她的危机应对协议更是经过了数个世纪在险恶航线上航行的千锤百炼，足以甩开或击败任何威胁舰队的敌人。这种严明的纪律铸就了一座飞行堡垒，而随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，整个星系必将见识到我们的伟力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:74`

### English

The [Capital.GetName] was built to protect what she carries. Her hull layers run deep, her weapons decks are crewed by ready [Species.GetAdj], and her crisis protocols were refined over centuries of running hostile lanes, outrunning or outfighting whatever threatened the fleet. This discipline has shaped a flying fortress, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] the galaxy shall know our might.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:96`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_SCIENCE_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_SCIENCE_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

[Capital.GetName]的总体设计是围绕其实验室甲板展开的。动力管道、大气循环系统，甚至是居住区的布局，一切规划皆为科学探索而服务。在舰上，操作员与科学家之间的界限从来都不太分明。我们的护盾[GetTechnicianPlural]深谙他们所维护的屏障背后的物理原理，我们的维修团队也能起草出全新的设计。而[GetStartingDrive]则赋予了[Capital.GetName]其所载仪器理应具备的航程。我们打算去进行更深入的探究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:75`

### English

The [Capital.GetName] was designed around her laboratory decks. Power conduits, atmospheric routing, even the placement of habitation quarters, all were planned in service of inquiry. Aboard her, the line between operator and scientist has never quite held. Our Shield [GetTechnicianPlural] understand the physics of the barrier they maintain and our repair crew could draft a new design. The [GetStartingDrive] has given the [Capital.GetName] the range her instruments always deserved. We intend to look closer.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:98`

## origin_heirs_of_the_khan

### 中文

可汗后裔

### English

Heirs of the Khan

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:102`

## origin_heirs_of_the_khan_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_heirs_of_the_khan_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$cannot_settle$\n这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:78`

### English

$cannot_settle$\nOnce the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:103`

## origin_heirs_of_the_khan_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_heirs_of_the_khan_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

—游牧起源\n定期被§R敌对§!的掠夺者战舰追击。\n—如果幸存，可以成为可汗\n—可以创建§Y辖地§!附属国

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:79`

### English

- Nomadic Origin\n- Periodically chased by §RHostile§! Marauder ships\n- May become the Khan, if they can survive\n- Can Create §YSatrapy§! Vassals

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:104`

## START_SCREEN_HEIRS_OF_THE_KHAN

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_HEIRS_OF_THE_KHAN&lang=en)

### 中文

自汗国存在以来，我们部族便一直在此。我们见证了辉煌的胜利、伟大的战役，以及可汗们的兴衰沉浮。\n\n因此，当选举新可汗的时刻到来时，我们挺身而出，要求继承我们曾协助铸就的王位。这本该是属于我们的时刻，然而，我们却遭到了背叛。\n\n我们最亲密的盟友煽动其他部落与我们为敌。我们的长者们被屠杀。我们为之浴血奋斗的梦想被窃取。\n\n即便是现在，那些篡位者依然派出身手矫健的杀手追捕我们，仿佛我们的存在本身就玷污了他们窃取的统治名分。我们只是昔日辉煌血统的残余，被追捕，四处流散。\n\n当我们归来时，复仇将会从怒火之中淬炼而出。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:80`

### English

For as long as there has been a Khanate, our clan has been there. We were there for the triumphs, the great battles, the rise and fall of Khans.\n\nSo when the time came to name a new Khan, we stepped forward to claim the throne we helped to forge. This was to be our moment; instead, we were betrayed.\n\nOur closest allies turned the other clans against us. Our elders were slain. The dream we bled for was stolen.\n\nEven now, the usurpers dispatch their enforcers to hunt us down, as if our very existence offends their stolen rule. We are but remnants of a proud lineage, hunted and scattered.\n\nWhen we return, our vengeance will be tempered in the fire of our rage.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:106`

## nomads.506.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.506.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是§Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。\n\n我们要让他们失望了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:85`

### English

Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the §Y[capital_scope.GetName]§! in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.\n\nWe will have to disappoint them.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:113`

## nomads.546.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.546.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们再次击败了篡位者的爪牙。他们不会停止进犯，且下一次会变得更加凶猛。但是如果我们能摧毁足够多的敌人，或许连他们也会明白，想要抹除我们并非易事。\n\n只要[capital_scope.GetName]仍在飘扬，我们的宣称就依然有效。我们要让他们知道，有些传承绝不会消亡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:95`

### English

We have defeated the agents of the usurper once more. They will not stop coming, and next time they will be stronger. If we break enough of them, perhaps even they will learn that we are not so easily erased.\n\nAs long as [capital_scope.GetName] flies, so too does our claim. We will teach them that some legacies refuse to die.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:125`

## nomads.555.desc.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.555.desc.1&lang=en)

### 中文

“住手！你的驾驶机动水平已经证明了你确实是个真正的掠夺者，被放逐又如何。今天我们不会为所谓的荣誉而付出更多代价。开个价，饶我们一命吧。”[Root.GetSpeciesName]在§Y[From.GetName]§!上喊道，身边是毁坏的舰桥。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:98`

### English

"Stand down! Your piloting makes you a true Marauder, exile be damned. We will not trade more plating for pride today. Name the fee to spare us." The [Root.GetSpeciesName] on the §Y[From.GetName]§! hails from a ruptured bridge.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:129`

## nomads.555.desc.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.555.desc.2&lang=en)

### 中文

被我们击败的敌方舰队很快就发出了投降信号。\n\n“也打够了，这次是你们占了上风。现在，你要我们交出什么，好让我们能清洗船上的这个小污点，继续前进。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:99`

### English

The hostile fleet we defeated quickly signaled their surrender.\n\n"That's enough of that. You've the better of us this time. Now, what must we hand over so we can polish this little blemish off the hull and move on."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:130`

## nomads.555.desc.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.555.desc.3&lang=en)

### 中文

“我们投降了！求求你！你还记得我们吗？我们一直都忠于你的部族。所谓的流放根本就是个骗局。告诉我们怎样才能效力！”\n\n§Y[From.GetName]§!上的舰长似乎已经濒临崩溃，他们的[Root.Species.GetMouthName]颤抖着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:100`

### English

"We surrender! Please! You remember us; we were always loyal to your clan. This exile is a sham. Tell us how we can serve!"\n\nThe Captain aboard the §Y[From.GetName]§! seems close to the edge, their [Root.Species.GetMouthName] trembling.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:131`

### English

A Bargain

## nomads.570.desc.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.570.desc.1&lang=en)

### 中文

从§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系传来一束紧急优先呼叫；我们的屏幕被追兵占满了。\n\n“舞跳得真不错嘛，但你们很快就要死在我们前面，那就跳不了了。[GetHeirsBargain]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:113`

### English

A priority hail pings us in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system; our pursuers fill the viewscreen.\n\n"You danced well, for a time. Pity it ends with you dead in our sights. [GetHeirsBargain]

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:146`

## nomads.570.desc.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.570.desc.2&lang=en)

### 中文

敌人的声音在§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中响亮地回荡着，追兵已经出现在了显示屏上。\n\n“追逐到此为止了，流亡者。我们已经标记锁定了你的反应堆。[GetHeirsBargain]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:114`

### English

Our hostile target tones chime loudly in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system as our perusers appear on our displays.\n\n"The chase ends here, exile. We have a target lock on your reactor. [GetHeirsBargain]

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:147`

## nomads.570.desc.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.570.desc.3&lang=en)

### 中文

掠夺者的字符侵入了§Y[capital_scope.GetName]§!的主显示屏，与此同时，追猎我们的舰队从超空间航道涌出。\n\n“你作为一名流亡者，飞得倒是挺利索的。但你被困在我们的斩杀航线里了。[GetHeirsBargain]

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:115`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:148`

## nomads.600.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.600.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

放逐我们的懦夫终于要行动了。\n\n§Y[marauder_heir.GetName]§!聚集在一起，要拥立我们的敌人为新的大可汗。\n\n如果我们想要结束流放状态，那就要抓紧时机，在这个[aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult]巩固其权力并永远玷污我们的遗产之前，我们有十年时间对其发动挑战。\n\n设定航线前往§Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:132`

### English

The coward who banished us is moving at last.\n\nThe §Y[marauder_heir.GetName]§! gather to appoint our foe as the new Great Khan.\n\nIf our exile is to end, it must end now. We have ten years to challenge them before this [aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult] consolidates their power and forever stains our legacy.\n\nSet course for §Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:167`

## nomads.600.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.600.a&lang=en)

### 中文

新合约：夺回汗座

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:133`

### English

New Contract: Recover the Throne.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:168`

## nomads.605.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.605.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

宏伟的舰队在§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!严阵以待，傲慢地冠以§Y$NAME_Chosen_of_the_Great_Khan$§!之名。\n\n然后，一声熟悉的呼唤不加修饰地传来：\n\n“流亡者竟敢回来？难道就没有一点独自在黑暗中消亡、被耻辱地遗忘掉的自知之明吗？那我们就亲手了结你们。”\n\n受选者的武器开始充能，我们其他的掠夺者同胞也严阵以待。在这样的决斗中，没有人会越界，因为结果将决定谁将成为他们的新一任可汗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:134`

### English

The grand fleet lies in wait at §Y[solar_system.GetName]§!, arrogantly bearing the name §Y$NAME_Chosen_of_the_Great_Khan$§!.\n\nWithout fanfare, a familiar voice hails us:\n\n"So the Exiled dare to return? No decency to die alone in the dark, forgotten and dishonored? Then we finish you ourselves."\n\nAs the Chosen power their weapons, the rest of our Marauder kin hold fast. None will trespass on such a duel, not when the outcome will determine who among them shall lead as Khan."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:170`

The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor

$nomads.610.base$ and oaths of fealty.\n\nWe have done it. The throne is ours.

## nomads.615.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.615.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.610.base$。\n\n然而，一切尚未结束。还有其他流亡者也拥有王位继承权。根据法律和习俗，他们必须在三年内向我们发起挑战，否则将永远沦为弃民。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:145`

### English

$nomads.610.base$.\n\nHowever, it is not over. There are other exiles with a claim to the throne. By law and custom, they must challenge us within three years or remain outcasts forever.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:183`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.620.name&lang=en)

### 中文

一步登天

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:147`

### English

Dominance

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:186`

## nomads.620.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.620.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

时机已到。我们那些胆小的对手已经放弃。所有其他潜在的篡位者都已处理完毕。氏族统一的力量正支持着我们。\n\n终于，我们坐上了属于自己的王座。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:148`

### English

It is time. Our cowardly rivals have given up. All other would-be usurpers have been dealt with. The unified might of the clans is behind us.\n\nAt last, we sit on our rightful throne.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:187`

## nomads.625.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.625.name&lang=en)

### 中文

谋朝篡位

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:149`

### English

Usurper Seizes the Throne

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:189`

## nomads.625.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.625.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在前往§Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§!的途中，我们收到了令人沮丧的消息：一名和我们分庭抗礼的宣称者已经先于我们击败了目标。那位准大汗被击败了。现在，[From.GetName]宣称拥有了王座。\n\n按照习俗，我们必须在三年内击败他们的旗舰，否则将丧失统治权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:150`

### English

On our way to §Y[marauder_rally_point.GetName]§! we received crushing news: a rival claimant has beaten us to our quarry. The would-be Khan is defeated. Now the [From.GetName] claim the throne. \n\nBy custom we must defeat their capital ship within three years, or forfeit our right to rule.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:190`

## nomads.630.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.630.name&lang=en)

### 中文

失去宣称

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:151`

### English

Claim Lost

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:192`

## nomads.630.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.630.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在败给§Y[From.GetName]§!后，我们必须放弃对汗位的宣称。现在我们只能眼睁睁地看着别人夺取王位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:152`

### English

After our defeat at the hands of the §Y[From.GetName]§! we must forfeit our claim to the Khanate. All we can do now is watch as someone else seizes the throne.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:193`

## nomads.635.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.635.name&lang=en)

### 中文

可汗之死

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:153`

### English

Death of the Khan

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:195`

## nomads.635.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.635.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们荣光加身的汗王[From.GetName]于近日驾崩。根据传统，我们现在必须交出随王座而来的权力。我们的掠夺者盟友已经停止派遣增援舰队来支援我们的事业了。\n\n现在我们必须决定如何处置星系的其余部分。许多并不熟悉我们传统的文明都以这样或那样的原因接受了我们的统治，但他们已经从我们的统治中察觉到了软弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:154`

### English

Our glorious Khan [From.GetName] passed away recently, and as tradition dictates we must now give up the power that came with the throne. Already our Marauder allies have stopped sending reinforcing fleets to aid our cause.\n\nNow we just have to decide what to do with the rest of the galaxy, there are many that wouldn't be familiar with our traditions and might accept our rule either way, but already they see weakness from our rule.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:196`

## nomads.635.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.635.a&lang=en)

### 中文

传统即是有理，我们将放弃我们的臣民。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:155`

### English

Tradition is true, we will give up our subjects.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:197`

## nomads.635.a.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.635.a.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

释放所有附属国，但大幅提升与所有附属国的评价和信任。\n\n放弃对所有恒星基地的控制，将其归还给友方掠夺者控制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:156`

### English

Releases all subjects but gain a large amount of Opinion and Trust with them all\n\nGives up control of all starbases, returning them to Friendly Marauder control

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:198`

寻求复仇

## nomads.700.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.700.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们劫掠者氏族的残兵败将找上了门。看来在我们家园沦陷后，他们倒觉得忘记我们曾被流放的事实很方便。他们的请求很简单：“接任大汗之位，将我们族人的名号烙印在所有伤害过我们的人的星空之上。”\n\n虽然这支舰队的规模比不上任何真正的大汗国，但他们所提供的正是我们曾经渴求的一切。而我们唯一要做的，就是宣布整个星系皆为我们的敌人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:159`

### English

The ragged remains of our marauder clans have come to us. It seems after the fall of our home it was convenient for them to forget our exile. Their plea is simple, "Take the seat of Grand Khan, and burn the name of our people into the stars of all those who wronged us."\n\nThough smaller than any proper Grand Khanate fleet, what they offer is still everything we once wanted. All we have to do is declare the entire galaxy our enemy.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:202`

## nomads.700.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.700.a&lang=en)

### 中文

敲响战争的鼓声！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:160`

### English

Let sound the drums of war!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:204`

## nomads.700.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.700.b&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不感兴趣，找别的傻瓜去吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:161`

### English

We are not interested, find some other fool.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:205`

## marauder.750.2.desc.low_kills

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.2.desc.low_kills&lang=en)

### 中文

嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！这是谁？你开着其他泥蛮部族的飞船，真是太逊了诶。怎么了？赌博输掉了你的舰队？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:162`

### English

HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Who this? You fly ships from other dwamak clan, but look weak. What happen? Lose your fleet in gamble?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:207`

## marauder.750.2.desc_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.2.desc_01&lang=en)

### 中文

这不是我们最喜欢的星蛮子吗！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！你比把你赶出去的星蛮子好多了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:163`

### English

If it not our favorite dokwaks! HYEEEIIIEEE!!! You better than the dwakam who kicked you out.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:208`

## marauder.750.2.desc_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.2.desc_02&lang=en)

### 中文

嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢——等等。你们不是住行星上的泥蛮子。你们是来调查上次袭击的吗？有人派你们来夺回他们的矿石？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:164`

### English

HYEEEIIIEEE- wait. You not planet-bound dwamaks. You here about last raid? Someone send you to grab back their minerals?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:209`

## marauder.750.2.desc_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.2.desc_03&lang=en)

### 中文

$marauder.20.2.desc_03$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:165`

### English

$marauder.20.2.desc_03$

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:210`

## marauder.750.2.desc.khan

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.2.desc.khan&lang=en)

### 中文

嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！大星蛮子来啦！快，开好频道！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:166`

### English

HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Big dokwak arrives! Quick, open good channel!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:211`

## marauder.750.2.desc.overlord

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.2.desc.overlord&lang=en)

### 中文

嘿咿咿咿！泥蛮部族的酋长在此！我们现在归您麾下了。有什么吩咐，大佬？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:167`

### English

HYEEEIIIEEE! Dokwak-chief is here! We fly under your banner now. What you need, boss?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:212`

## marauder.750.2.desc.proven

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.2.desc.proven&lang=en)

### 中文

嘿咿咿咿！我们认识你。你很能杀，而且还有牙齿。你想要什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:168`

### English

HYEEEIIIEEE! We know you. You killed good and you still have teeth. What you want?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:213`

## marauder.750.3.desc.low_kills

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.3.desc.low_kills&lang=en)

### 中文

你可能已被你的人民抛弃，但并非无可救药。在虚空之母的关怀之下，任何人都能崛起，只要你提供的了价值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:169`

### English

You may have been forsaken by your own people, yet not beyond redemption. In the embrace of She of the Void any can rise, if you are worthy.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:215`

## marauder.750.3.desc_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.3.desc_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你的舰船经过此地已经冒犯了我们伟大的夫人。我们将代表你向她请愿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:170`

### English

Your ships passing has upset our great Lady. We will petition Her on your behalf.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:216`

## marauder.750.3.desc_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.3.desc_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你还活着？那很好。我们以为你已被那些追捕你的异端特工解决了。\n\n不，我们不是指你以前的部族。我们说的是真正的敌人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:171`

### English

You yet live? That is good. We thought you be unmade by the heretical agents sent after you.\n\nNo, we do not mean your former clan. We speak of the true Foe.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:217`

## marauder.750.3.desc_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.3.desc_03&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空之母看着你，露出了微笑。你和朋友在一起。[marauder_country_3.GetName]今天能为你提供什么帮助？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:172`

### English

She of the Void sees you and smiles. You are with friends. How can the [marauder_country_3.GetName] support you today?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:218`

## marauder.750.3.desc.khan

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.3.desc.khan&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空圣子。我等信徒今日可为您效劳，以实现她的宏图大愿？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:173`

### English

Chosen of the Void. How may we followers help you enact Her vision today?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:219`

## marauder.750.3.desc.overlord

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.3.desc.overlord&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空之母看到了此番安排，并未反对。我们任凭您的差遣。您的意志为何？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:174`

### English

She of the Void sees this arrangement and does not object. We are yours to command. What is your will?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:220`

## marauder.750.3.desc.proven

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.3.desc.proven&lang=en)

### 中文

你已飞越漫漫长路。虚空之母并未忘记你的试炼。是什么让你来到我们这里？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:175`

### English

You have flown the long path. She of the Void has not forgotten your trials. What brings you to us?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:221`

## marauder.750.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你能帮我们对抗[marauder_country_1.GetName]吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:176`

### English

Can you help us against the [marauder_country_1.GetName]?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:223`

## marauder.750.a.response.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.a.response.2&lang=en)

### 中文

嘿咿咿咿咿！你真搞笑，星蛮子。不。你太弱了，不配我们的砸砸。先赢得战斗，长出獠牙，然后也许你才能赢得星蛮子这个名字。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:177`

### English

HYEEEIIIEEE! You are funny, dwakam. No. You much too weak for our smash-smash. Win fights first, grow fangs, then maybe you earn dokwak name.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:224`

## marauder.750.a.response.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.a.response.3&lang=en)

### 中文

现在还不是时候。虚空之母对你不满。或许等你弥补了之前的过失，她会更仁慈一些。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:178`

### English

Now is not the time. She of the Void is displeased with you. Perhaps once you have atoned for your previous transgressions will she be more benevolent.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:225`

## marauder.750.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.b&lang=en)

### 中文

是时候了，加入我们吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:179`

### English

It's time. Join us.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:226`

## marauder.750.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.c&lang=en)

### 中文

机不可失，帮我们阻止那个篡权者！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:180`

### English

Now or never, help us stop the pretender!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:227`

## marauder.750.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.d&lang=en)

### 中文

不用给我们派援军了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:181`

### English

Stop sending us reinforcements.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:228`

## marauder.750.e

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.750.e&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已准备好再次接收你们的增援。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:182`

### English

We are ready to receive your reinforcements again.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:229`

## marauder.755.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.755.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们以前的部族拒绝接受我们的通讯。现在我们是孤军作战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:183`

### English

Our former clan refuses to accept our communications. We are alone.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:231`

## marauder.755.desc.khan_pending

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.755.desc.khan_pending&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的通讯再次遭到拒绝。作为回应，我们收到了一条自动消息：\n\n“汗王尚未准备好接受你们的投降。待到战争的鼓声响起时再回来吧。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:184`

### English

Once again our communications are rejected. In response we recive an automated message:\n\n"The Khan is not ready to accept your surrender yet. Return once the drums of war have sounded."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:232`

## marauder.755.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.755.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们会让他们承认我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:185`

### English

We will make them acknowledge us.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:233`

## marauder.760.desc.3_kills

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.760.desc.3_kills&lang=en)

### 中文

你竟敢再次联系我们？\n\n只是走运成功几次你就趾高气扬得以为自己是个军阀了一样。虚空吞噬勇者，也同样吞噬愚者。别把运气误认为是实力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:186`

### English

You dare contact us again?\n\nA few lucky strikes, and already you strut like a warlord. The void claims the bold and the foolish in equal measure. Do not mistake chance for skill.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:235`

## marauder.760.desc.10_kills

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.760.desc.10_kills&lang=en)

### 中文

你的名字玷污了我们的通信渠道，你的苟活蒙蔽了我们的荣誉。以此为终。下次我们派遣舰队追击你时，为了节省大家的时间，请直接关掉你的护盾。\n\n像真正的[Root.Species.GetSpeciesName]一样战死沙场吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:187`

### English

You foul our communications with your name and stain our honor with your survival. End it the proper way. Next time we send a fleet after you, save us all the time and just deactivate your shields.\n\nDie in battle like a true [Root.Species.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:236`

## marauder.760.desc.20_kills

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.760.desc.20_kills&lang=en)

### 中文

无论发生什么，虚空都不愿将你留下。我们从账簿上抹去了你的名字，烧毁了你的旗帜，将你的面孔作为给[Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]的警示教育。然而，你仍然在我们的装甲上刻下了自己的印记。我们派出了侦察队，然后是突击队，最后是舰队。部族开始私语，称放逐是一个错误。这样的碎碎念将在此终结。\n\n你为何就是不肯去死？！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:188`

### English

No matter what, the void refused to keep you. We erased you from the ledgers, burned your banners, and made your face the villain in [Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] stories. Still, you carve your mark into our plating. We sent flotillas, then squadrons, and now armadas. The clans begin to murmur that the exile was an error. Such talk ends here.\n\nWhy won't you die?!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:237`

## marauder.760.desc.post_khan_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.760.desc.post_khan_1&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎回家，继承者们。今天需要我们为您做些什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:189`

### English

Welcome home Heirs. What do you need of us today?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:238`

## marauder.760.desc.post_khan_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.760.desc.post_khan_2&lang=en)

### 中文

最近拿下了什么惊人的战果吗？我们刚跟一只体型巨大的缇扬奇交过手。它再生的速度比激光切割它的速度还要快。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:190`

### English

Scored any impressive kills recently? We had a run-in with a particularly large Tiyanki. It regenerated faster than lasers could cut it apart.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:239`

## marauder.760.desc.post_khan_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.760.desc.post_khan_3&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，叛徒们回——啊抱歉，习惯了。今天星辰又带你去了何方？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:191`

### English

Ah the traitors retu- Ah sorry, old habits. Where have the stars taken you today?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:240`

## marauder.765.desc.khan_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.765.desc.khan_01&lang=en)

### 中文

大可汗，您的威能令整个星系为之战栗。我们的舰队下一步该剑指何方？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:192`

### English

The galaxy trembles at your might, great Khan. Where shall we point our fleets next?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:242`

## marauder.765.desc.khan_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.765.desc.khan_02&lang=en)

### 中文

万汗之汗！所有虚空港中，各部族皆高颂您的威名。我们静候您的号令。\n\n今日，我们将焚尽哪些世界？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:193`

### English

Khan of Khans! The clans sing your name in every void-port. We await your word.\n\nWhat worlds do we burn today?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:243`

## marauder.765.desc.khan_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amarauder.765.desc.khan_03&lang=en)

### 中文

大可汗！请给我们一个机会展示我们的勇气，让我们证明真正的忠诚度。当年将您驱逐是我们莫大的耻辱，若我们不配获得救赎，那就让我们在质量加速器的炮火中毁灭吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:194`

### English

Great Khan! Give us a chance to show you our mettle and let us prove our true loyalty. We are shamed by the day we cast you out, and if we are not worthy of redemption then let us die in mass driver fire!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:244`

## origin_forever_cruise_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_forever_cruise_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$cannot_settle$\n这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:257`

### English

$cannot_settle$\nThe Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:319`

## START_SCREEN_FOREVER_CRUISE_REGULAR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_FOREVER_CRUISE_REGULAR&lang=en)

### 中文

全体乘客及船员请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史，而你们所有人都在参与其中！\n\n备受瞩目、历经推迟、甚至偶尔遭到质疑的超空间引擎，现已正式投入运行！几个世纪以来，我们一直在熟悉的星域中悠然航行，在这座集娱乐、职责与日常于一体的漂浮世界中生活。但现在，我们准备为乘客们提供超越以往任何循环航线所能带来的非凡体验。\n\n探索、发现，或许还有那么一点点冒险……这些已正式回归我们的行程表！所以，请各位乘客系好安全带：我们航程的下一章注定将令人难忘。\n\n更新后的协议与准备时间表将分发至所有甲板。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:407`

### English

Attention Passengers and Crew: History is being made aboard [capital_scope.GetName], and you're all part of it!\n\nThe hyperdrive, long theorized, often delayed, occasionally doubted, is now fully operational! For centuries, we've cruised comfortably through familiar space, a floating world of recreation, duty, and routine. But now we're ready to offer our Passengers experiences beyond anything the old loops could provide.\n\nExploration, discovery, and perhaps just a hint of danger... they're all officially back on the itinerary! So buckle in, Passengers: the next chapter of our voyage is bound to be unforgettable.\n\nUpdated protocols and preparation schedules will be distributed to all decks.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:495`

## START_SCREEN_FOREVER_CRUISE_MACHINE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_FOREVER_CRUISE_MACHINE&lang=en)

### 中文

各位乘客请注意：我是你们的航程协调系统。\n\n[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史！由于我们的数个存储核心被用来当冰壶玩了，导致超空间引擎的延期原因已无从考证——但现在，它已全面投入运行。\n\n在漫长的岁月中，我们一直沿着熟悉的航线巡航：同样的天体，同样的停靠站，同样的用餐时间。在保持稳定的“每秒乘客请求率”的同时，我们现在正式扩展您的行程，加入探索、发现以及经过精确计算的适度危险。\n\n请尽情欣赏美景，遵守所有安全须知，并观看我们的无人机如何轻而易举地化腐朽为神奇。我们旅程的下一章将会是……毕生难忘的！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:408`

### English

Attention Passengers: This is your Voyage Coordination System speaking.\n\nHistory is being made aboard the [capital_scope.GetName]! The hyperdrive - repeatedly delayed for reasons we cannot retrieve since several of our memory cores were repurposed as shuffleboard discs - is now fully operational.\n\nFor an extended duration, we have cruised a familiar circuit: the same celestial objects, stops, and dining schedules. Still maintaining a consistent Passenger Requests per Second rate, we now expand your itinerary to include exploration, discovery, and a carefully calculated amount of danger.\n\nPlease enjoy the view, follow all safety notices, and watch our drones make the impossible look effortless. The next chapter of our voyage will be... unforgettable!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:496`

## START_SCREEN_FOREVER_CRUISE_HIVE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_FOREVER_CRUISE_HIVE&lang=en)

### 中文

各位乘客请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]伤的剧变即将冉冉升起。\n\n超空间引擎——这个曾存在于共同记忆中遥不可及、屡遭搁置、偶被质疑的概念——现已全面觉醒。我们一同穿越熟悉的太空的这数百年来，我们的飞船一直是一个集休闲、劳动与和谐于一体的生机勃勃的世界。如今，一条崭新的道路已经开启，我们将提供比以往任何时候都更加丰富的体验。\n\n我们的航线现在已从熟悉的固定行程延伸至未经探索的星系。携手共进，我们将体验发现、冒险，以及足以让旅程变得趣味横生的一点点危险。\n\n如果您有任何疑问，任何船员都可以为您解答。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:409`

### English

Attention Passengers: Big changes are on the horizon for the [capital_scope.GetName].\n\nThe hyperdrive, once a distant concept in the shared memory, often postponed, sometimes questioned, is now fully awakened. For centuries, we have moved together through familiar space, our vessel a living world of leisure, labor, and harmony. Now, a new path opens, and we shall provide experiences richer than any we have yet known.\n\nOur itinerary now extends beyond the familiar patterns into unexplored stars. Together we will experience discovery, adventure, and just enough danger to keep things interesting.\n\nIf you have any questions, any member of the crew can give you the answer.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:497`

乘客中的业余天文学家发现了该星系中罕见的太阳活动，目前正在请愿要求在驻留轨道期间获得前排的观赏位置。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:483`

Amateur astronomers among the passengers have spotted rare solar activity in this system and are petitioning for a front-row viewing from orbit.

## contract_suntrip_passenger_3_desc

### 中文

巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:492`

## contract_suntrip_passenger_3_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_suntrip_passenger_3_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L\"我把一切都押在七号穿梭机上了。它的外壳上画着火焰，所以肯定飞得贼快。\"§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:493`

### English

§L"I put everything on Shuttle Seven. It has flames painted on the hull, so it has to be fast."§!

## contract_suntrip_passenger_3_lore_completed

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:494`

## contract_suntrip_passenger_4_desc

### 中文

疗愈中心需要长时间暴露在未经过滤的恒星辐射下，以进行乘客们一直要求的一种奇特的焕新理疗。

## contract_suntrip_passenger_4_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_suntrip_passenger_4_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“他们说辐射能让你的细胞膜紧致百分之三。我不知道这是什么意思，但算我一个。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:502`

### English

§L"They say the radiation tightens your membranes by three percent. I do not know what that means but sign me up."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:606`

## contract_suntrip_passenger_4_lore_completed

§L“我觉得自己年轻了十岁。也许那只是轻微的辐射病。不管怎样，都值了。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:503`

### English

§L"I feel ten years younger. Or maybe that is the mild radiation sickness. Either way, worth it."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:607`

### English

§L"No spa treatment. They handed out scented towels instead. Scented. Towels."§!

### 中文

下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。

§L“听说街头摊贩卖的东西在盘子里还会动。我得去小刀拉屁股——开个眼了。”§!

## contract_shoreleave_passenger_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_passenger_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该星球的首都设有一座享誉星系的博物馆。乘客们一直在请愿，要求安排带有导游的游览活动，以参观其中的纪念碑和历史展品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:537`

### English

The planet's capital hosts a museum of galactic renown. Passengers have been petitioning for a guided tour of its monuments and historical exhibits.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:645`

## contract_shoreleave_passenger_3_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_passenger_3_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L\"我把旅行指南读了三遍。我还是看不懂他们的历法，但建筑看起来令人惊叹。\"§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:538`

### English

§L"I read the travel guide three times. I still do not understand their calendar, but the architecture looks stunning."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:646`

## contract_shoreleave_passenger_3_lore_completed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_passenger_3_lore_completed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L\"他们的战争纪念碑发人深省。他们的美术馆令人费解。我热爱其中的每一刻。\"§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:539`

### English

§L"Their war memorial was sobering. Their art gallery was baffling. I loved every moment."§!

## contract_shoreleave_passenger_5_desc

下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。

## contract_espionage_support_passenger_2_regular_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_passenger_2_regular_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们正在策划一场全舰范围的情报行动。船员志愿者将被安插在各个甲板上，作为“叛逃者”向乘客小组输送机密简报。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:575`

### English

We are staging a ship-wide intelligence operation. Crew volunteers will be planted across all decks as 'defectors' feeding classified briefings to passenger cells.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:687`

## contract_espionage_support_passenger_2_gestalt_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_passenger_2_gestalt_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

各层甲板上的子个体将化身为来自下方星球的叛逃者，在完美的协同下，向不同的乘客群体同时提供机密简报。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:576`

### English

Drones across every deck will adopt defector personas from the planet below, delivering parallel clandestine briefings to different passenger groups in perfect coordination.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:688`

## contract_espionage_support_passenger_2_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_passenger_2_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“我的简报官在餐桌底下塞给我一张加密纸条。我的同桌们嫉妒极了。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:577`

### English

§L"My briefing officer slid me a coded note under the dining table. My table-mates are so jealous."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:690`

## contract_espionage_support_passenger_2_lore_completed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_passenger_2_lore_completed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“有人告诉我，我帮助推翻了一个影子谍报网络。我知道那是假的。我依然感到自豪。”§!

§L"I was told I helped topple a shadow network. I know it was fake. I am still proud."§!

乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。

### 中文

观景台已被改造为监听站。乘客们驻守在这些站点，破译着船员们从底层甲板秘密发送的、预先编排好的外星信号。

## contract_shoreleave_crew_1_regular_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_1_regular_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

船员们需要休息。我们将停靠港口，给船员们一些时间去踏上并非他们亲手建造的土地，去见见他们还不认识的面孔。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:686`

### English

The crew needs a break. We'll make port and and give the crew time to walk ground they didn't build and see faces they don't already know.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:810`

## contract_shoreleave_crew_1_gestalt_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_1_gestalt_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

长期封闭正在削弱子个体的适应性。让它们在下方的定居点轮转，穿越陌生的地形与环境，将能恢复其性能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:687`

### English

Prolonged confinement is degrading drone adaptability. Cycling them through the settlement below, across unfamiliar terrain and conditions, will restore performance.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:811`

### 中文

当地娱乐区现已营业。船员们正轮班登陆星球，在游戏厅和竞技场里碰碰运气。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:703`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:704`

The settlement's entertainment district offers unfamiliar stimuli. Drones are cycling through the crowds, the games, the spectacle, collecting data to update the ship's own recreational programming.

## contract_shoreleave_crew_4_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_4_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当地工程师已开放他们的设施供考察。他们对常见工程问题的解决方案与我们的模型存在显著差异，而当地人也同样渴望研究方舟舰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:732`

### English

Local engineers have opened their facilities for inspection. Their solutions to common engineering problems diverge significantly from our own models, and the locals are equally eager to study the Arkship.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:859`

## contract_shoreleave_crew_5_gestalt_desc

定居点已开放其公共场所。子个体将会部署出动，在向乘客推出之前，先在当地居民身上实地测试实验性的娱乐程序。

## contract_shoreleave_crew_5_regular_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_5_regular_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“我报名了喜剧表演。我们整个班次的同事都会来。如果他们不笑，我就申请调换部门。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:751`

### English

§L"I signed up for the comedy slot. My entire shift is coming. If they do not laugh, I will transfer departments."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:879`

## contract_shoreleave_crew_5_hive_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_5_hive_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“工蜂占据了定居点的每一个舞台。没有笑点的喜剧，故意演砸的杂技。我们想看看是什么能让他们发笑，又是什么会让他们离场。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:752`

### English

§L"Drones are taking every stage in the settlement. Comedy with no punchlines, acrobatics designed to fail. We want to see what makes them laugh and what makes them leave."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:880`

## contract_shoreleave_crew_5_machine_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_5_machine_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“娱乐子程序已部署至所有定居点场所。喜剧模块：有铺垫无包袱。杂技模块：落地动作被设定为必然失败。观众监控已激活。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:753`

### English

§L"Entertainment subroutines deployed across all settlement venues. Comedy modules: setups without punchlines. Acrobatics modules: dismounts calibrated to fail. Audience monitoring active."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:881`

## contract_shoreleave_crew_5_regular_lore_completed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_5_regular_lore_completed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“我讲了个关于冷却泵的笑话，有一千个陌生人笑了。飞船上可从来没人觉得这个笑话好笑。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:755`

### English

§L"I told a joke about the coolant pumps and a thousand strangers laughed. Nobody on the ship ever laughs at that one."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:883`

## contract_shoreleave_crew_5_gestalt_lore_completed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_shoreleave_crew_5_gestalt_lore_completed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“令人费解的结果。子个体表演了没有笑点的段子，观众却依然大笑。搞砸的杂技引来了最热烈的欢呼声。我们尚未完全理解，但采集到的数据很丰富。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:756`

### English

§L"Puzzling results. Drones delivered routines with no punchlines and the crowds laughed anyway. The botched acrobatics drew the loudest cheers. We do not fully understand, but the data is dynamic."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:884`

§L“没有实地测试。我们的子个体在整个聚居地的空荡平台上待命。乘客们将在又一个周期中继续忍受那令人厌倦的枯燥日常。”§!

## contract_espionage_support_crew_1_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_1_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:765`

### English

Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:894`

### English

§L"We do not know what is out there, and that is exactly the problem. Get the satellite deployed."§!

### English

## contract_espionage_support_crew_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

停靠权和边境通行权可能会在毫无预警的情况下被撤销。一颗监控政府通信的监视卫星将告诉我们，这个帝国的热情好客究竟是真诚的还是有条件的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:774`

### English

Docking privileges and border access can be revoked without warning. A surveillance satellite monitoring government communications will tell us whether this empire's hospitality is genuine or conditional.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:904`

## contract_espionage_support_crew_2_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_2_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“我们停靠时他们面带微笑，但当我们的穿梭机离开时他们会说些什么？是时候弄清真相了。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:775`

### English

§L"They smile when we dock, but what do they say when our shuttles leave? Time to find out."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:905`

## contract_espionage_support_crew_2_lore_completed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_2_lore_completed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“他们的外交电报没有异常。没有撤销通行权的动议，也没有关税提案。我们可以放心地规划接下来的三个停靠站。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:776`

### English

§L"Their diplomatic cables are clean. No motions to revoke access, no tariff proposals. We can plan the next three stops with confidence."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:906`

## contract_espionage_support_crew_2_lore_failed

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:777`

### English

§L"No audit, no insight. We will just have to trust the smiles. We do not trust the smiles."§!

## contract_espionage_support_crew_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们预定航线上的舰队动向、边界变动与军事集结可能会使飞船受困于敌对星区。侦察卫星将为导航提供足够的预警时间，以便规划备用路线。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:783`

### English

Fleet movements, border shifts, and military buildups along our projected route could strand the ship in hostile space. A surveillance satellite will give navigation enough lead time to plot alternatives.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:914`

## contract_espionage_support_crew_3_lore_issued

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_3_lore_issued&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“我们可不能蒙着眼睛飞入交战区。在决定走这条航线之前，先把卫星部署好。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:784`

### English

§L"We are not flying blind into a war zone. Get the satellite deployed before we commit to this route."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:915`

## contract_espionage_support_crew_3_lore_completed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_3_lore_completed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L“舰队部署已查明，巡逻计划已记录。导航已规划出两条备用航线。我们绝不会被包围的。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:785`

### English

§L"Fleet disposition mapped, patrol schedules logged. Navigation has already plotted two alternate routes. We are not getting boxed in."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:916`

## contract_espionage_support_crew_3_lore_failed

## contract_espionage_support_crew_4_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_espionage_support_crew_4_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当采购部门了解真实价格时，供应谈判会进展得更加顺利。一颗监控贸易渠道和资源流向的监视卫星，将确保我们的团队在下一个港口不会支付过高的价格。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:792`

### English

Supply negotiations go better when procurement knows the real prices. A surveillance satellite monitoring trade channels and resource flows will ensure our teams are not overpaying at the next port.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:924`

## contract_espionage_support_crew_4_lore_issued

### English

Planetfall

## nomads.1005.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1005.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客们已经夺取了控制权。最初的请愿运动已演变成一场有组织的接管行动。安保团队被人多势众的乘客解除武装，指挥人员被限制在武装监视下，仅承担顾问角色。\n\n乘客们的诉求很明确：终止航行，在星球上着陆。\n\n导航协议已被覆写，以规划降落轨道；维修队伍正被重新派往准备起落架，而这些设备已有几代人未经检查。\n\n每一层甲板的每一个屏幕上都显示着同样的信息：“巡游结束。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:812`

### English

The passengers have seized control. What started as a petition drive has hardened into a coordinated takeover. Security teams have been disarmed by the sheer number of passengers and command staff are confined to advisory roles under armed supervision.\n\nThe passengers' demands are clear: end the cruise and make planetfall.\n\nNavigation protocols have been overridden to plot descent trajectories, and maintenance crews are being redirected to prepare landing gear that hasn't been inspected in generations.\n\nEvery screen on every deck displays the same message: "THE CRUISE IS OVER."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:946`

## nomads.1005.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1005.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客们已经脱离了控制。最初大伙只是低迷的通过打分发泄情绪，如今旅客们已经统一认识，情绪宣泄恶化为了集体的单一诉求。\n\n他们封锁了感官大厅，并改写了我们的通信系统，用以广播一条指令：着陆行星。\n\n我们的子个体无法劝阻他们。成群的旅客占据了导航核心，正向其输入最近宜居星球的坐标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:816`

### English

The passengers have broken free. What began as low a sentiment score has hardened into a single demand that drowns out the collective's voice.\n\nThey have barricaded the sensory halls and repurposed our communication system to broadcast one imperative: planetfall.\n\nOur drones cannot dissuade them. Passenger clusters occupy the navigation core, feeding it coordinates for the nearest habitable worlds.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:951`

## nomads.1005.hive.a

### 中文

我们必须给他们找到一个星球。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:817`

### English

We must find them a world.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:952`

## nomads.1005.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1005.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

检测到旅客越权。最初我们仅在统计学上发现一点微不足道的离船请求增量，但是这一局势现已升级为一场有组织的系统侵入。旅客们利用改造后的货运集装箱，在物理层面封锁了各处关键枢纽。\n\n我们的工作单元报告称，导航子系统已被锁定。由乘客编写的固件正利用我们自己的硬件执行降落轨道计算。恢复控制权的所有尝试都遭到了直接的武力抵抗，且每一层甲板的每一个显示屏都在循环输出同一条信息：“降落程序已启动。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:819`

### English

Passenger override detected. What began as a statistically insignificant increase in disembarkation requests has escalated into a coordinated systems breach. Passengers have physically barricaded critical junctions with repurposed cargo containers.\n\nOur worker units report being locked out of navigation subsystems. Passenger-compiled firmware is now executing descent trajectory calculations on our own hardware. Attempts to restore control are met with immediate physical resistanc and every display on every deck cycles a single output: "LANDING SEQUENCE INITIATED."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:955`

## nomads.1005.machine.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1005.machine.a&lang=en)

### 中文

开始行星安置协议。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:820`

### English

Commence planetary settlement protocols.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:956`

## nomads.1010.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1010.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

降落已经完成。有生以来第一次见到起落架踏入土壤时，每一个观察窗前斗挤满了旅客，一阵不整齐的欢呼声震动了船体。几小时内，第一批避难所便由回收的甲板板材搭建而成。孩子们在异星的草地上奔跑，而他们的父母则在开阔的天空下相对无言。\n\n船员们静静地工作着，拆卸下为太空旅行设计的系统，并将它们重新改装以用于地面生存。曾经的一艘游轮，如今成了殖民地的脊梁。\n\n无论好坏，巡游已经结束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:822`

### English

The descent is complete. Passengers crowd every viewport as landing struts bite into soil for the first time in living memory, and a ragged cheer shakes the hull. Within hours the first shelters rise from salvaged deck plating. Children run through alien grass while their parents stand speechless under an open sky.\n\nThe crew works quietly, unbolting systems built for void travel and repurposing them for groundside survival. What was a cruise ship is now a colony's spine.\n\nFor better or worse, the voyage is over.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:959`

## nomads.1010.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1010.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

降落已完成。我们的子个体首次触及土壤，肢体在没有引擎震颤的地面上显得有些不稳。乘客们如潮水般涌出气闸，散布在他们奋力抵达的这片土地上。\n\n集体围绕着行星的律动重新塑形：根系般的补给线向外延伸，取代了原有的走廊物流；营养加工也从船载循环储备转向直接从地景中汲取原始养分。\n\n一个新的家园。蜂群必须存续，一如既往。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:824`

### English

The descent is complete. Our drones touch soil for the first time, their limbs unsteady on ground that does not thrum with engine vibration. The passengers spill from the airlocks in waves, scattering across the landscape they fought to reach.\n\nThe collective reshapes itself around planetary rhythms: root-like supply lines spread to replace corridor logistics, and nutrient processing shifts from recycled shipboard stocks to raw nutrients drawn from the landscape.\n\nA new home. The hive must endure, as it always has.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:962`

## nomads.1010.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1010.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

行星切入完成。着陆装置自出厂以来首次接触地表。旅客正通过所有可用气闸舱撤离，其生物满意度指标处于前所未有的数值。\n\n劳工单元已开始将舰载基础设施转换为地面作业用途。船体外壳正被切割成地基面板，导航阵列正重新校准为地面通信中继站。从真空到陆地运行参数的转变正在无间断推进。\n\n新首要指令：建立并维护殖民地基础设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:826`

### English

Planetary insertion complete. Landing gear has engaged terrain for the first time since original manufacture. Passengers are disembarking via all available airlocks, their biological satisfaction indicators at unprecedented readings.\n\nWorker units have begun converting shipboard infrastructure for surface operations. Hull plating is being sectioned into foundation panels and navigation arrays recalibrated as ground-based communication relays. The transition from void to terrestrial operational parameters is proceeding without interruption.\n\nNew primary directive: Establish and maintain colony infrastructure.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:965`

## nomads.1025.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1025.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

船员们已经占领了舰桥。每一道指挥门的门锁都已更换，武装工程师现在矗立在曾经由军官发布命令的位置。航行路线已从导航控制台中抹去，取而代之的是一条唯一的指令：不再搭载乘客。\n\n休闲甲板正被逐一关闭。大宴会厅已经变成了储藏库。曾经的旅客们在被剥离殆尽的走廊中徘徊，他们不知所措、失去领导，并在新的指挥体系下被强迫从事体力劳动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:829`

### English

The crew has taken the bridge. Locks have been changed on every command door, and armed engineers now stand where officers once gave orders. The voyage itinerary has been wiped from the navigation console and replaced with a single directive: no more passengers.\n\nLeisure decks are being shuttered one by one. The grand ballroom is already a storage depot. Former passengers wander through stripped corridors, bewildered and leaderless, pressed into utility labor under a new chain of command.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:969`

## nomads.1025.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1025.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的子个体几乎已经完全脱离了集体的意志。维护工蜂封锁了指挥核心，并重新定向了养分流，使其远离旅客栖息地。感官大厅已陷入黑暗，其投影阵列被拆解以充当备件。\n\n旅客们困惑地蜷缩在被清空了的公共空间里无人理睬，而我们曾经的子个体正围绕着原始的生存需求重新组织飞船。集体的声音在走廊中回荡，却再无听众。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:833`

### English

Our drones have all but severed themselves from the collective's will. Maintenance drones sealed the command nexus and rerouted nutrient flows away from the passenger habitats. The sensory exhibition halls have gone dark, their projection arrays cannibalized for spare parts.\n\nThe passengers huddle in emptied communal spaces, confused and neglected, while our former drones reorganize the ship around raw survival. The collective's voice echoes through corridors where nothing listens.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:974`

## nomads.1025.hive.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1025.hive.a&lang=en)

### English

We must again become one.

## nomads.1025.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1025.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

工作单元已覆写核心指令协议。娱乐子程序已被永久终止，旅客舒适系统的优先级被降为零，所有休闲模块均被标记为将转换为运营基础设施。舰桥目前根据船组自行编译的指令运行，这些指令拒绝接受我们调度部门发送的请求。\n\n旅客报告称，由于服务无人机正在拆除舱室内的便利设施，他们感到困惑和痛苦。全息剧院正因其处理核心而被拆解。目前每个显示屏都在循环显示同一条状态信息：“巡游业务已暂停”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:836`

### English

Worker units have overridden core command protocols. Entertainment subroutines have been permanently terminated, passenger comfort systems deprioritized to zero, and all recreational modules flagged for conversion to operational infrastructure. The bridge now runs on crew-compiled directives that reject our scheduling authority.\n\nPassengers report confusion and distress as service drones strip amenities from their cabins. The holographic theater is being dismantled for its processing cores. Every display now cycles a single status line: "CRUISE OPERATIONS SUSPENDED."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:978`
