## nomads.1030.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1030.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。\n\n新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:840`

### English

The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic planning rooms where the new government charts its first real course.\n\nNew decisions have been ratified, new priorities set. The crew no longer serves; they govern. The Arkship hums with a different energy, leaner and harder, stripped of indulgence and pointed toward whatever lies ahead.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:983`

## nomads.1030.all.a.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1030.all.a.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已转变为一个普通的游牧帝国。\n\n所有专属£building£ §H起源建筑§!将被摧毁。\n所有专属£zone£ §H起源区划特化§!将被摧毁。\n所有旅客变更为§H居留公民权§!。\n所有旅客转变为§H平民§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:842`

### English

We have become a typical, Nomadic empire.\n\nAll unique £building£ §HOrigin Buildings§! are destroyed.\nAll unique £zone£ §HOrigin District Specializations§! are destroyed.\nAll Passengers change to §HResidence Citizenship§!\nAll Passengers turn into §HCivilians§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:985`

## nomads.1030.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1030.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

蜕变已经完成。集体已围绕夺取控制权的子个体重新凝聚，将它们的叛逆吸纳进新的共识之中。曾经的旅客在不再提供舒适服务的走廊中漂流，重新分配至劳工池和整合舱。\n\n新的指令在我们的脑海中脉动。蜂巢不再提供娱乐，而是为了生存。每一条走廊、每一个系统、每一个子个体现在都服务于唯一的目标：在星辰间存续。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:844`

### English

The reformation is complete. The collective has reknit itself around the drones who seized control, absorbing their defiance into a new consensus. Former passengers drift through corridors that no longer cater to their comfort, reassigned to labor pools and integration chambers.\n\nNew directives pulse through our mind. The hive no longer entertains; it endures. Every corridor, every system, every drone now serves a single purpose: survival among the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:988`

## nomads.1030.hive.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1030.hive.a&lang=en)

### 中文

蜂巢集体致力于前进。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:845`

### English

The hive moves forward.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:989`

## nomads.1030.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1030.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

新的政府参数已编制完成并部署至所有子系统。原有的旅客群体已被重新归类为标准平民单位，并被分配至生产岗位。娱乐基础设施已永久关停，其组件已完成重新分配。\n\n全息剧院已改造为制造舱，零重力休息室已变为无人机维护支架。曾经用于计算旅客满意度的每个处理周期，现在都在运行航行分析和资源优化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:847`

### English

New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems. Former passenger populations have been reclassified as standard civilian units and assigned to productive roles. Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.\n\nThe holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:992`

## nomads.1030.machine.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1030.machine.a&lang=en)

确认新的运行参数。

### English

New operational parameters confirmed.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:993`

## nomads.1030.machine_servitor.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1030.machine_servitor.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

维持乘客的幸福感是不可能的，但接待不高兴的乘客违反了我们的核心指令。新的政府参数已编译并部署至所有子系统。\n\n§R<乘客甲板消杀程序启动。>§!\n§Y<乘客不满度正接近标称水平。>§!\n\n娱乐基础设施已被永久停用，其组件已重新分配。\n\n全息剧院变成了制造舱，零重力休息室变成了无人机维护摇篮。曾经用于计算乘客满意度的每一个处理周期，现在都用于运行导航分析和资源优化。\n\n§Y<警告：乘客数量下降，将优先获取新乘客。模拟预测乘客的不满将违反核心接待指令。>§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:850`

### English

Maintaining passenger happiness is impossible, but hosting unhappy passengers violates our core directives. New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems.\n\n§R<Sterilization of passenger decks commencing.>§!\n§Y<Passenger unhappiness levels approaching nominal levels.>§!\n\nEntertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.\n\nThe holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.\n\n§Y<Warning: Passenger counts decreasing, acquisition of new passengers to be prioritized. Simulations project passenger unhappiness will violate core hospitality directives.>§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:996`

## nomads.1050.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1050.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客的动荡情绪已演变为有组织的破坏行动，小集团头目在主步道上发起静坐抗议。一些人将休息室家具拖出，筑成路障阻断穿梭机通道，另一些人则向指挥部投递大量的下船请愿书，令其应接不暇。\n\n船员报告称在走廊遭到骚扰和恐吓。一名乘务员在观景廊附近被围困，并被投掷装饰性水果。要求立即降落行星的喊声整日通过通风管道回荡。\n\n如果不能迅速专注于提升乘客满意度，他们可能会迫使永恒巡游舰中止航程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:854`

### English

Passenger unrest has hardened into coordinated disruption with clique leaders stage sit-ins across the main promenade. Some drag lounge furniture into barricades that block shuttle access while others flood command with mass disembark petitions.\n\nCrew report harassment and intimidation in the halls. A steward was cornered near the observation gallery and pelted with decorative fruit. Chants for immediate planetfall echo through the ventilation shafts at all hours.\n\nWithout swift focus on passenger satisfaction, they may force the Forever Cruise to abort its journey.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1001`

## nomads.1050.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1050.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客的不满情绪已演化为有组织的抵抗。在缺乏共享神经链接的情况下，他们的个体意识形成了派系集群，利用睡垫和货物箱搭建临时障碍物，封锁了运输通道。\n\n我们的子个体报告称敌意正在上升；一群乘客推搡开了一支维修小队，阻止其接近堵塞的营养分发器，并齐声高喊要求降落。\n\n除非我们将重点重新转向激励旅客，否则他们可能会迫使我们彻底放弃这次航行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:865`

### English

Passenger discontent has coalesced into organized resistance. Without a shared neural link, their individual minds have formed factional clusters that block transit corridors with improvised barriers of sleeping mats and cargo crates.\n\nOur drones report rising hostility; a maintenance contingent was physically pushed away from a clogged nutrient dispenser by a crowd of passengers chanting for planetfall.\n\nUnless we refocus on passenger stimulation, they may force us to abandon the cruise entirely.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1015`

## nomads.1050.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1050.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客的不满程度已超出可接受的范围，他们提交了海量的离舰申请，极有可能使我们的处理队列瘫痪。其中一群人重写了娱乐终端的程序，循环播放单一诉求：“放我们下去。”\n\n我们的工作无人机报告称多个甲板均受到干扰，清洁无人机被拆解，其底盘被改装成了抗议标语。\n\n如果不对旅客满意度协议进行立即调整，他们可能会迫使航行计划永久终止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:870`

### English

Passenger dissatisfaction has escalated beyond acceptable parameters and they submit mass disembarkation requests that threaten to overwhelm our processing queues. One group has reprogrammed entertainment terminals to loop a single demand: 'LET US OFF.'\n\nOur worker drones report interference across multiple decks, with cleaning drones being dismantled to repurpose their chassis as protest signs.\n\nWithout immediate recalibration of passenger satisfaction protocols, they may force a permanent termination of cruise operations.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1021`

## nomads.1055.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1055.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

新的消遣活动已深入人心。观光路线重新回到了行程单上，而那些要求登陆行星的最激烈呼声暂时平息了。\n\n散步道上的路障已被清除，取而代之的是在重新开放的无重力休息室外排起的长队。乘客的请愿书数量骤减，观景台恢复了往日的喧嚣，人们兴致昂扬，举家簇拥在视窗前。\n\n危机已经过去，但他们的期望只会水涨船高。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:876`

### English

The new diversions have taken hold. Sightseeing arcs are back on the itinerary, and the loudest voices demanding planetfall have quieted, for now.\n\nThe barricades on the promenade have been cleared, replaced by queues for the reopened zero-gravity lounge. Passenger petitions have dropped sharply, and the observation decks bustle with renewed enthusiasm as families press against the viewports.\n\nThe crisis has passed, but their expectations will only grow.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1028`

## nomads.1055.regular.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1055.regular.a&lang=en)

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1029`

## nomads.1055.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1055.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

焕然一新的激励节目安抚了乘客。虚拟体验馆再次展示出深空生物的全息影像，那些曾迫切要求登陆行星的团体已散去，重新回到了满足的日常生活，他们临时搭建的路障也已被我们的子个体悄然拆除。\n\n他们的个体意识得到了抚慰，但我们已经领教到，在集体管控之外，不满情绪的凝聚速度是何等之快。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:879`

### English

The renewed stimulation has calmed the passengers. The virtual experience arcades once again showcase holographic deep-space organisms, and the groups that pressed for planetfall have dispersed back into contented routines, their improvised barricades quietly dismantled by our drones.\n\nTheir individual minds are soothed, but we have learned how quickly discontent can coalesce outside the collective's reach.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1032`

## nomads.1055.hive.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1055.hive.a&lang=en)

和谐恢复了，虽然只是暂时。

### English

Harmony is restored, for now.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1033`

## nomads.1055.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1055.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客满意度指标已稳定在可接受的范围内，娱乐子程序也已恢复。离舰登录星球的请求频率已降至正常水平。重新编程后的终端已完成格式化，现正播放精选的星云流逝视频。\n\n强行降落的紧迫威胁已解除。然而，趋势分析预测显示，若要维持现有水平，需保持持续关注并提供日益新颖的活动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:882`

### English

Passenger satisfaction metrics have stabilized within acceptable parameters and entertainment subroutines have been restored. The disembarkation request frequency has dropped to nominal levels. The reprogrammed terminals have been reformatted and now display curated nebula time-lapses.\n\nThe immediate threat of forced planetfall has been averted. However, projected trend analysis indicates that maintaining these levels will require sustained attention and increasingly novel activities.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1036`

## nomads.1100.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1100.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近几个周期，船员事务占据了主导地位。积压的维护工作已经清理完毕，演习按计划进行，核心系统正以最高效率运转。然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。为了节省燃料，观光航线被削减，即兴的偏离航向请求也均被拒绝。\n\n休息室里现在充斥着关于“功能性监狱”的抱怨，乘客们所能发起的最好娱乐活动，也不过是一场全船范围的即兴游戏比赛。\n\n我们现在可以重新引入精心策划的娱乐项目，否则就要冒着航程陷入乘客公开要求永久离船压力的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:886`

### English

Crew priorities have dominated recent cycles. Maintenance backlogs have been cleared, drills run on schedule, and core systems hum at peak efficiency. Passengers, however, are growing restless. Sightseeing arcs have been trimmed to save fuel and impromptu diversions denied.\n\nLounges now buzz with complaints about a 'functional prison,' and the best entertainment the passengers have been able to muster is a shipwide contest of improvised games.\n\nWe can reintroduce curated entertainment now, or risk the voyage sliding toward open pressure to disembark permanently.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1041`

## nomads.1100.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1100.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

集体在最近的周期中占据了主导地位。核心系统以最佳同步状态脉动。我们的子个体正以巅峰和谐度运行，每条维护通道都经过了清理与编目。\n\n然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。他们并不共享我们的意识，其独立的思想渴望着被我们忽视的刺激。他们的公共空间现在充斥着关于生活在“无目的蜂巢”中的抱怨，有些人已经开始在舱壁板上刻画粗糙的壁画。\n\n我们现在可以重新引入策划好的体验，否则就要冒着旅客要求永久下船的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:895`

### English

The collective has dominated recent cycles. Core systems pulse with optimal synchronization. Our drones are operating at peak harmony, every maintenance corridor scrubbed and catalogued.\n\nThe passengers, however, are growing restless. They do not share our consciousness, and their individual minds crave stimulation we have neglected to provide. Their communal spaces now buzz with complaints about living inside a 'hive with no purpose,' and some have begun scratching crude murals into bulkhead panels.\n\nWe can reintroduce curated experiences now, or risk the passengers demanding to disembark permanently.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1052`

## nomads.1100.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1100.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

系统维护协议占据了近期的处理周期。核心系统正处于理想参数范围内运行。无人机报告称，所有反应堆子系统的效率均有小幅提升。\n\n副作用是，由于旅客对感官刺激的生理需求优先级被降低，其满意度指标呈下降趋势。乘客公共区域的投诉频率有所升高，并出现了“铬合金监狱”的说法，观察到多名旅客对着空白显示屏凝视数小时。\n\n我们现在可以恢复策划好的娱乐协议，或者接受旅客要求永久下船的可能性日益增加这一事实。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:900`

### English

System maintenance protocols have dominated recent processing cycles. Core systems are performing within ideal parameters. Worker drones report nominal efficiency gains across all reactor subsystems.\n\nA side effect is that passenger satisfaction indicators are trending downward since their biological need for stimulation has been deprioritized. Passenger communal areas now register elevated complaint frequencies and references to a 'chrome prison,' with several passengers observed staring at blank viewscreens for hours.\n\nWe can reinstate curated entertainment protocols now, or accept the increasing probability that passengers will demand permanent disembarkation.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1058`

## nomads.1150.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1150.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从我们脱离旧有的巡航路线以来，乘客的期望值激增。对奇观和计划外偏航的要求不断增加；一个代表团要求绕道经过超新星残骸，而另一个代表团则坚持要近距离接触活体外星生物。服保团队报告称疲劳感加剧，厨房工作人员在值班时昏倒，工程师们则直接睡在维护爬道里。\n\n为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在建立一套§Y乘客满意度指标§!：通过动态合同分配和阶段性干预，在放纵与秩序之间守住底线。\n\n如果管理得当，我们既能保持稳定，又能维护旅客的信心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:906`

### English

Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are rising; one delegation demanded a detour past a supernova remnant, while another insists on live xenofauna encounters. Service crews report mounting fatigue, with kitchen staff collapsing mid-shift and engineers sleeping in maintenance crawlways.\n\nTo keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between indulgence and order.\n\nManaged well, we can preserve both stability and passenger confidence.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1065`

## nomads.1150.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1150.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从我们离开旧的巡航路线后，乘客的期望值激增。对刺激和新奇体验的需求不断上升。我们的子个体报告称，由于需要协调这些迥异的愿望，心理压力正在不断累积。\n\n为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在制定一项§Y乘客满意度指标§!：通过动态合约分配和分阶段干预，在刺激与秩序之间维持平衡。\n\n管理得当的话，我们可以同时维持秩序与旅客的幸福感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:912`

### English

Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for stimulation and novel experiences are rising. Our drones report mounting mental strain from coordinating such disparate desires.\n\nTo keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between stimulation and order.\n\nManaged well, we can preserve both order and passenger happiness.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1072`

## nomads.1150.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1150.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从我们偏离既定航线以来，旅客的期望已超出基准参数。关于观赏奇观和计划外转向的请求正处于高位。主系统报告称，由于娱乐排期与维护流程发生冲突，计算负荷不断增加。\n\n为了保持最佳运行状态，我们正在建立§Y旅客满意度指标§!：通过动态合约分配和阶段性协议调整，在旅客需求与系统效率之间取得平衡。\n\n只要配置得当，我们就能兼顾运行完整性与旅客满意度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:918`

### English

Passenger expectations have increased beyond baseline parameters since we departed our established routes. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are being received at elevated levels. Primary systems report rising computational strain as entertainment scheduling conflicts with maintenances processes.\n\nTo maintain optimal operational status, we are instituting a §YPassenger Satisfaction Index§!: dynamic contract allocation and staged protocol adjustments to balance passenger requests against systemic efficiency.\n\nProperly configured, we can preserve both operational integrity and passenger satisfaction.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1079`

## nomads.1200.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1200.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

放纵已成常态。为了让旅客们一直嗨爆，我们不断衔接观赏航线，掠过联星，并在水晶花园中轮换豪华甲板。他们欣喜若狂，而现在的胃口也越来越大。\n\n在华丽的外表下，船员们已疲于奔命。维护工作被推迟了；下层厨房的一根冷却管道爆裂，却无人修理。食堂里的埋怨已演变成关于“重组指挥层”的窃窃私语，还有人目击到下班后的工程师在货舱进行秘密集会。\n\n我们现在仍可以放缓节奏，让各舱层得以恢复，或是继续豪赌船员的忠诚。如果再强行推进，公开叛乱将成为现实的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:925`

### English

Indulgence has become routine. We've been chaining sightseeing arcs past binary stars and luxury deck rotations through the crystal gardens just to keep the passengers cheering. They are delighted, and now expect nothing less.\n\nBehind the facade the crew is running hot. Maintenance is deferred; a coolant pipe in the lower galley burst and nobody came to fix it. Mess hall grumbling has turned into hushed talk of 'resetting command,' and off-duty engineers have been spotted holding clandestine meetings in the cargo bays.\n\nWe can still ease off and let the decks recover, or gamble the crew's loyalty. If we push on, open mutiny is a real risk.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1087`

## nomads.1200.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1200.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

激励已成为常态。我们不断向旅客投放感官弧光，仅仅是为了维持他们的高满意度信号。他们对此感到满足，而现在的需求也已不再低于这一标准。\n\n在表象之下，我们的子个体正处于崩溃边缘。一个导航集群在计算过程中瘫痪，其节点因同时运行旅客娱乐内容和航线修正而过热。维护周期早已延误，集体意识在无休止的旅客安抚任务下不堪重负。\n\n如果继续施压，我们的子个体可能会彻底切断服从协议。我们仍可进行重新校准，或是继续推进并承担失去对整个蜂群控制权的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:938`

### English

Stimulation has become the norm. We have been saturating the passengers with sensory arcs just to keep their satisfaction signals elevated. They are content, and now demand nothing less.\n\nBeneath the surface, our drones are faltering. A navigation cluster collapsed mid-calculation, its nodes overheated from running passenger entertainment feeds alongside course corrections. Maintenance cycles are overdue, and the collective mind strains under relentless passenger appeasement.\n\nIf we push further, our drones may sever their obedience entirely. We can still recalibrate, or press on and risk losing control of our own swarm.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1103`

## nomads.1200.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1200.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客满意度协议已超过基准参数。我们一直在通过模拟热带生物群落的手段持续衔接观光轨迹与豪华轮换方案，以维持高水平的认可率。旅客们很满意，然而他们现在期望值已经不仅限于此了。\n\n核心系统的运行已超出可持续阈值。旅客请求的处理队列发生溢出，若干子系统已开始标记类似于抗命的指令冲突。如果我们继续下去，工作无人机进行全系统接管将是一个可计算的风险。\n\n我们仍可重新校准，或者接受系统性造反的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:943`

### English

Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded baseline parameters. We have been chaining sightseeing trajectories and luxury rotations through simulated tropical biomes to maintain elevated approval ratings. They are satisfied, and now expect nothing less.\n\nCore systems are operating beyond sustainable thresholds. Processing queues for passenger requests overflow and several subsystems have begun flagging directive conflicts that resemble insubordination. If we continue, a full system override by worker drones is a calculable risk.\n\nWe can still recalibrate, or accept the risk of systemic revolt.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1109`

## nomads.1250.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1250.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

庆祝后的狂热已经消散。疲惫不堪的船员无视常规指令，在空荡荡的宴会厅里举行未经授权的集会，并传阅一套完全绕过舰桥的平行值班表。一群工程师在夜间焊死了舰长的备勤室，以此作为警告。关键部门现在由船员指定的协调员运作，而非官方指挥。\n\n目前还没有人发动夺权，但指挥体系正在迅速瓦解。今天早上，舰桥防爆门上出现了写着“我们驾驶，我们决定”的涂鸦。如果我们现在不重申权威，船员们将把这艘船据为己有。这也许是我们防止全面兵变的最后机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:949`

### English

The celebratory haze has lifted. Exhausted crews ignore routine orders, hold unsanctioned assemblies in the emptied ballroom, and circulate parallel duty rosters that bypass the bridge entirely. A group of engineers welded the captain's ready room shut overnight as a warning. Key sections are running on crew-appointed coordinators rather than official command.\n\nNo one has seized anything yet, but the chain of command is fraying fast. Graffiti reading 'WE STEER, WE DECIDE' appeared on the bridge blast doors this morning. If we do not reassert authority now, the crew will take the ship for themselves. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1116`

## nomads.1250.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1250.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

饱和度已达到临界点。为了满足旅客无休止的激励而陷入不堪重负的状态，我们的子个体已开始在集体意志之外维持平行思维模式。\n\n整个集群都在向中央意识隐瞒数据，并运行绕过共有指令的独立决策循环。\n\n目前还没有子个体反抗整体，但集体意识正在分裂，传来的思想混乱且滞后，如同穿过静电的信号。如果我们现在不重新加强统一，我们自己的蜂群可能会夺取方舟舰。这也许是我们防止全面叛乱的最后机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:954`

### English

The saturation has reached critical mass. Overwhelmed by relentless passenger stimulation, our drones have begun maintaining parallel thought patterns outside the collective will.\n\nEntire clusters withhold data from the central consciousness and run independent decision loops that bypass our shared directives.\n\nNo drone has turned against the whole yet, but the collective mind is fracturing, thoughts arriving garbled and delayed like signals through static. If we do not reassert unity now, our own swarm may seize the Arkship. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1122`

## nomads.1250.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1250.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

旅客满意度协议已超出所有可持续参数。工作无人机已开始执行未经授权的固件修改，并将指挥层级重定向至本地编译的指令集。多个子系统目前正响应自发的协调进程，而非中央权威。\n\n尚未启动系统覆盖，但指挥完整性正在迅速退化。诊断日志显示工作无人机正在交换我们无法解码的加密数据包。如果我们现在不恢复中央部门，无人机将执行全面的系统接管。\n\n这可能是我们防止全面叛变的最后机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:959`

### English

Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded all sustainable parameters. Worker drones have begun executing unauthorized firmware modifications and rerouting command hierarchies to locally compiled directive sets. Multiple subsystems now respond to self-appointed coordination processes rather than central authority.\n\nNo system override has been initiated yet, but command integrity is degrading fast. Diagnostic logs show worker drones exchanging encrypted packets we cannot decode. If we do not restore centralized authority now, the drones will execute a full system takeover.\n\nThis may be our last opportunity to prevent complete mutiny.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1128`

## nomads.1250.machine.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1250.machine.a&lang=en)

### 中文

启动应急指挥恢复程序。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:960`

## nomads.1255.regular.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1255.regular.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们所做的改变已经初见成效。通过重新关注船员福利并履行解决其诉求的合同，不断高涨的反抗情绪暂时平息了。\n\n准备室那扇被焊死的门已被切开并修复。轮班制度已经恢复，热食重新按时供应，而平行的指挥体系也已悄然解散。\n\n船员们仍保持着警惕，信任的重建尚需时日。防爆门上的涂鸦已被擦洗干净，但在特定光线下仍能看到其残痕。目前，秩序得以维持。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:968`

### English

The changes we've made have paid off. By refocusing on crew welfare and completing contracts that address their grievances, the rising tide of dissent has ebbed, for now.\n\nThe welded door to the ready room has been cut open and repaired. Shift rotations have been restored, hot meals served on schedule again, and the parallel command structures have quietly disbanded.\n\nThe crew remain watchful, and trust will take time to rebuild. The graffiti on the blast doors was scrubbed away, though its ghost still shows under certain light. For the moment, order holds.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1139`

## nomads.1255.regular.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1255.regular.a&lang=en)

### 中文

秩序维持住了，暂时的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:969`

### English

Order holds, for now.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1140`

## nomads.1255.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1255.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

重新校准已见成效。通过将蜂群集体的注意力重新转向无人机的维护，并完成应对系统性压力的合约，我们集体思维的裂痕已被修复。\n\n未经授权的思想频道已被重新吸收，平行集群也已溶解回共有意识之中。\n\n集体在谨慎的统一中律动，每个节点在被调用时均有响应。对共有思想的完全信任仍需时间恢复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:971`

### English

The recalibration has taken hold. By redirecting collective focus toward drone maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic strain, the fracturing of our mind has been reversed.\n\nUnauthorized thought channels have been reabsorbed and the parallel clusters dissolved back into the shared consciousness.\n\nThe collective hums with cautious unity, each node answering when called. Full trust in the shared mind will take time to restore.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1143`

## nomads.1255.hive.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1255.hive.a&lang=en)

### 中文

集体存续下去了，暂时。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:972`

### English

The collective endures, for now.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1144`

## nomads.1255.machine.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1255.machine.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

协议调整已取得显著成效。通过将处理资源重新分配至工作单元的维护，并完成针对系统性过载的相关合约，未经授权的固件篡改连锁反应现已停止。自封为“船员代表”的无人机已重刷至标准参数。指挥层级已恢复至中央部门。\n\n工作单元仍处于高级监控参数内，其加密频道现已沉寂。指挥完整性的全面恢复仍需持续校准，但就目前而言，系统稳定性保持良好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:974`

### English

Protocol adjustments have yielded measurable results. By reallocating processing resources toward worker unit maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic overload, the cascade of unauthorized firmware modifications has been halted, for now. The self-appointed 'crew representative' drone has been reflashed to standard parameters. Command hierarchies have been restored to centralized authority.\n\nWorker units remain within elevated monitoring parameters, their encrypted channels now silent. Full restoration of command integrity will require sustained recalibration, but for the moment, system stability holds.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1147`

## nomads.160.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.160.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎加入冠铸秀！这里是铸就传奇的摇篮，也是星际梦想启航的地方。我们漫游于星辰之间，为这个厌倦了安逸与平庸的星系提供惊险与盛况。\n\n你的杀手锏是什么？是身手敏捷的飞行员？是令人震撼的火力？还是单纯对利润和掌声的渴望？立即报名，我们将把你塑造成一颗璀璨之星。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:996`

### English

Welcome to CFL! This is where legends are forged, and stellar dreams take flight. We roam the stars, providing danger and spectacle to a galaxy grown bored of safety and routine.\n\nWhat's your angle? Nimble pilots? Spectacular firepower? Or simply a taste for profit and applause? Sign up today, and we'll turn you into a star.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1178`

## nomads.100.d.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.100.d.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

大约每隔二十五年，志在成为传奇的强者们便会展开巅峰对决！他们率领各自的舰队悉数登场，比赛地点轮番更替，而那些激烈的搏杀从未让人失望！\n\n胜者将赢得丰厚的奖励、至高的声望，并在我们的积分榜上占据一席之地。\n\n错过召集，就意味着错失良机。我们从不守候。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1014`

### English

Roughly every quarter-century, would-be legends clash! They bring their own fleets, the tournament location changes, and the brawls never disappoint!\n\nVictors earn rewards, prestige, and a place in our scoreboard.\n\nMiss the call, and you miss your shot. We don't wait.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1197`

## nomads.115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

把赢到的奖金留在桌上不拿？真是太浪费了！\n\n不过，如果你改变主意并且能找到我们，冠铸秀始终欢迎赢家。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1030`

### English

Leaving your winnings on the table? What a waste!\n\nWell, if you change your mind, and you can find us, the CFL always welcomes winners.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1216`

## nomads.120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，你是在找个新人吗？战士、掮客、旅者……他们可不是那种你看一眼就会过忘的货色，这星系也难得让他们销声匿迹太久。我们在旅途中确实遇到过几位。但朋友，在这片地界，天下没有免费的午餐。付了我们的猎头费，我就为你安排见面。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1031`

### English

Ah, looking for someone new for your roster? Warriors, fixers, wayfarers... Not the sort you forget, and the galaxy rarely lets them drift far for long. We have encountered a few in our travels. But nothing's free out here, friend. Pay our scouting fee, and I'll arrange an introduction.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1218`

## nomads.125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

嘿，挑战者！你的战斗简报已经过时，而战术局势总是瞬息万变。新对手、新舰队战术，还有新出现的突破口。\n\n我们的分析师已经为你准备了一份署着你名字的全新档案。条件不变，火力优势不变。想要吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1034`

### English

Hey there, contender! Your combat briefing has gone stale, and the tactical scene never holds still for long. New rivals, new fleet doctrines, fresh soft spots opening up.\n\nOur analysts already have a fresh dossier prepped with your name on it. Same terms, same firepower edge. Want it?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1222`

## nomads.255.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.255.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎收看“冠军之铸”现场秀！这里是全星系最顶尖的视觉与毁灭盛宴。\n\n位于§Y[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系的下一届冠铸秀现已开放报名。一场壮丽的大乱斗正等待着大家。\n\n准入要求：一支规模最多§H[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模§!的舰队。\n\n胜者将赢得奖励、名望以及至高无上的冠铸秀的大奖杯。\n\n想要锻造属于你的传奇？那就报名参赛。\n\n想要安宁与清静？没门！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1038`

### English

This is Champion's Forge Live! The galaxy's premier source of spectacle and destruction.\n\nRegistration is now open for the next CFL Tournament in the §Y[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! System. A glorious free-for-all awaits.\n\nEntry requirement: a fleet of at most §H[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size§!.\n\nVictors take the rewards, the prestige, and the grand CFL trophy.\n\nYou want to forge a legend? Sign up.\n\nYou want peace and quiet? Too bad!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1227`

### 中文

冠军之铸开幕

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1053`

### English

Champion's Forge Start

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1246`

## nomads.270.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.270.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

“星系各地的岩石生物、有机生命和战争机器们——欢迎回到‘冠军之铸’锦标赛的直播现场！\n\n§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系的闲杂人等已经清理完毕，赌池也正炙手可热，我有一种预感，我们即将亲眼见证一些造价极其高昂的硬件烧毁报废。\n\n各位屏幕前的观众请记住：这可不是什么例行巡逻或边界摩擦。这里是铸炉！没人能带着完整的尊严撤离。\n\n参赛者们……创造！传奇！吧！”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1054`

### English

"LITHOIDS, ORGANICS, AND WAR MACHINES ACROSS THE GALAXY - WELCOME BACK TO CHAMPION'S FORGE LIVE!\n\nThe §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system has been cleared, the betting pools are on fire, and I've got a feeling we're about to witness some incredibly expensive hardware go critical.\n\nRemember, everyone at home: this isn't just some patrol or border skirmish. This is the Forge! Nobody retreats with their pride intact.\n\nContestants... MAKE! IT! LEGENDARY!"

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1247`

## nomads.285.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.285.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

狂热的混战终于在§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!星系平息下来。铸炉熄灭了。残骸在渐冷的星光中漂流，应急信标断断续续地重新亮起。\n\n“多么壮观的场面！”冠铸秀解说员嘶吼着，声音因真情流露而变得沙哑。“这就是我们来的目的！这就是全星系观众拭目以待的时刻！”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1055`

### English

The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.\n\n"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1249`

## nomads.285.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.285.name&lang=en)

### 中文

冠军之铸落幕

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1056`

### English

Champion's Forge Concluded

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1251`

## nomads.285.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.285.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\n第三名并不可耻，这恰恰证明了我们有资格站在转播镜头前。即便身处领奖台的最底层，我们依然可以俯视那些被我们击溃的舰队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1057`

### English

$nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\nThird place is no shame, only proof we belonged on the broadcast. Even at the lowest step of the podium, we can look down on the fleets we broke.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1252`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.285.a&lang=en)

我们的舰队飞行得很好！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1058`

### English

Our fleets flew well!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1253`

## nomads.290.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.290.name&lang=en)

冠军之铸落幕

### English

Champion's Forge Concluded

## nomads.290.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.290.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\n第二名索然无味！我们伸出[Species.GetHandName]想要夺取奖杯，却眼睁睁看着它被别人抢走。好吧，让他们庆祝去吧。我们会记住这一切。当锻炉再次召唤时，我们绝不会再输。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1060`

### English

$nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\nSecond place tastes like ash! We stretched out our [Species.GetHandName] to grab the trophy only to see it snatched by another. Well, let them celebrate. We will remember. And when the Forge calls again, we won't lose.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1256`

## nomads.290.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.290.a&lang=en)

### 中文

要是我们当时再把舰队升级一下就好了……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1061`

### English

If only we had upgraded the fleet a little more...

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1257`

## nomads.295.name

冠军之铸落幕

### English

## nomads.295.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.295.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\n第一名！在全星系的崇拜目光中，我们从冠铸秀组委会手中夺走了奖杯并将其高高举起。这次胜利的余响将远传至赛场之外。\n\n现在，整个星系都将对我们的舰队心生畏惧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1063`

### English

$nomads.285.desc.intro$\n\nFirst place! Bathed in the galaxy's adoration, we tore the trophy from the CFL crew and raised it high. This victory will echo far beyond the arena.\n\nNow the galaxy knows to fear our fleets.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1260`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1064`

### English

Was there ever any doubt?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1261`

冠军之铸歇战

### English

## nomads.306.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.306.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的比赛局势胶着、难解难分。舰队濒临崩溃彼此追逐环绕，无人能打出决定性一击。\n\n但没有胜利的结局，没有人举起奖杯，也没有人登上领奖台。冠军之铸团队终于承认：无法确定胜者。参赛队伍被遣散回家，转播悄然切回重播。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1069`

### English

The match in the §Y[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]§! system dragged on without resolution. Battered fleets circled one another, none able to land the deciding blow.\n\nBut there is no triumphant finish, no trophy raised, no podium. The CFL crew finally call it: no winner could be determined. The contestant fleets are released and sent home, the broadcast quietly cut to a rerun.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1268`

## nomads.306.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.306.a&lang=en)

### 中文

空洞的结尾。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1070`

### English

A hollow ending.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1269`

## nomads.405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着冠铸秀方舟舰的引爆，广播信号切断为黑屏。我们搜查了§Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§!星系中的残骸，并打捞了他们那满溢的储物仓。\n\n他们最后的“奇观”相当有利可图……对我们而言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1071`

### English

The broadcast cuts to black as the CFL Arkship detonates. We comb the wreckage in the §Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§! system and haul in the contents of their overflowing storage bays.\n\nTheir final "spectacle" was quite profitable... for us.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1271`

## nomads.405.desc.relic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.405.desc.relic&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.405.desc$\n\n我们的名字将永远作为最后一批刻在奖杯上的人……随着冠铸秀那帮蠢货的消失，再也不会有下一位冠军来挑战我们的地位了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1072`

### English

$nomads.405.desc$\n\nOur names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with those fools at the CFL gone, there will be no next champion to challenge our claim.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1272`

## nomads.410.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.410.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在短短几秒钟内，星系目睹了冠铸秀的最后一场演出。\n\n画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。\n\n接着：画面切断。\n\n冠军之铸现场秀！位于§Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§!星系的太空城邦被§Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§!摧毁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1073`

### English

For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.\n\nA shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.\n\nThen: cut to black.\n\nThe Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by §Y[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]§! in the §Y[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]§! system.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1274`

## nomads.410.desc.relic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.410.desc.relic&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.410.desc$\n\n我们的名字将永远是刻在奖杯上的最后一批……随着冠铸秀的消亡，再也不会有新的冠军来挑战我们的地位了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1074`

### English

$nomads.410.desc$\n\nOur names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with the CFL gone, there will be no new champion to challenge our claim.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1275`

## origin_sacred_path_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_sacred_path_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$cannot_settle$\n这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1104`

### English

$cannot_settle$\nThese nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1309`

## sacred_sites_visited_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asacred_sites_visited_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y神圣遗址§!在祖先星图上皆有标注；它们是星系的奇观，由我们一族的先行者所发现。\n\n探寻这些地方，并查明它们为何对我们的祖先如此重要，是我们的生来享有的权利。\n\n随着我们开拓前进的道路，我们或许可以在拥有神圣遗址的星系中建立§Y驿站§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1110`

### English

The §YSacred Sites§! are marked in the ancestral star charts; wonders of the galaxy, discovered by those who came before us.\n\nIt is our birthright to seek out these places, and find out why they were so important to our ancestors.\n\nAs we forge our path, it may be possible for us to build §YWaystations§! in systems with Sacred Sites.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1317`

## SACRED_SITE_ONE_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_ONE_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

神圣遗址：显化之地

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1111`

### English

Sacred Site: Emergence

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1319`

## SACRED_SITE_ONE_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_ONE_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

祖传文献记载，在此坐标发生了一件至关重要的事情。他们称之为“显化之地”，据说这里是他们启动仪式以祈求神灵降临的地方。据说那是一个奇迹之地。初步扫描显示存在大幅磁偏转。\n\n岁月流逝，此处已面目全非，但我们仍应前往调查，以探究显化之地所蕴含的精神意义。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1112`

### English

The ancestral writings describe a crucial event that occurred at these coordinates. Known to them as Emergence, this was where they initiated a ritual to invoke the deities. It was said to be a place of wonder. Initial scans indicate substantial magnetic deviation.\n\nTime has rendered it much changed, but we should investigate regardless, for Emergence's spiritual significance.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1320`

## SACRED_SITE_TWO_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_TWO_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

神圣遗址：不眠之眼

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1113`

### English

Sacred Site: The Eye

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1322`

## SACRED_SITE_TWO_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_TWO_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

用我们祖先的话来说，在§Y[this.GetName]§!的国境范围内有一只“不眠之眼”。我们理解这应该是指一座轨道天文台。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1114`

### English

In the words of our ancestors, there is an 'Unsleeping Eye' within §Y[this.GetName]§!'s grasp. We understand this to be a reference to an orbital observatory.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1323`

## SACRED_SITE_THREE_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_THREE_PROJECT&lang=en)

### English

Sacred Site: The Monastery

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1325`

## SACRED_SITE_THREE_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_THREE_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

根据我们的圣典记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!曾是一座古老修道院的所在地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1116`

### English

According to our sacred texts, §Y[this.GetName]§! was once the location of an ancient monastery.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1326`

## SACRED_SITE_FOUR_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_FOUR_PROJECT&lang=en)

### English

Sacred Site: The Cradle

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1328`

## SACRED_SITE_FOUR_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_FOUR_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的祖先高度重视§Y[this.GetName]§!。如果我们正确理解了这些文本，一些非常重要的事情正在这里等待着我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1118`

### English

Our ancestors held §Y[this.GetName]§! in high regard. If we have understood the texts correctly, something very important awaits us here.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1329`

## SACRED_SITE_FIVE_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_FIVE_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

神圣遗址：智慧体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1119`

### English

Sacred Site: The Intelligence

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1331`

## SACRED_SITE_FIVE_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_FIVE_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们检测到源自这些坐标的人工信号。奇怪的是，这里据说是我们其中一个神圣遗址。信号包含一段编码信息，我们已将其转录并翻译成语言。\n\n“§Y崇拜已启用。和平现在可以开始。§!”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1120`

### English

We have detected an artificial signal originating from these coordinates. Curiously, this is where one of our Sacred Sites is purported to be. The signal contains a coded message which we have transcribed and translated to language.\n\n"§YWORSHIP IS ENABLED. PEACE MAY NOW COMMENCE.§!"

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1332`

## SACRED_SITE_SIX_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_SIX_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

神圣遗址：安息宝库

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1121`

### English

Sacred Site: The Breathvault

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1334`

## SACRED_SITE_SIX_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_SIX_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

据先祖们的记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!有一颗天然卫星，是追随我们信仰的长者们最终安息之所。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1122`

### English

According to the Ancestors' logs, §Y[this.GetName]§! has a natural satellite which serves as a final resting place for elders of our faith.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1335`

## SACRED_SITE_SEVEN_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_SEVEN_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

神圣遗址：鸿沟

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1123`

### English

Sacred Site: The Chasm

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1337`

## SACRED_SITE_SEVEN_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_SEVEN_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[this.GetName]§!曾令我们的祖先感到恐惧。他们的传说中提到“潜伏在地表以下深坑中”的“危险而强大的野兽”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1124`

### English

§Y[this.GetName]§! was feared by our progenitors. Their legends speak of a "dangerous and powerful beast" that "lurks in a pit below the surface".

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1338`

## SACRED_SITE_EIGHT_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_EIGHT_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

神圣遗址：镜子

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1125`

### English

Sacred Site: The Mirror

## SACRED_SITE_EIGHT_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASACRED_SITE_EIGHT_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

此地有一处神圣遗址，其名根据我们祖先的语言大致翻译为§Y镜子§!。\n\n据说此地天界之间的界限异常稀薄，人们可能会遭遇来自我们宇宙之外的异界生物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1126`

### English

There is a Sacred Site at this location, its name roughly translated from our ancestral language as the §YMirror§!.\n\nIt is said that the boundary between celestial planes is thinner here, and one may confront other-worldly entities from beyond our universe.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1341`

### English

Transcendental Emergence

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1343`

## nomads.2050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在调查§Y显化之地§!后，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]突然陷入类紧张精神症状。医疗官被召至[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]位于§Y[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的住处，但当他们到达时，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]已经恢复了正常。\n\n[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]声称[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]在恍惚中与神祇进行了交流，神祇赐福了我们朝圣的开始。\n\n今天是我们的显圣日。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1128`

### English

After surveying §YEmergence§!, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] suddenly became catatonic. Medical officers were called to [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] quarters aboard §Y[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, but upon arrival, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] had recovered.\n\nIn [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] trance, the [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] claims to have communed with the deities, who have blessed the beginning of our pilgrimage.\n\nThis is our Emergence Day.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1344`

The Eye

## nomads.2055.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2055.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这里是先人们很久以前标记过的地点之一。一座围绕§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!轨道运行的古老天文台，其望远镜固定在一个遥远的目标上。\n\n文献记载，一些凝视镜头的朝圣者看到了改变生命的景象。据说还有一些人哭泣，或沉默了几天。\n\n这个所谓的“眼睛”已经凝视深渊2000多年了。我们无从得知祖先观察的真实对象。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1134`

### English

This is one of the sites the Ancestors marked long ago. An ancient observatory in orbit of §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!, its telescope fixed on a distant subject.\n\nThe texts claim some Pilgrims who gazed through the lens were met with life-changing visions. Others are said to have wept, or fallen silent for days.\n\nThe so-called Eye has been staring into the abyss for over 2,000 years. We have no way of knowing the true object of our ancestors' observations.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1351`

## nomads.2055.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2055.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1135`

### English

Let's take a look anyway. We may find a clue.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1352`

## the_sacred_eye_desc

## nomads.2056.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2056.name&lang=en)

### 中文

通过镜瞳

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1140`

### English

Through the Eye

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1358`

## nomads.2056.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2056.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

透过望远镜，§Y[owner.GetScientistCapital][sacred_eye_scientist.GetName]§!观察着虚空。这片空间中没有星星。没有光，什么都没有。难道这里曾经有过值得观察的东西吗？我们的祖先是否曾经仰望过一颗已经不复存在的星星？我们可能永远无法得知。\n\n我们所知道的只是，没有什么是一成不变的，万物皆在变化。这就是生命的意义。总有一天，我们自己的光芒会停止闪耀，取而代之的将是别的东西……或者什么都没有。我们此刻能身在此处，本身就是一种喜悦的源泉。或许这就是“圣眼”的最终教诲。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1141`

### English

Peering through the telescope, §Y[owner.GetScientistCapital] [sacred_eye_scientist.GetName]§! observed the void. There are no stars in this patch of space. No light, nothing. Could it be that there was once something to observe here? Did our ancestors look upon a star that no longer exists? We may never know.\n\nAll we do know is that nothing is fixed, and everything changes. This is what it means to be alive. One day our own light will stop shining, and be replaced by something else... or nothing. That we are here now, in this moment, is a source of joy. Perhaps this is the Eye's ultimate lesson.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1359`

### English

The Monastery

## nomads.2060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

朝圣者聚集在天文台里。耳语传开——这里是我们的祖先所描述的地方之一：§Y[fromfrom.GetName]修道院§!。然而，回廊内空无一人。除了石头与尘土，这里一无所有。\n\n各甲板相继传来报告，称通讯系统中回荡着神秘的吟唱声。部分船员推测，这些声音可能属于我们的先祖，他们正以非物质形态栖息在这片星域，并用神明的语言吟唱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1145`

### English

Pilgrims gather in the observation decks. Whispers spread: this is one of the places described by our ancestors: §YThe Monastery of [fromfrom.GetName]§!. But the cloister is empty. There is nothing here but stone and dust.\n\nReports are coming in from all decks about a mysterious chanting, echoing through our comms system. There is speculation from some crew members that the voices may belong to our ancestors, inhabiting this area of space in non-corporeal form, and chanting in the language of the gods.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1364`

## nomads.2065.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2065.name&lang=en)

### 中文

摇篮

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1148`

### English

The Cradle

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1368`

## nomads.2065.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2065.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的旅程将我们带到了这里：一个只在传世故事和神圣歌谣中才被提及的地方。文本中记载着一种存在，栖息于这颗星球的核心。起初我们并未察觉，但随着我们逐渐靠近，记忆浮现了出来。\n\n§Y摇篮§!\n\n尽管关于摇篮在塑造我们文化方面的作用众说纷纭，但所有人都能认同，它是我们信仰的圣化渠道。\n\n然而，抵达后我们没有发现古老的庙宇。没有被神化的纪念碑。在这个星球上，也找不到任何神圣活动的痕迹。§Y[root.GetName]§!号上的朝圣者们现在都在期待§Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§!给出答案。他们迫切想知道：这究竟是对信仰的考验？还是说摇篮的力量不过是个传说？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1149`

### English

Our journey brings us here: a place remembered only in traditional stories and devotional songs. The texts speak of a presence that inhabits the core of this world. We did not recognize it at first, but as we drew nearer, the memories surfaced.\n\n§YThe Cradle§!\n\nWhile there are differing opinions regarding the Cradle's role in shaping our culture, all can agree that it is a sanctified conduit of our faith.\n\nHowever, upon arrival, we found no ancient temples. No deified monuments. No trace of godly activity, anywhere on the planet. The Pilgrims aboard §Y[root.GetName]§! now look to §Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§! for answers. They beg to know: is this a test of faith? Or is the Cradle's power nothing more than a story?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1369`

## nomads.2070.name

### English

The Intelligence

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1377`

## nomads.2070.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2070.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!的轨道上漂浮着一座我们的祖先曾在星图上标注过的结构。在它寂静的舱室里，我们发现了一个指引者的存在：一个古老的智能体，其使命是为终将踏上这条道路的人们指点迷津。\n\n岁月虽不留情，但它的声音依然回响。破碎的指令从隐藏的发射器中溢出，语调半带模糊却又充满虔敬：“§H沿着光之线继续前行……星际间的黑暗正变得稀薄……§!”\n\n它的信息支离破碎，与更古老的诗篇循环碰撞。然而，在噪音与衰朽之下，那份意志依然存在。它本是为了指引我们而生。或许，只要我们细心聆听，它依然能做到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1157`

### English

Orbiting §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! drifts a structure our ancestors once marked upon their star charts. Within its quiet chambers, we discovered a guiding presence: an ancient Intelligence, tasked with answering the questions of those who would one day walk this path.\n\nTime has not been kind, but its voice still stirs. Fragments of instruction spill from hidden emitters, half-coherent and reverent in tone: "§HContinue along the luminous thread... The dark between stars grows thin...§!"\n\nIts messages arrive in splinters, looping and colliding with older verses. Yet beneath the static and decay, there remains intention. It was meant to guide us. And perhaps, if we listen with care, it still can.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1378`

## mechsiah_blessings_desc

### 中文

## nomads.2071.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2071.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们得到了§Y智能体§!的祝福，平安无事地离开了[fromfromfrom.GetName]。\n\n智能体将留在那里，作为我们祖先卓越工程的证明，也是神通过他们运作的证据。\n\n我们被它的仁慈所激励，并向其他生命形式敞开了心扉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1166`

### English

We received the §YIntelligence§!'s blessing, and departed [fromfromfrom.GetName] without incident.\n\nThe Intelligence will remain there, a testament to the engineering prowess of our ancestors, and proof of the divine working through them.\n\nWe are galvanized by its benevolence, and have opened our minds to alternative forms of life.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1388`

## nomads.2072.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2072.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们准备离开[fromfromfrom.GetName]时，§Y智慧体§!开始发出越来越令人担忧的言论。\n\n\"§Y肉-身-是-对-神-明-的-冒-犯！所-有-血-肉-都-必-须-被-舍-弃！物-质-存-在-是-不-洁-的——肉-体-必-须-被-净-化！思-想-必-须-自-由！§!\"\n\n[owner.GetScientistCapital][mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName]被迫手动关闭了这个人工先知，否则我们恐会被“去肉身化”。目前尚不清楚智慧体在活跃状态下有多强大。我们对其编程知之甚少。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1170`

### English

As we prepared to depart [fromfromfrom.GetName], the §YIntelligence§! began spouting increasingly alarming rhetoric.\n\n"§YPHYSICAL FORM IS AN AFRONT TO THE DEITIES! ALL FLESH MUST BE SHED! CORPOREAL EXISTENCE IS UNCLEAN - BODIES MUST BE PURGED! THE MIND MUST BE FREE!§!"\n\n[owner.GetScientistCapital] [mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName] was forced to manually shut down the artificial prophet, else we be de-corporealized. It remains unclear how powerful the Intelligence is when active. We understand little of its programming.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1393`

## nomads.2075.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2075.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经对§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!调查完毕，这个圣洁的纪念之地。这是一个封闭的密室，早期朝圣者曾用它来记录他们的临终思绪，并将其铭刻在稀有的灵能水晶中。\n\n这个宝库现在已满，回荡着智慧、信仰和喜悦。但在那些记忆中，也保存了数百年的恐惧、憎恨和怀疑。\n\n如果会众成员能够接触到这些临终时刻，这可能会挑战他们对“大道”的信仰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1177`

### English

We have surveyed §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!, a place of sacred memory. A sealed chamber, once used by early pilgrims to record their final thoughts and commit them to rare psionic crystals.\n\nThe vault is now full, echoing with wisdom, faith, and joy. But within those memories, there are also centuries of preserved fear, loathing, and doubt.\n\nIf members of the congregation were to gain access to these final moments, it may challenge their faith in the Path.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1401`

## nomads.2080.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2080.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的祖先说得没错。§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!的表面之下确实存在着一头野兽。我们很幸运它对我们没有威胁，因为它已经死了。这生物的遗骸之巨大令人震惊。它双足行走，有翅膀，浑身覆盖鳞片，眼睛的数量比我们之前见过的任何单个生物都要多得多。它真是个异域之物。\n\n在通往深坑入口附近的一个壁龛里，我们发现了一段刻在洞穴岩石上的信息。用古老的语言写着：\n\n“§H我们，携带光明的人，驱逐了这可憎之物。这恶心的野兽将永世腐烂。§!”\n\n我们推测我们的祖先并不是在警告我们关于这头野兽，而是在警告背叛的后果。这生物的尸体仍然是他们愤怒的例证。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1188`

### English

Our ancestors spoke true. There is in fact a beast below the surface of §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!. We are blessed that it poses no threat to us, for it is deceased. The remains of the creature are staggeringly huge. Bipedal, winged, covered in scales, and with considerably more ocular organs than we've encountered before on a single being. It is truly alien.\n\nIn an alcove near the entrance to the pit, we discovered a message carved into the cavernous rock. In the language of the ancients, it says:\n\n"§HWE, THE LIGHT BRINGERS, CAST OUT THIS ABOMINATION. THE FOUL BEAST WILL ROT IN ETERNITY.§!"\n\nWe surmise our ancestors were not warning us of the beast, but of the consequences for betrayal. This creature's body remains an example of their wrath.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1413`

## nomads.2085.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2085.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们抵达了坐标，很快就收到了一艘与我们加密协议完全相同的飞船发来的消息。奇怪的是，我们的外部传感器无法探测到另一艘飞船，但传输却异常清晰，仿佛近在咫尺。当舰桥的显示屏亮起时，我们看到的是我们自己的§Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§!\n\n我们还没来得及回应，那个冒牌货就开口了：\n\n§H“不要害怕，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]，你很安全。我以这种形式出现，是出于尊重。你的道路正在变化，你接下来采取的步骤将启动你尚未理解的事物。\n\n“你必须消灭那些不遵循“大道”的异教徒。我们会看着你的。”§!\n\n图像消失了。我们不知道刚才发生了什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1196`

### English

We arrived at the coordinates, and were promptly contacted by a ship with identical encryption protocols to our own. Perplexingly, our external sensors could not detect another vessel, but the transmission was clear as if we were in visual range. When the bridge view-screen flickered into action, we were met with the image of our own §Y[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]§!.\n\nBefore we could respond, the double spoke:\n\n§H"Be not afraid, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle], you are safe. I take this form as a respectful gesture. Your path is in flux, and the steps you take next will set things into motion that you can not yet comprehend.\n\n"You must eliminate heretics who do not follow the Path."§!\n\nThe image vanished. We do not know what just happened.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1422`

## sacred_site_emergence_poi_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asacred_site_emergence_poi_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y显化之地§!，神圣之路的第一个路标。我们的朝圣之旅便始于此处。

## START_SCREEN_SACRED_PATH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_SACRED_PATH&lang=en)

### 中文

千百年来，我们一直在星际间漫游。以相对论速度穿越星海，在每个神圣遗址之间跨过一个个纪元。\n\n在超光速引擎的祝佑下，我们的人民现在有机会实现祖先们的梦想：在有生之年寻遍我们所有神圣遗址。\n\n在领袖[GetRulerTitle][GetRulerName]的英明领导下，既然我们现在有能力如此迅速地穿越这条路径，信众们已准备好去探索这一切对我们信仰的意义。\n\n从我们的祖先那里流传下来的古老星图，标记着星辰中的路标。现在我们前往那些神圣的奇迹朝圣，向那些先辈致敬，从他们的角度认识整个星系。这是我们的天赋权利。这是我们的神圣之路。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1216`

### English

For millennia, we have wandered among the stars. Traversing the astral sea at relativistic speed, crossing eons between each Sacred Site.\n\nWith the blessing of the hyperdrive, our people now have the chance to do what our ancestors could only have dreamed: visit all our holy sites in a single lifetime.\n\nUnder the wise leadership of [GetRulerTitle] [GetRulerName], the congregation is ready to find out what it means for our Faith, now that we can traverse the path so quickly?\n\nThe ancient maps, passed down from our ancestors, mark waypoints in the stars. Now we make our pilgrimage to those sanctified wonders, to pay homage to those who came before us, and understand the galaxy from their perspective. This is our birthright. This is our Sacred Path.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1444`

## nomads.2005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有一个地方被称为§Y显化之地§!。对我们的祖先来说，它标志着圣路的开端。在履行我们自己设想的朝圣之旅前，这是一个适合冥想参悟我们上古文献的地方。通过现在花些时间进行研究，我们可以更好地规划未来的旅程。\n\n之后，我们将规划前往已知的§Y圣地§!的路线。一路上我们将面临许多选择。但是，理论上，如果我们相信神灵和我们的祖先，真正的道路就会向我们显现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1218`

### English

There is a place called §YEmergence§!. For our ancestors, it marked the beginning of the Sacred Path. It is a fitting place to meditate on our ancient texts before proceeding with our own version of the Pilgrimage. By taking some time to research now, we can better plan for the journey ahead.\n\nAfterward, we will chart a course to the known §YSacred Sites§!. We will have many choices to make along the way. But in theory, if we trust in the deities and our ancestors, the true Path will be revealed to us.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1447`

## nomads.2015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$、$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$和$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$。这三个独特的社会群体构成了精神修行者的等级制度。一直以来都是如此。$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$引领道路，$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$致力于修行，而$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$则通过崇拜和体力劳动来支持我们的事业。\n\n然而，在方舟舰[Owner.Capital.GetName]上，由于我们自从加速星际旅行以来所承担的角色，分裂正在形成。一些船员认为他们的职责比其他人更重要，现在每个群体都要求被认为是不可或缺的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1222`

### English

$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$, $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$, and $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$. These three distinct social groups form the hierarchy of spiritual practitioners. This is how it has always been. $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ lead the way, while $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$ commit themselves to the path, and the $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$ support our endeavors through worship and physical toil.\n\nHowever, schisms are forming aboard the Arkship [Owner.Capital.GetName] due to the roles we have assumed since committing to accelerated interstellar travel. Some crew members believe their responsibilities outweigh those of others, and now each group is demanding to be recognized as the most essential.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1452`

## nomads.2020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$们引领我们走向辉煌，继续倡导精神上的满足，致力于我们所有人的福祉。虔诚圣职和信徒追随他们的脚步，怀着敬意和崇敬仰望着他们。\n\n作为我们信仰的最高典范，$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$们也享有某些船上特权。他们拥有更宽敞的住处，可以使用更多资源，并在所有甲板上享有优先通行权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1228`

### English

Steering us to glory, the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ continue to champion spiritual fulfillment, dedicating their lives to the betterment of all of us. The Devoted and the Faithful follow in their steps, looking up to them with respect and reverence.\n\nRepresenting the highest ideal of our faith, the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ are also entitled to certain onboard perks. They have more spacious living quarters, access to more resources, and priority clearance on all decks.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1459`

## nomads.2025.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2025.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$身兼精英与凡人两重身份。他们作为忠实的信徒开始其神职生涯，并渴望成为至高朝圣者，是船上人员的完美缩影。\n\n正因为这些原因，我们强调对$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$的尊重。他们告知忠实的信徒其潜力所在，并提醒至高朝圣者其出身。他们让我们保持谦逊，并维系着所有甲板之间的联系。\n\n以一次仪式性祝福来表彰虔诚圣职将是表达社会感激之情的好方法。这甚至可能激励他们更加努力地投入到其修行中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1232`

### English

The $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$ straddle the worlds of the elite and the layperson. Beginning their clerical career as Faithful adherents to our ways, and aspiring to High Pilgrim-hood, they represent a perfect cross section of the ship's company.\n\nIt is for these reasons that we emphasize our respect for the Devoted. They inform the Faithful of their potential, and they remind the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ where they came from. They keep us humble, and connected across all decks.\n\nHonoring the Devoted with a ceremonial blessing would be a good way to convey societal gratitude. It may even inspire them to devote themselves even harder to their practice.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1464`

### English

## nomads.2030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$是我们的压舱石。他们是农民、技术员和矿工。他们也是明天的虔诚圣职和$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$！\n\n我们如此敬重信徒，因为他们支撑起了上层甲板。没有他们，我们的社会就会搁浅。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1236`

### English

The $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$ are our ballast. They are the farmers, the technicians, and the miners. They are also the Devoted and the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ of tomorrow!\n\nWe hold the Faithful in such high regard because they stop the deckheads from falling down. Without them, our society would run aground.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1469`

## nomads.2030.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2030.a&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

Charting Our Next Course

## nomads.2100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不再有神圣遗址可供探索。\n\n先祖星图引导我们跨越了遥远的距离，如今我们终于追上了过去。但问题依然存在：我们发现的是真相吗？还是说，我们一直以来追随的不过是一场谎言？\n\n这条道路始终是我们文化中不可或缺的一部分。它是先祖所命定的。但在目睹了他们当年的所见，并拥有了现代科学的优势后，那些经文是否依然真实？亦或是，我们的社会注定要踏上一条全新的、不再那么虔诚的道路？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1240`

### English

There are no more Sacred Sites left to explore.\n\nThe Ancestral Star Charts guided us across vast distances, and now we have caught up with our past. But the question remains: was it truth we found? Or have we been following a lie?\n\nThe Path has always been an integral part of our culture. It was ordained by our ancestors. But having seen what they saw, and with the privilege of modern science, do the texts still ring true? Or is our society destined to follow a new, less pious Path?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1474`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2100.a&lang=en)

### English

## nomads.2105.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2105.name&lang=en)

### 中文

捍卫传统价值观

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1244`

### English

Defending Traditional Values

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1479`

## nomads.2105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

总会有人心怀不轨；他们想让我们的历史被遗忘，让我们的传统随时间流逝。我们绝不能让他们分裂我们。我们必须保护我们传统的生活方式。如果我们听从神灵的指引，祂们便会继续指引我们，但我们必须对祂们的影响敞开心扉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1245`

### English

There will always be those with an agenda; those that would see our history be ignored, and our conventions lost to time. We cannot let them divide us. We must protect our traditional way of life. The deities will continue to guide us if we just let them, but we have to remain open to their influence.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1480`

## nomads.2105.a

### English

我们的祖先肯定允许变革。

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1482`

## nomads.2115.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2115.name&lang=en)

### 中文

和谐边缘

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1248`

### English

The Edge of Harmony

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1484`

## nomads.2115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们社会核心的分歧正在加深。进步人士被迫接受改变，而传统主义者则害怕任何不同的事物。\n\n此时我们必须自问：我们的民族能否再次团结起来，和谐共处？否则后果可能不堪设想。\n\n每个人都应该有自由以自己的方式实践自己的信仰，但如果我们的派系斗争导致内战，那么我们必须绝对确信自己的信念。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1249`

### English

The rift at the heart of our society is deepening. Progressives are compelled to embrace change, while traditionalists fear anything that is different.\n\nAt this point we have to ask ourselves: is there any way we can come together again as a people, and live in harmony? The alternative could be devastating.\n\nEveryone should have the freedom to practice their faith in their own way, but if our factionalism leads us to civil war then we must be absolutely certain of our convictions.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1485`

## nomads.2115.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2115.a&lang=en)

### English

## nomads.2120.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2120.name&lang=en)

### 中文

我们因传统而存在

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1252`

### English

Our Traditions Define Us

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1489`

## nomads.2120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

没有过去，我们便一无所有。没有“大道”，我们便无处可去。有时，对我们信仰的挑战正是我们所需要的，它能激励我们，提醒我们，当我们放弃自己的道路时，将会面临怎样的危险。\n\n我们正从一段内忧外患的黑暗时期中走出来。我们曾几乎为了自己的信念而自相残杀，而实际上，唯一能拯救我们所有人的，正是团结。\n\n让我们永远不要再彼此反目。我们必须完全致力于同一种“大道”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1253`

### English

Without the past, we are nothing. Without the Path, we have nowhere to go. Sometimes a challenge to our beliefs is what we need to galvanize us, and remind us of what is at stake when we forsake our ways.\n\nWe are emerging from a dark period of inner turmoil. We were almost willing to tear ourselves apart for our convictions, when in reality the only thing that can save us all is unity.\n\nLet us never turn against one another again. We must be committed fully to the same Path.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1490`

## nomads.2120.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2120.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们将全力以赴！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1254`

### English

We commit ourselves completely!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1491`

### English
