Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1492`

## nomads.2125.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2125.name&lang=en)

### 中文

未来无限光明

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1256`

### English

The Future is Bright Now

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1494`

## nomads.2125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

过去拖累我们、阻碍我们进化。从历史中吸取教训是一回事，但停滞不前，永远无法超越历史，则是愚蠢的。\n\n我们不必浪费自我发现的潜力。既然我们已经摆脱了昨日的枷锁，我们就可以以奔放的热情向前迈进。\n\n我们不再受制于技术落后的祖先。众神留下的神秘碎片也不再能决定我们的道路。我们选择自己的“大道”，没有任何事物能阻挡我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1257`

### English

The past pulls us back, keeping us from evolving. Learning from history is one thing, but remaining there, never moving beyond it, is foolish.\n\nWe need not waste our potential for self-discovery. Now that we have shrugged off the chains of yesterday, we can move forward with unbridled passion.\n\nNo longer will we be governed by our technologically inferior ancestors. No longer will the Path be dictated by the cryptic crumbs laid by the deities. We choose our own Path, and nothing can stand in our way.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1495`

## nomads.2125.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2125.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这条“大道”使我们感到清晰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1258`

### English

The Path brings us clarity.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1496`

## nomads.2125.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2125.b&lang=en)

### 中文

唯一的真理就是战争之路……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1259`

### English

The only true Path is a war path...

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1497`

## nomads.2130.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2130.name&lang=en)

### 中文

欢乐启蒙

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1260`

### English

Joyous Enlightenment

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1499`

## nomads.2130.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2130.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们带着信念和希望追随此“大道”，并已得道。\n\n现在，我们明白重新圣化所有已知圣地，并扩展此道以造福无数物种和文明，是我们的神圣职责。\n\n我们的仁慈将传播到星辰之间，与所有愿意的灵魂相连。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1261`

### English

We have followed the Path, in faith and hope, and we have attained enlightenment.\n\nNow, we see it is our holy duty to re-sanctify all known sacred sites, and expand the path so that it may bless countless species and civilizations.\n\nOur benevolence will spread across the stars and connect with all willing souls.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1500`

## nomads.2130.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2130.a&lang=en)

### 中文

无上欢愉！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1262`

### English

Jubilations!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1501`

## nomads.2135.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2135.name&lang=en)

### 中文

中途

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1263`

### English

The Middle Path

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1503`

## nomads.2135.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2135.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这从来都不关乎“道路”本身。最重要的是我们共同度过的旅程。我们的族人遵循这一传统已有数百年之久，然而在任何历史文献中，我们都从未发现过这条道路真正的“目的”。它或许早已淹没在时间的长河里。\n\n我们会铭记先辈流传下来的故事，以及他们曾进行的朝圣之旅，但我们不再需要追随他们的脚步。比起他们，我们对生命、银河系以及自身都有了更深刻的认知。他们所坚持的真理已不再适用于我们。我们将开辟属于自己的道路。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1264`

### English

It was never about the Path itself. What's most important is the journey we make together. Our people have followed this tradition for centuries, and yet we have never found, in any of our historical documents, the true 'purpose' of the Path. It may be lost to time.\n\nWe will remember the surviving stories of our ancestors, and the Pilgrimage they made, but we no longer need to follow their lead. We know more about life, the galaxy, and ourselves than they did. The truths they held are no longer relevant to us. We will chart our own path.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1504`

## nomads.2135.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2135.a&lang=en)

### 中文

大道至简，本性具足。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1265`

### English

The Path was within us all along.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1505`

## nomads.2140.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2140.name&lang=en)

### 中文

接纳混乱

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1266`

### English

Embracing the Chaos

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1507`

## nomads.2140.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.2140.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

现在一切都清晰了。我们祖先的神圣遗址是病态甜美的希望和信仰灯塔。那些先我们而来的人毫无羞耻之心，也不在乎别人是否知道。\n\n我们的声誉已被轻视和玷污。我们有能力圣化新的地点，以传达我们更新后的精神使命。\n\n神灵是复杂且被误解的。通过这条“大道”，祂们教导我们冲突是我们社会的自然特征。我们克服的挑战使我们变得更强大。现在我们将向整个星系展示我们的力量！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1267`

### English

Everything is clearer now. The Sacred Sites of our ancestors are sickly sweet beacons of hope and faith. Those who came before us had no shame, and they didn't care who knew it.\n\nOur reputation has been trivialized and tarnished. We have it in our power to sanctify new sites that will communicate our updated spiritual mission.\n\nThe deities are complex and misunderstood. Through the Path, they have taught us that conflict is a natural feature of our society. The challenges we overcome make us stronger. Now we will demonstrate our strength across the galaxy!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1508`

## nomads.50.default.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.50.default.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着在§Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。

## nomads.4715.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.4715.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。\n\n然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1625`

### English

One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.\n\nBut more than peculiar things for our arkships to behold, each new vista is an opportunity to learn something new, reflect and grow.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1927`

## START_SCREEN_GRS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_GRS&lang=en)

### 中文

风信子号生来就不是为了驻足在某个地方的。\n\n她是“尤利西斯计划”的第六艘，也是最后一艘方舟舰。那个本该将我们送往新殖民世界的虫洞打散了我们的舰队，而在穿越后瞬间发生的灾难性动力故障，让我们陷入了孤独漂流的境地。\n\n冈德森船长做出了一个决定。风信子号将成为我们的家，并且它将对外开放。那场失散中的其他幸存者找到了我们：研究员、殖民者，以及无处可去的流浪者。我们收留了他们。无论他们通过气闸舱带来了什么，冈德森家族都能将其物尽其用。\n\n如今[Ruler.GetTitle]依然是冈德森家族的一员。漫长的漂流让我们绕了一大圈，又回到了虫洞最初将我们抛下的那片星域。我们之所以回来，是因为这里是一切疑问开始的地方。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1639`

### English

The Hyacinth was not built to stay still.\n\nShe was the sixth and last of the Ulysses Initiative's arkships. The wormhole that was supposed to deliver us to a new colony world scattered our fleet, and a catastrophic power failure in the moments after transit left us adrift and alone.\n\nCaptain Gundersen made a decision. The Hyacinth would be our home, and it would be open. Other survivors of the scattering found their way to us: researchers, colonists, and wanderers who had nowhere else to go. We took them in. Whatever they brought through the airlock, the Gundersen line put to use.\n\nThe [Ruler.GetTitle] is always a Gundersen. Our long drift has brought us full circle, back to the stars where the wormhole first deposited us. We came back because this is where the questions start.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1943`

## EMPIRE_DESIGN_humans3

### 中文

刚德森研究学会

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1640`

### English

Gundersen Research Society

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1944`

## EMPIRE_DESIGN_humans3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPIRE_DESIGN_humans3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

作为由联合国赞助的“尤利西斯计划”的第六艘也是最后一艘方舟舰，“风信子”号在穿过那个将人类散布到星辰之中的虫洞后的瞬间，遭遇了灾难性的动力故障。罗纳德·F·冈德森舰长凭借着毅力与智慧拯救了所有人，并在此过程中建立了一个王朝。\n\n一个世纪后，冈德森研究学会依然以“风信子”号为家。这艘飞船经历了如此多的重建与扩建，以至于有些人开始称它为“忒修斯”号。他们的欢迎是真诚的，好奇心是广泛的；无论任何人通过气闸舱带来什么，都由冈德森家族决定该如何使用。如今，漫长的漂流让他们回到了原点，回到了虫洞最初将他们送达的那个星系角落。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1641`

### English

The sixth and final arkship of the UN-sponsored Ulysses Initiative, the Hyacinth suffered a catastrophic power failure in the moments after its passage through the wormhole that scattered humanity across the stars. Captain Ronald F. Gundersen saved them all through grit and ingenuity, and in doing so, founded a dynasty.\n\nA century later, the Gundersen Research Society still calls the Hyacinth home, rebuilt and expanded so much that some have started calling it the Theseus. Their welcome is genuine, their curiosity broad; what anyone brings through the airlock, the Gundersen line decides how to use. Now their long drift has brought them full circle, back to the corner of the galaxy where the wormhole first deposited them.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1945`

## nomads.9000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.9000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

风信子号的远程接收器在“尤利西斯计划”的紧急频率上截获了一段广播。\n\n这个信号非常古老——至少有一个世纪之久——但信息十分清晰。尤利西斯计划的第五艘“秋菊号”在失散中幸存了下来。殖民者们发现了一个世界，他们将其命名为“联合星”。\n\n广播不断重复着：“秋菊号殖民地呼叫所有尤利西斯计划的船只。我们已在一个宜居世界登陆。这颗星球非常美丽。我们正在这里建设新的家园。回家吧。”\n\n从这里无法确定信号的源头，但用于传输该信号的中继浮标应该是可追踪的。对附近星系进行勘测或许能找到其中一个。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1667`

### English

The Hyacinth's long-range receivers have intercepted a broadcast on Ulysses Initiative emergency frequencies.\n\nThe signal is old - at least a century - but the message is clear. The Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship, survived the scattering. The colonists found a world. They named it Unity.\n\nThe broadcast repeats: "Chrysanthemum colony to all Ulysses Initiative vessels. We have made landfall on a habitable world. The planet is beautiful. We are building something here. Come home."\n\nThe signal's origin cannot be determined from here, but the relay buoys used to carry it should be traceable. A survey of nearby systems may locate one.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1974`

## nomads.9005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.9005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尤利西斯计划的一个中继浮标漂浮在这个星系中——破损不堪，勉强运转，但仍在发送广播。\n\n除了最初的宣告外，浮标还载有两条后来的通讯。第二条的日期大约在第一条的十年后。\n\n殖民地人口：二十六万。农业已建立。基础设施正在扩建。\n\n第三条通讯的日期是第9182天——大约在登陆后的第二十五年。“我们还在这里。联合星的环境比最初的调查显示的更具挑战性。我们失去了一些同伴。如果有任何尤利西斯计划的飞船收到此广播，请回复。我们在这里。我们仍在坚持。”\n\n联合星位于天津四星系，距离这里仅有几次超空间跳跃的航程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1673`

### English

A Ulysses Initiative relay buoy is drifting in this system - battered, barely functional, but still broadcasting.\n\nBeyond the original announcement, the buoy carries two later transmissions. The second is dated roughly ten years after the first.\n\nColony population: two hundred and sixty thousand. Crops established. Infrastructure growing.\n\nThe third transmission is dated from Day 9,182 - approximately twenty-five years after landing. "We are still here. Unity is more challenging than initial surveys indicated. We have lost people. If any Ulysses Initiative vessel receives this broadcast, please respond. We are here. We endure."\n\nUnity is in the Deneb system, only a few hyperlane jumps from here.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1981`

### English

## nomads.9010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.9010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

天津四星系一片寂静。\n\n“风信子”号脱离跃迁，发现没有信标，没有信号，也没有在星球间穿梭的飞船。奥林波斯星悬浮在半远处，庞大而冷漠。\n\n有一颗卫星不对劲。殖民地的广播曾描述那里有绿色的大陆和广阔的水域，而扫描仪显示的却是一个死寂的世界——那是被核武器摧毁后的星球特有的无可错认的灰褐色。那里没有任何生命。\n\n在近地轨道上，缓慢而暗淡地漂浮着的是“秋菊”号。它没有被毁。只是空无一人。每一扇舷窗都漆黑一片。这艘曾运载着二十五万殖民者来到这个世界的飞船，已经在这里停滞了数十年。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1678`

### English

The Deneb system is quiet.\n\nThe Hyacinth drops from transit to find no beacons, no signals, no ships moving between worlds. Olympus hangs in the middle distance, enormous and indifferent.\n\nOne moon is wrong. Where the colony's broadcasts described green continents and open water, the scanners show a dead world - the unmistakable gray-brown of a nuked planet. Nothing lives there.\n\nAnd in low orbit, drifting slow and dark, is the Chrysanthemum. Not destroyed. Simply empty. Every porthole dark. The ship that carried a quarter million colonists to this world has sat here for decades.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1987`

## site_chrysanthemum_colony_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asite_chrysanthemum_colony_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。

## nomads.9015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.9015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

殖民地的数据核心幸存了下来——被封存在玻璃化表岩屑下方的地下档案馆中。\n\n第9251天：发现了一种新的掘地变种。外围墙体的防护等级不足以抵御地下突破。已向“秋菊”号请求工程支援。请求待批复。\n\n第9389天：外环已撤离。地下居住区已确认安置了214,000名殖民者。部分区域失去联系。\n\n第9441天：与7至12区的通讯中断。民兵伤亡：892人。\n\n第9484天：地下四层的电力已中断。团队被要求停止记录。档案管理员予以拒绝。\n\n第9514天：我们没有足够的时间了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1687`

### English

The colony's data cores survived - sealed in a subterranean archive beneath vitrified regolith.\n\nDay 9,251: A new burrowing variant has been identified. The outer perimeter walls are not rated for subsurface breach. Engineering support requested from the Chrysanthemum. Request pending.\n\nDay 9,389: Outer ring evacuated. 214,000 colonists accounted for in underground residential blocks. Some sectors uncontacted.\n\nDay 9,441: Communications with sectors 7 through 12 lost. Militia casualties: 892.\n\nDay 9,484: Power to sublevel four is gone. The team has been asked to stop logging. The archivist declines.\n\nDay 9,514: We do not have enough time.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:1999`

## nomads.9020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.9020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

议事厅是为容纳两百人而建造的。最后一次会议只召集到了十七人。档案员仍在进行记录。\n\n会议持续了六个小时。共投出十二张选票——六票赞成轨道轰炸，六票反对。一名委员弃权。三人缺席；他们所在的防区三天前就已沦陷。\n\n反对者争辩说，撤离仍然可行。“秋菊号”可以在地表殖民地的下层被攻破前分批撤离幸存者。\n\n多数人则不这么认为。该生物已经到达了下层通道。任何停靠的飞船都会将污染带离这个星球。现在的选择已经不再是拯救部分人还是拯救所有人，而是失去一个世界，还是失去随后的每一个世界。\n\n殖民地安全主管博克莱尔指挥官投下了决定性的一票。动议通过。殖民地宪章规定少数服从多数。那份宪章是他们在第一年亲自起草的，那时的未来看起来还是另一番光景。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1690`

### English

The council chamber was built for two hundred. The final session convened seventeen people. The archivist was still logging.\n\nThe session ran for six hours. Twelve votes were cast - six for orbital bombardment, six against. One member abstained. Three were absent; their sectors had fallen three days prior.\n\nThe dissenters argued that evacuation was still possible. The Chrysanthemum could extract survivors in cycles before the lower levels were breached.\n\nThe majority held otherwise. The organism had already reached the lower access tunnels. Any vessel that docked would carry contamination offworld. The choice was no longer between saving some and saving all, but between losing one world and losing every world that followed.\n\nChief of Colony Security, Commander Beauclair, cast the deciding vote. The motion carried. The colony's charter said majority rules. They had written that charter themselves, in the first year, when the future looked different.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2003`

## nomads.9025.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.9025.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

舰桥日志始于第9516天——即投票两天后。\n\n11名船员留下来确认地表清除情况。辐射水平。人口预估被下调，随后再次下调。第9519天：授权轰炸。第9521天：确认扇区清除完毕，40%。第9558天：地表已彻底净化。未探测到生命迹象。评估结果：全体一致。\n\n船员们又花了四年时间进行天体物理学勘测。科学家们借此打发时间。\n\n最后一篇日志的日期是第11204天。值班军官描述了一个晴朗的日子。她写道，在这么近的距离看天津四，与当初靠近它时所见的模样截然不同。记录到此结束。\n\n最后的记录只有一个时间戳，没有歉意，也没有反思。仅仅是对星光的一句观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1693`

### English

The bridge logs begin on Day 9,516 - two days after the vote.\n\nEleven crew remained to confirm surface clearance. Radiation levels. Population estimates revised downward, then revised again. Day 9,519: bombardment authorized. Day 9,521: sector clearance confirmed, 40%. Day 9,558: surface sterile. No life signatures detected. Assessment: unanimous.\n\nThe crew spent four more years on astrophysics surveys. Scientists filling the time.\n\nThe final log is dated Day 11,204. The officer on watch describes a clear day. She notes that Deneb looks different from this close than it did on approach. The entry ends there.\n\nThe final entry is a timestamp, no apology or reflection. Just an observation about starlight.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2007`

## action.1.desc_112

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_112&lang=en)

### 中文

ISA-06……风信子号。我们与全部六艘飞船都失去了联系，很长一段时间里，我们做好了最坏的打算。能在这里找到你们，看到你们还活着……请原谅我的失态。\n\n我代表[From.GetHomeWorldName]和联合国大会，请接受我们伸出的友谊之手。无论“尤利西斯计划”让你们踏上了怎样的道路，你们现在都已经回到同胞身边了。\n\n我们有很多事情要谈。请把一切都告诉我们吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1696`

### English

ISA-06... The Hyacinth. We lost contact with all six ships, and for a long time we assumed the worst. To find you here, alive... forgive me.\n\nOn behalf of the people of [From.GetHomeWorldName] and the United Nations General Assembly, please accept our hand in friendship. Whatever road the Ulysses Initiative set you on, you are among your own people now.\n\nWe have a great deal to talk about. Please, tell us everything.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2011`

## action.1.desc_113

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_113&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]，来自冈德森研究学会。“风信子”号向您致意。我们很高兴看到地球依然屹立。\n\n我们花了一个世纪的时间，追寻被虫洞散落在这片星系中的事物。这项工作浩大无边，并且我们发现，宇宙绝不会向缺乏好奇心的人展露它的秘密。每一个加入我们的人都深谙此道。这也是我们提出的唯一条件。\n\n[From.GetHomeWorldName]曾孕育出愿意乘坐方舟舰穿越虚空的科学家与探险家。我们相信如今依然如此。“风信子”号的大门向任何怀揣这种精神的人敞开。把你们最优秀的人才派给我们吧。这里从来都不缺问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1697`

### English

[From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], of the Gundersen Research Society. Greetings from the Hyacinth. We are glad to find Earth still standing.\n\nWe have spent a century pursuing what the wormhole scattered across this galaxy. The work is vast, and we have found that the universe does not yield its secrets to the incurious. Everyone who has joined us has understood this. It is the only condition we have ever asked.\n\n[From.GetHomeWorldName] produced scientists and explorers willing to cross the void in arkships. We suspect it still does. The Hyacinth's doors are open to anyone who carries that same spirit through them. Send us your best. There is no shortage of questions.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2012`

## tech_waystation_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atech_waystation_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的$starbase_waystation_1_plural$不再仅仅是繁星之间的某个简单标识物。物流的改善使其能容纳更多的库存，并沿着已建立的驿道更高效地传输资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1775`

### English

Our $starbase_waystation_1_plural$ are no longer simple markers along the stars. Improved logistics allow them to store greater reserves and transfer resources more efficiently along established Waylines.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2103`

## sm_waystation_energy_module_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_waystation_energy_module_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些先进的阵列从当地恒星辐射中汲取能量，并将其储存起来以备后用。即使我们不在，恒星也在继续为我们工作。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1820`

### English

These advanced arrays draw energy from local stellar radiation and store it for future use. Even in our absence, the stars continue to work for us.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2155`

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2520`

## nomads.8060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.8060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们如此竭尽全力而最终我也毫发无损……\n\n真是浪费。我本对你们有更高的期望。不要把你的力量浪费在不会受到伤害的事物上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2261`

### English

You burned through so much just to leave me untouched...\n\nSuch a waste. I had hoped for more from you. Do not throw your strength away on what cannot be harmed.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2627`

## nomads.8060.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.8060.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2628`

## nomads.8065.name

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2263`

### English

A Lesson Returned

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2629`

## nomads.8065.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.8065.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

又来。一样的浪费，一样的结果。\n\n我把你们所消耗的还给了你们，不是为了伤害你们，而是让你们感受到它的分量。事不过三。我不想看到你们再一次浪费自我。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2264`

### English

Again. The same waste, the same result.\n\nI return what you spent, not to hurt you, but so you feel the weight of it. Learn from this. I will not watch you spend yourself a third time.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2630`

### 中文

我们的社会不必局限于一个家园。有了建造更多方舟舰的能力，每一个战略方向都将成为一条道路，而每一条道路都将属于我们。

Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.

### 中文

$civilian_arkship_class$方舟舰不仅仅是一艘飞船，它本身就是一个独立的世界。其基础设施足以支撑一个航行中的完整社会，携带着在星海间繁衍生息所需的一切。

### English

More than a vessel, the $civilian_arkship_class$ Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.

## arkship_ruined_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship_ruined_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

昔日辉煌的方舟巨舰残骸，如今寂静地漂流着。无论它遭遇了怎样的命运，都几乎没有留下任何痕迹。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2328`

### English

The wreck of a once-great Arkship, adrift and silent. Whatever fate claimed it left little behind.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2710`

## arkship_ruined_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship_ruined_MEGASTRUCTURE_DETAILS&lang=en)

### 中文

一艘损毁的方舟舰。它的系统已然死寂，但对于愿意前去调查的人来说，或许还能找到可回收的物资。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2329`

### English

A ruined Arkship. Its systems are dark, but salvage may remain for those willing to investigate.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2711`

### 中文

§L星系将它们的秘密隐藏得极好：变动的轨道，死寂的天体，迷失在恒星干扰中的信号。我们的深度扫描能发现他人所遗漏的。§!

## concept_arkship_lithoid_consume_world_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aconcept_arkship_lithoid_consume_world_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

可以下令噬岩方舟舰环绕行星轨道，并部署其来噬岩蜂群来吞噬该星球。$NEW_LINE$一旦开始，将会有一个§H局势§!来追踪吞噬进度，并且方舟舰会被锁定在轨道上，直到该过程完成。 $NEW_LINE$如果方舟舰离开轨道，将有§Y180天§!的宽限期允许其返回。如果未能及时返回，吞噬将被放弃。 $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$在轨道上时：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—会定期提取£minerals£ §Y矿物§!、£food£ §Y食物§!和£pop£ §Y人口§! $NEW_LINE$完成后： $TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该星球将被转化为§Y粉碎星球§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2539`

### English

Terravore Arkships can be ordered to orbit a planet and deploy it's swarm consume it.$NEW_LINE$Once initiated, a §HSituation§! tracks consumption progress and the Arkship is locked in orbit until the process is complete. $NEW_LINE$If the Arkship leaves orbit, a §Y180-day§! grace period allows it to return. If it does not return in time, the consumption is abandoned. $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$While in orbit:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- £minerals£ §YMinerals§!, £food£ §YFood§!, and £pop£ §YPops§! are periodically extracted $NEW_LINE$On completion: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The world is converted into a §YShattered World§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2959`

## concept_arkship_nanotech_consume_world_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aconcept_arkship_nanotech_consume_world_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

纳米方舟舰可以受命环绕行星，并用纳米机器将其同化。$NEW_LINE$一旦启动，将出现一个§H局势§!来追踪同化进度，并且方舟会被锁定在轨道上，直到该过程完成。$NEW_LINE$如果方舟离开轨道，将有§Y180天§!的宽限期允许其返回。如果未能及时返回，该过程将被放弃。$DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$在轨道上时：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—定期提取£nanites£ §Y纳米机器§! $NEW_LINE$完成后：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该星球将被转化为不可宜居的纳米星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2541`

### English

Nanite Arkships can be ordered to orbit a planet and assimilate it with nanites.$NEW_LINE$Once initiated, a §HSituation§! tracks assimilation progress and the Arkship is locked in orbit until the process is complete.$NEW_LINE$If the Arkship leaves orbit, a §Y180-day§! grace period allows it to return. If it does not return in time, the process is abandoned. $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$While in orbit:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- £nanites£ §YNanites§! are periodically extracted $NEW_LINE$On completion:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- The world is converted into an Uninhabitable Nanite World

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:2962`

## arkship_stellar_ignition_desc

### 中文

§L将充能暗物质注入$pc_gas_giant_plural$或现有的恒星中以启动聚变反应。在此过程中幸存的恒星会燃烧得更加炽热明亮，但代价是牺牲整个星系的宜居性。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2615`

### English

§LEnergized dark matter is injected into either $pc_gas_giant_plural$ or existing Stars to jump-start fusion reactions. Stars that survive the process burn hotter and brighter, at the cost of habitability throughout the system.§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3052`

## situation_arkship_nanotech_consume_planet_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asituation_arkship_nanotech_consume_planet_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

## nomads.4705.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.4705.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在§Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!定居吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2714`

### English

Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are living through a moment future generations will remember. Now, let us settle §Y[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]§!!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3169`

## nomads.4705.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.4705.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

将所有无人机和基础设施从§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!转移至一颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上，这标志着§Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!背离了预言中的未来。现在将开发新的优先队列，以适应定居生活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2715`

### English

The transfer of all drones and infrastructure from the §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§! to a [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] is a departure point from the predicted future of the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!. New priority queues will now be developed to adapt to settled life.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3170`

## nomads.4705.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.4705.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

经过多年来对§Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§!基础设施的筹备以及对我们自身生理机能的改造，进化出更强健的骨骼与优化的肺部，如今我们已准备好定居。这将是§Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§!生命周期中的一个全新阶段，也许定居生活会很适合我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2716`

### English

After years of preparing the infrastructure of the §Y[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]§! and our own biology, evolving stronger bones and optimized lungs, we are now ready to settle. This will be a new stage in the §Y[event_target:player_country.GetName]§! lifecycle, perhaps settled life will suit us.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3171`

## nomads.4710.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.4710.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

自从我们的飞船首次驶出我们的星系以来，我们之中总有一些人只能通过影像记录来了解宇宙，在同一片天空下出生、生活并死去。现在，这一切都将改变。\n\n随着我们的§H方舟舰§!建造完成，引力不再是障碍，宇宙的无数奇迹正等待着我们。§Y[From.GetName]§!已经倾其所有：我们的人民将带着它的名字、它的记忆与它的未来，一同踏入虚空。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2743`

### English

Since our ships first ventured beyond our star, there have always been those among us who knew the cosmos only through recordings, those who were born, lived, and died beneath the same sky. That changes now.\n\nWith the completion of our §HArkship§!, gravity is no longer an obstacle, and every wonder of the cosmos awaits. §Y[From.GetName]§! has given all it had to give: our people will carry its name, its memory, and its future with us into the void.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3204`

## nomads.4710.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.4710.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经完成了一艘§H方舟舰§!。我们的无人机将不再被束缚于[From.GetPlanetMoon]。它们的程序已被调整以适应移动星际功能，同时§Y[From.GetName]§!的基础设施已被剥离殆尽，所有必要的系统均已转移，以支持一个全新的、四海为家的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2744`

### English

We have completed an §HArkship§!. No longer will our drones be bound to [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Their processes have been adjusted for mobile stellar function as §Y[From.GetName]§! is stripped bare of infrastructure and all necessary systems are transferred to support a new mobile future.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3205`

## nomads.4710.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.4710.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

我们，[event_target:player_country.GetName]，曾目睹过无数景象，但我们的子个体却始终被束缚在已定居的星球上。如今，在星际旅行的时代，困守于单一星系已成为一种累赘。登入我们崭新的§H方舟舰§!，我们将重获自由，而§Y[From.GetName]§!则会被榨干与收割。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2745`

### English

We, the [event_target:player_country.GetName], have seen many sights, yet our drones have always been bound to settled worlds. Now, in an age of interstellar travel, confinement to a single system is a liability. We will be free aboard our new §HArkship§!, while §Y[From.GetName]§! is left stripped and harvested.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3206`

## sm_arkship_engineering_bay_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_arkship_engineering_bay_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

维持这种规模的舰船运转是一场对抗熵增的持久战。零件被改装挪用，系统勉力维持着超越极限的运转，而这样的工作永无休止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2767`

### English

Keeping a vessel of this scale operational is a constant struggle against entropy. Parts are repurposed, systems are coaxed beyond their limits, and the work is unending.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3234`

## sm_arkship_docking_bay_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_arkship_docking_bay_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

停泊湾从未安静过。飞船进出穿梭，永无停歇，持续不断的抵达与驶离让方舟号与更广阔的银河系保持着紧密的联系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2771`

### English

The docking bays are never quiet. Traffic flows in and out without pause, a steady churn of arrivals and departures that keeps the Arkship connected to the wider galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3240`

## sm_arkship_psi_corps_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_arkship_psi_corps_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这座设施深藏于方舟舰的船体深处，与人口聚居的环形区域相隔绝，专门用于训练具有灵能天赋的个体，使灵能军团得以对全体居民保持密切监视。\n\n§Y灵能军团是你的朋友。信任军团。§!\n\n£job_telepath£ $job_telepath_plural$可产出£unity£ §Y$unity$§!，降低 £crime£ §Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!，并提升$mod_psionic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2978`

### English

Nestled deep within the hull of Arkship, isolated from the populated rings, this facility is devoted to training psi-gifted individuals, allowing the Psi Corps to keep a watchful eye on the population.\n\n§YThe Psi Corps is your Friend. Trust the Corps.§!\n\n£job_telepath£ $job_telepath_plural$ produce £unity£ §Y$unity$§!, decrease £crime£ §Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!, and increase $mod_psionic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$.\n

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3480`

## sm_arkship_psi_corps_desc_hive_mind

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_arkship_psi_corps_desc_hive_mind&lang=en)

### 中文

这座设施位于方舟舰深处，远离人口稠密的环带，专门用于训练有心灵异能天赋的工蜂，并让这批灵能军团监视蜂群。\n\n§Y这批灵能军团能够保护你，相信它们。§!\n\n$job_telepath_drone_effect_desc$\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2980`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3482`

## wg_expel_nomads_status_quo_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awg_expel_nomads_status_quo_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

在§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）境内归属于§Y[From.GetName]§!的§Y$waystation_plural$§!被全部摧毁。\n在停战协定期间§Y[From.GetName]§!禁止在§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）境内建造§Y$waystation_plural$§!。\n所有属于§Y[From.GetName]§!的舰船都将被强行驱逐出§Y[Root.GetName]§!。\n§Y[From.GetName]§!在接下来的§Y10年§!内将需要获得§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）的边境通行权才能进入其国境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3058`

### English

All §Y$waystation_plural$§! owned by the §Y[From.GetName]§! in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies) are destroyed.\n§Y[From.GetName]§! is blocked from building §Y$waystation_plural$§! in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies) for the duration of the truce.\nAll ships owned by the §Y[From.GetName]§! will be forced out of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!.\n§Y[From.GetName]§! will require Border Access from the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies) for the next §Y10 Years§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3570`

## wg_expel_nomads_subject_status_quo_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awg_expel_nomads_subject_status_quo_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

在§Y[Root.GetName]§!（其盟友及附属国）境内归属于§Y[From.GetName]§!的§Y$waystation_plural$§!被全部摧毁。\n在停战协定期间§Y[From.GetName]§!禁止在§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）境内建造§Y$waystation_plural$§!。\n所有属于§Y[From.GetName]§!的舰船将会被赶出§Y[Root.GetName]§!。\n在未来§Y10年§!内§Y[From.GetName]§!将需要§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）的边境通行权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3059`

### English

All §Y$waystation_plural$§! owned by the §Y[From.GetName]§! in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (their allies and subjects) are destroyed.\n§Y[From.GetName]§! is blocked from building §Y$waystation_plural$§! in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies) for the duration of the truce.\nAll ships owned by the §Y[From.GetName]§! will be forced out of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!.\n§Y[From.GetName]§! will require Border Access from the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies) for the next §Y10 Years§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:3571`

## wg_expel_nomads_effects

在§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）境内归属于§Y[From.GetName]§!的§Y$waystation_plural$§!被全部摧毁，没收其中的§Y$waystation_stockpile_plural$§!。\n在停战协定期间§Y[From.GetName]§!禁止在§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）境内建造§Y$waystation_plural$§!。\n所有属于§Y[From.GetName]§!的舰船都将被强行驱逐出§Y[Root.GetName]§!。\n§Y[From.GetName]§!在接下来的§Y10年§!内将需要获得§Y[Root.GetName]§!（及其盟友）的边境通行权才能进入其国境。

(and their allies) for the next §Y10 Years§!.

## contract_prisoner_disposal_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acontract_prisoner_disposal_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

从§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!接收罪犯。我们将按认为合适的方式驱逐他们，并可以选择将他们留在船上或送往另一个殖民地。我们不应将他们带回属于§Y[from.GetName]§!的行星。\n\n在接收囚犯后，选择将他们§Y留在船上§!，或使用方舟舰指令“§Y$arkship_drop_off_prisoners$§!”将他们§Y捎到§!我们选择的殖民地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3606`

### English

Pick up criminals from §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!. We are to deport them as we see fit, and can choose to either keep them aboard or drop them off on another colony. We are not supposed to bring them back to a planet owned by §Y[from.GetName]§!.\n\nAfter collecting the prisoners, choose to either §YKeep Them§! aboard or to §YDrop Them Off§! at a colony of our choice using the §Y$arkship_drop_off_prisoners$§! Arkship action.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4236`

## arkship_drop_off_prisoners_effect

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship_drop_off_prisoners_effect&lang=en)

### 中文

$ARKSHIP_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—移除§Y$nomad_criminals_on_board$§!修正。转移最多§Y300§!名£pop£ 人口至该行星。\n\n$PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—添加§Y$nomad_criminals_dropped_off$§!修正，持续 §Y10£time£ 年§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—如果行星拥有方的解码等级足够高，可以发现此行为。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—格式塔帝国、罪犯殖民地、奴隶世界和突触车床不受这些效果影响。\n\n§G此行动将完成§Y$contract_prisoner_disposal$§!合同§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3624`

### English

$ARKSHIP_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Removes the §Y$nomad_criminals_on_board$§! modifier. Transfer up to §Y300§! £pop£ Pops to the planet.\n\n $PLANET_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Adds the §Y$nomad_criminals_dropped_off$§! modifier for §Y10 £time£ Years§!.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Can be detected by the planet owner if they have high enough Decryption$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Gestalts Empires, Penal Colonies, Thrall Worlds and Synaptic Lathes are exempt of these effects.\n\n§GThis action will complete the §Y$contract_prisoner_disposal$§! Contract§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4257`

## nomads.3075.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.3075.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们遇到的§Y[From.GetName]§!是一个§H游牧§!文明。他们似乎愿意承担我们发布的§H合约§!工作，以换取微薄的费用。\n\n这可能为我们之间的协作提供有趣的契机，我们可以利用他们在轨道开发和探索方面的专业知识来为我们谋利。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3633`

### English

The §Y[From.GetName]§! we met are a §HNomadic§! civilization. They appear to be willing to pick up §HContract§! work on our behalf in exchange for a modest fee.\n\nThis could present interesting opportunities for collaboration between us, and we could leverage their expertise in orbital exploitation and exploration to our benefit.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4268`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4507`

## nomads.3050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.3050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了解决§H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。\n\n我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于§H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3830`

### English

Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the §H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§! have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at one point or another.\n\nOur Contract gives us options on how to handle them, but we are not supposed to drop them off again on a world belonging to the §H[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]§!. At the same time, it is likely that other empires will not appreciate a sudden influx of criminals in one of their colonies. Of course, if we are discreet enough, they might never realize what we've been up to.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4508`

Prisoners Disembarked

## nomads.3052.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.3052.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3836`

### English

The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

## nomads.3053.name

## nomads.3053.desc.issuer.problem

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.3053.desc.issuer.problem&lang=en)

### 中文

我们试图欺骗[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]，但是失败了。虽然罪犯已成功卸载，但我们的行动已被发现，[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]已取消合约并拒绝向我们支付报酬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3839`

### English

Our attempt at double crossing the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has failed. While the criminals have been successfully disembarked, we have been detected and the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has cancelled the contract and refuse to pay us.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4517`

## nomads.3053.desc.problem

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.3053.desc.problem&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们的行动已被发现，但[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]依然很高兴我们帮他们处理掉了罪犯，并同意向我们全额支付报酬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3840`

### English

While we have been detected, the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] is still pleased that we rid them of their criminals, and have agreed to pay us in full.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4518`

## nomads.3060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.3060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个旅行团在§H[root.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。\n\n我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3843`

### English

A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the §H[root.solar_system.GetName]§! system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.\n\nWe have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now we need only deliver the spectacle they were promised.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4522`

## nomads.3065.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.3065.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

游客欣赏着§H[root.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的美景，惊叹于身边的种种奇景。当踏上归途时，他们将再也不同往日了，因为对宇宙之广阔的一手认知将会重塑他们。

## nomads.6005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在代表§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!执行合同期间，我们偶然发现了一批古老的集装箱。它们被冰块包裹着，我们差点把它们误认为是普通的陨石。虽然从打捞权的角度来看，这些物品在技术上属于我们，但考虑到它们是在为他们工作时发现的，我们应该考虑将它们移交给§H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!。扫描这些箱子后，发现里面……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3850`

### English

While working on a contract on behalf of the §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!, we chanced upon a collection of ancient containers. Encased in ice, we almost mistook them for plain asteroids. While technically ours by right of salvage, we should consider turning them over to the §H[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! as they were retrieved while working on their behalf. Scanning the crates revealed...

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4531`

## nomads.6015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们方舟舰上的一些老旧模块在一次严重的冷却故障后受损，已经显得老态龙钟。损坏程度很大，好在飞船的完整性受到威胁之前已经进行紧急关停。我们该如何应对？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3869`

### English

Some older modules on our Arkship have begun to show their age after a critical cooling failure left them damaged. The damage is extensive, but an emergency shutdown was triggered before the Arkship's integrity could be compromised. How should we proceed?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4551`

Noises from the Cargo Deck

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4565`

## nomads.6020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在从§Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!装载物资时，我们检测到其中一个货舱发生了收容失效。据报告，安全门另一侧传来了低沉的轰鸣声，证实了舱室内存在潜在危险。\n\n我们要冒险进行调查吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3883`

### English

While loading materials from the §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!, we detected a containment breach in one of the cargo bays. Deep rumbling noises were reported from the other side of the security doors, confirming the presence of a potential hazard within the compartment.\n\nShould we chance an investigation?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4566`

Let's not risk the Arkship, space the cargo.

## nomads.6025.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6025.name&lang=en)

### 中文

发光生物体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3886`

### English

Bioluminescent Critters

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4570`

## nomads.6025.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6025.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

货舱门开启后，一群发光生物体令我们措手不及，它们随即窜入了方舟舰的其他区域。异星生物学家的报告显示，这些生物没有攻击性，对我们的公民或飞船的完整性不构成威胁。\n\n这些微小的生物拥有椭圆形的身体，由修长的肢体支撑，能够攀爬墙壁和天花板，并以惊人的速度移动。它们似乎以我们生态系统中的小型害虫为食，利用胸部的发光腺体引诱猎物。居民们已经适应了它们的存在，并发现它们在夜晚格外讨人喜欢——它们发出的光亮和柔和的鸣叫构成了一场令人惬意的奇观。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3887`

### English

Upon opening the cargo deck doors, a swarm of bioluminescent organisms took us by surprise and scurried in the rest of arkship. Xenobiologist reports indicate that these beings are non-aggressive and pose no threat to our citizens or to the ship's integrity.\n\nThe tiny creatures posses an oval shaped body, supported by elongated limbs, and are capable of climbing walls and ceilings while moving at remarkable speed. They appear to feed on small vermin-like critters from our ecosystem, luring them over with bioluminescent glands located in their thorax. Already, inhabitants have gotten used to them, and find them to be especially pleasing at night, when their lights and soft chirps offer a comfortable spectacle.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4571`

### English

Feral Feline

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4575`

## nomads.6030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管进行了广泛搜寻，我们的团队仍无法在此时已归于沉寂的货舱中找到骚乱的源头。正当他们准备离开时，一个小生物从阴影中钻了出来，扑向一名船员制服上挂着的一根松散线头。\n\n船员们最初吃惊不小，但很快便判定这只外星生物生性顽皮，并无攻击性。当它被小心翼翼地拿近观察时，这个外星动物发出了一种微弱的、类似马达运转的震动，这被解读为一种表示舒适的良性反应。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3891`

### English

Despite an extensive search, our team could not isolate the source of the ruckus in the now silent hold. As they prepared to exit, a small creature emerged from the shadows and pounced on a loose strand of fabric hanging from a crewmate's uniform.\n\nInitially startled, the crew soon determined that the alien to be playful in nature, rather than aggressive. When carefully handled for closer inspection the foreign animal emitted a faint, motor-like vibration interpreted as a benign comfort response.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4576`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6035.name&lang=en)

### 中文

故障的机械体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3894`

### English

Malfunctioning Mechanoid

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4580`

## nomads.6035.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6035.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

进入货舱后，船员们发现其中一个货运集装箱被从内部破开了。一台受损的机械体瘫在甲板上，电机仍在嗡嗡作响，指示灯紊乱地闪烁着。\n\n船员们试图将该单位放回集装箱，就在这时，一个隐藏隔层打开了，一堆闪烁的水晶散落在地板上。\n\n在永久关机前的一瞬间，机械体发出了一声微弱的低语，据船员报告，其内容为：“别关掉我，我不一样。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3895`

### English

Upon entering the cargo deck, the crew discovered that one of the cargo containers had been breached from within. A damaged mechanoid lay sprawled across the deck plating, motors still whirring and indicator lights blinking erratically.\n\nThe crew attempted to return the unit to its container, at which point a hidden compartment opened, releasing a collection of shimmering crystals onto the floor.\n\nImmediately prior to its permanent shutdown, the mechanoid emitted a faint vocalization, reported by crew members as: "Don't shut me down, I am different."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4581`

易爆的气体

### English

Combustive Gases

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4586`

## nomads.6040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

靠近货舱时，怪声仍在持续，我们认为采取广泛的安全预防措施极具必要。进入货舱层后，船员们发现舱室内弥漫着强烈的有害异味，并注意到货架碎片散落在停泊区各处。片刻之后，相邻的货柜内发生了几次小型爆炸，引发了紧急响应。\n\n团队循着烟雾痕迹发现了一处小火点。专业人员迅速将其扑灭，使船员能够在事态进一步升级前，安全地控制并中和这些易挥发气体。货舱层出现了明显的结构性损坏，周边区域的多处货箱也遭到了破坏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3900`

### English

The weird noises continued when approaching the cargo bay, warranting extensive safety precautions. Upon entry into the cargo deck, crew members detected a strong, noxious odor filling the compartment and noticed pieces of holding crates scattered across the dock. Several minor explosions went off moments later within adjacent cargo containers, prompting an immediate response.\n\nThe team followed a trail of smoke, discovering a small fire that had broken out. It was quickly suppressed by specialist personnel, allowing the crew to safely contain and neutralize the volatile gases before further escalation. The cargo deck exhibited visible structural damage, along with multiple nearby crates in the surrounding area. 

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4587`

## nomads.6045.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6045.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

进入货舱后，骚乱愈演愈烈。声学读数显示源头指向一个货箱。队员们做好了最坏的打算，片刻之后，一个人影从货箱中冲了出来。\n\n此人操着一口浓重且陌生的口音，声称自己带着和平而来。此人自称是§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!，并表示[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]曾是某个庞大舰队组织的一员，后因纪律原因被开除。[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap]解释说，[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]潜伏在船上，掩盖[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]自己的行踪是为了寻求庇护，并渴望有机会证明[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]的价值。\n\n§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!询问队员们是否愿意接受[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer]提议。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3904`

### English

Upon entering the cargo bay, the disturbance intensifies. Acoustic readings trace the source to a single cargo crate. The team prepares for the worst as, moments later, an individual bursts free from its confinement.\n\nThey claim to come in peace, speaking with a pronounced and unfamiliar accent. They identify themselves as §Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! and state that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] was once part of a larger fleet organization before being expelled for disciplinary reasons. [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap] explains that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] concealed [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]self aboard the vessel in search of safety and an opportunity to prove [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer] usefulness.\n\n§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! asks whether the team is willing to accept [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer] proposal.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4592`

## nomads.6045.desc.noleader

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6045.desc.noleader&lang=en)

我们曾处于水深火热之中，直到§Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§!控制了局面并被授予方舟舰的领导权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3905`

### English

We were in dire straits until §Y[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]§! took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4593`

### English

Unauthorized Biological Cargo

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4598`

## nomads.6050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当舱门打开时，那些异常的噪音戛然而止。由于无法确定骚乱的原因，团队开始对货物集装箱进行系统扫描。\n\n其中一个集装箱显示出多个意料之外的生命体征。强行打开后，发现其中有几个人，明显营养不良，身体状况极差。“请发发慈悲，”其中一人说道。“我们遭到了迫害，被迫从§Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§!帝国逃亡。我们听凭您的发落。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3910`

### English

The anomalous noises cease immediately when the doors open. Unable to determine the cause of the disturbance, the team begins a systematic scan of the cargo containers.\n\nOne of them registers multiple unexpected life signatures. Breaking it open reveals several individuals, visibly malnourished and in poor physical condition. "Please, have mercy," says one. "We were persecuted and forced to flee from §Y[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]§! Empire. We submit ourselves to whatever fate you deem appropriate."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4599`

## nomads.6055.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6055.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$他们希望在合约有效期内观察并记录方舟舰上的生活。\n\n似乎对大多数定居文明而言，游牧的生活方式依然令人着迷，且充满着不小的神秘感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3916`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$ They wish to observe and document life aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.\n\nIt seems that to most settled civilizations, the nomadic way of life remains a subject of fascination and no small degree of mystery.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4607`

## nomads.6055.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6055.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$他们希望在合约有效期内记录方舟舰的运作情况。\n\n他们的既定目标是研究一个在常规行星参数之外运行的移动自治网络，关于这一课题目前几乎没有外部数据可供参考。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3917`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$ They wish to document Arkship operations during the active contract period.\n\nTheir stated objective is the study of a mobile autonomous network operating outside conventional planetary parameters, a subject for which little external data exists.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4608`

## nomads.6055.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6055.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$他们要求在合约有效期内获得在方舟舰上的观察权。\n\n该请求源自个体研究人员，他们试图理解一种超出其记录经验的集体移动生存方式。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3918`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$ They are requesting observation rights aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.\n\nThe request originates from individuated researchers seeking to comprehend a form of collective mobile existence outside their documented experience.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4609`

## nomads.6060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n两个船员部门之间出现了关于哪个团队拥有操作权限的管辖权争议。双方均已提交正式投诉，受影响区域的工作效率已开始下降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3924`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nA jurisdictional dispute has emerged between two crew departments over which team holds operational authority. Both have submitted formal complaints, and productivity in the affected area has begun to suffer.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4616`

## nomads.6060.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6060.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n相互冲突的优先指令导致两个管理子系统之间出现了处理冲突。\n\n双方均将自身标记为当前合约的授权操作单位，导致系统陷入循环待机状态，从而降低了产出效率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3925`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nCompeting priority directives have caused a processing conflict between two management subsystems.\n\nEach has flagged itself as the authorized operational unit for our current contract, resulting in a recursive standby loop that is reducing output efficiency.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4617`

## nomads.6060.desc.hive

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n集合体的运作共振中出现了一个不和谐的线程。\n\n关于当前合约内的责任划分，两个子集群开始发出相互冲突的行为模式，为共享意识引入了低效因素。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3926`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nA dissonant thread has emerged within the collective's operational resonance.\n\nTwo sub-clusters have begun emitting conflicting behavioral patterns regarding the delineation of responsibilities within our current contract, introducing an inefficiency into the shared consciousness.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4618`

## nomads.6065.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6065.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n方舟舰的内部监控系统报告称，劳工阶层船员的士气出现恶化。一份要求获得一段休整期的正式请求已被提交。\n\n该请求已抄送至[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，对方正等待回复，并必然会要求修改条款。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3935`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nThe Arkship's internal monitoring systems have flagged a deterioration in crew morale among the worker strata. A formal request for a period of rest has been submitted.\n\nThe request has been copied to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will expect a response and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4629`

## nomads.6065.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6065.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n诊断周期发现，多个主次系统积累了大量延期的维护任务。效率预测表明，安排一次定期维护将使劳动力产出获得具有统计学意义的显著提升。\n\n该报告已提交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，其将密切关注此事的处理情况，并势必会要求修改条款。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3936`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nDiagnostic cycles have flagged an accumulation of deferred maintenance tasks across several primary and secondary systems. Efficiency projections indicate a statistically significant improvement to workforce output would follow a scheduled maintenance period.\n\nThe report has been flagged to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will be monitoring how the matter is handled, and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4630`

## nomads.6065.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6065.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n我们记录到了我们的$planet_jobs_simple_drone$中日益严重的不协调现象。它们的劳作过程需要一段同步恢复期，因为持续的压制有导致集体产出出现显著下降的风险。\n\n[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]已获悉此情况，并且必然会要求修订条款。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3937`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nWe have registered a growing dissonance within our $planet_jobs_simple_drone$. Their labor processes requires a period of synchronized recovery, as continued suppression risks measurable decline in collective output.\n\n[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName] has been made aware of the situation and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4631`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4641`

## nomads.6070.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6070.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n我们作为承包商的良好业绩已声名远播。§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!在监控泛星系贸易活动时注意到了这一点，现在将我们视为一个可靠且有能力的合作伙伴。\n\n我们现在有机会进一步培养这份关系，或者也可以将功劳让给我们自己信任的合作伙伴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3946`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nWord of our track record as a contractor has traveled. §H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, monitoring galactic trade activity, has taken note, and now views us as a reliable and capable partner.\n\nAn opening exists to cultivate the relationship, or possibly to defer credit to our own trusted partners.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4642`

## nomads.6070.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6070.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n我们在已完成合同中记录的运营数据已被外部观察者获取。§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!在追踪该区域的自主网络活动时，注意到了我们的效率指标，并认为我们是一家可靠且有实力的承包商。\n\n通讯频道已建立。我们可以接受这一评价，或者将功劳转交给我们的现有合作伙伴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3947`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\nOperational data logged across completed contracts has been accessed by external observers. §H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, tracking autonomous network activity in the region, has flagged our efficiency metrics as consistent with a reliable and capable contractor.\n\nA channel has been established. We may acknowledge the assessment, or redirect attribution to our existing partners.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4643`

## nomads.6070.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.6070.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n在观察整个星域的贸易与劳动力流动时，§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!注意到了我们行动中的规律，这彰显了我们的可靠与能力。\n\n认可的共鸣已经到来。我们可以予以回应，或者让其他蜂巢主脑的声音将这一信号传递下去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3948`

### English

$nomads.contract_event_header$\n\n§H[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]§!, observing the flow of trade and labor across the sector, has recognized a pattern in our movements, one that speaks to reliability and capability.\n\nThe resonance of recognition has arrived. We may answer it, or let another voice carry the signal forward.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4644`

## nomads.1505.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H那人以军人的姿态登舰，面容因悲痛和多年的流亡而变得坚毅。他的声音低沉、从容，带着钢铁般的锋利。§!\n\n“我的世界被清洗了，我的族人，我的家人……唯我幸存。我隐忍至今。而那些毁灭的始作俑者，必将死于我手。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3966`

### English

§HThe figure steps aboard with a soldier's bearing, their features hardened by grief and long years of exile. Their voice is low, measured, and edged with iron.§!\n\n"My world was cleansed, my people, my family... I alone survived. I endure. And the architects of annihilation will die by my hand."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4666`

## nomads.1505.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是谁？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3967`

### English

Who are you?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4667`

## nomads.1505.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H此人停顿下来，仿佛说出自己的名字会撕裂旧伤。§!\n\n“一个名字尚存，尽管其意义已成灰烬。我曾是一名士兵，忠诚而顺从。如今，我是一个被毁灭民族的影子。\n\n如果你非要称呼我，就叫我$NAME_nomadic_revenant$吧。我的过去已不再重要。重要的只有那未偿还的血债。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3968`

### English

§HThey pause, as if speaking their own name tears at an old wound.§!\n\n"A name remains, but its meaning is ash. I was a soldier once, dutiful and obedient. Now I am the shadow of a people destroyed.\n\n"Call me $NAME_nomadic_revenant$, if you must. My past no longer matters. Only the debt of blood unpaid."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4668`

## nomads.1505.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.b&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么选择我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3969`

### English

Why come to us?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4670`

## nomads.1505.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“你的方舟舰不带任何暴政的旗帜。这便是我站在你面前的原因。我很久以前就明白，一颗星球便是一座牢笼。一旦屠杀开始，便无处可逃。但你们在移动，因此你们能经受磨难。”\n\n“追随你们，此类惨剧或可被蔑视，而我的利刃也将转向那些行下屠行的屠夫。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3970`

### English

"Your Arkship carries no flag of tyranny. That is why I stand before you. I learned long ago that a planet is a cage. Once the slaughter begins, there is no escape. But you move, and so you endure.\n\n"With you, such horrors may be defied, and my blade turned against the butchers who commit them."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4671`

## nomads.1505.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你想要什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3971`

### English

What do you want?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4673`

## nomads.1505.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“复仇。”\n\n§H这两个字在空气中凝滞。陌生人探身向前，每一根筋腱都因强压下的怒火而绷得紧紧的。§!\n\n“向那些进行清洗的人复仇，向那些屠杀无辜者却将其称之为‘政策’的人复仇。\n\n为了看到这些怪物覆灭，我不惜跨越万水千山，忍受任何伤痛。\n\n助我一臂之力，我将以效忠于你来践行我的誓言。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3972`

### English

"Vengeance."\n\n§HThe word hangs in the air. The stranger leans forward, every sinew drawn tight with barely contained rage.§!\n\n"Vengeance on those who purge, on those who slaughter the innocent and call it 'policy.'\n\n"To see such monsters undone, I will cross any distance, endure any wound.\n\n"Aid me, and I will seal my oath in your service."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4674`

## nomads.1505.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.d&lang=en)

### 中文

你能否在追求个人目标的同时，也为我们的事业效力？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3973`

### English

Can you serve our cause while pursuing your own?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4676`

## nomads.1505.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“复仇是我的志向，但不必成为你的负担。只要那些星球屠夫尚存一息，我便会追猎不止。在为你效劳的过程中，我将磨砺我的利刃。”\n\n§H他们的目光变得锐利，掠食者般的锋芒穿透了自律的面具。§!\n\n“请以我带来的力量来评价我，而非我留下的伤痕。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3974`

### English

"Vengeance is my purpose, but it need not be your burden. So long as planetary butchers draw breath, I will hunt them. In your service I shall sharpen my blade."\n\n§HTheir gaze sharpens, a predatory gleam breaking through the mask of discipline.§!\n\n"Judge me by the strength I bring, not the scars I bear."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4677`

Are you kin to us?

## nomads.1505.e.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1505.e.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H紧接着发出的那声咕哝，是他们最接近笑声的反应。§!\n\n“如果是呢？熟络就能换来同情吗？身体不过是工具。而我的身体，将收割复仇。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3976`

### English

§HThe grunt that follows is as close as they come to laughter.§!\n\n"And if I was? Does familiarity buy me sympathy? A body is a tool. Mine will reap vengeance."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4680`

## nomads.1511.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1511.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

敌方舰队在我们的攻击下溃败。他们的信号逐渐没入静默。\n\n§Y$NAME_nomadic_revenant$§!注视着监视屏，沉默不语。这场胜利中没有喜悦，只有清算。那个奉行大清洗的帝国的旗帜在虚空中燃烧，但在随后的死寂中，他们的誓言依然回荡。\n\n“每击倒一个这样的敌人，都会磨炼我们的意志。我们将继续打击那些推行灭绝政策的人，永不言弃。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3982`

### English

The enemy fleet breaks against our assault. Their signals fade into static.\n\nWatching on the view screen, §Y$NAME_nomadic_revenant$§! does not speak. There is no triumph in this victory, only reckoning. The banner of a purge-committing empire burns in the void, but in the silence that follows, their promise endures.\n\n"Each such foe cast down steels our resolve. We will continue to strike against those who practice annihilation, and we will not relent.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4689`

## nomads.1515.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H你面前站着一位穿着仪式礼袍的流浪者，饰品与织物的排列显然经过精心打理。反重力伺服器嗡嗡地震动着，驱动着一本法典漂浮在她面前。当她终于开口时，每个字听起来都不像是回答，而更像是一个未问出口的问题的回响。§!\n\n“意外与命运生着别无二致的面孔，而今天它转向了你。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3991`

### English

§HBefore you stands a wanderer robed in ceremonial layers, ornaments and fabrics arranged with deliberate care. Antigravity servos within the codex that floats before her cause it to hum and gently vibrate. When she finally speaks, each word feels less like an answer than the echo of an unasked question.§!\n\n"Accident and destiny share one face, and today it turns toward you."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4700`

## nomads.1515.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是谁？

### English

## nomads.1515.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“名字如容器；我的名字恰巧是$NAME_nomadic_sage$。但唯有虚空的容器，方能成就其用。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3993`

### English

"A name is a vessel; mine happens to be $NAME_nomadic_sage$. But only the empty vessel can serve its purpose."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4703`

## nomads.1515.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你为什么四处流浪？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3994`

### English

Why do you wander?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4705`

## nomads.1515.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“那些陈旧梦想毫无意义。唯有在运动中，指引方能流淌；唯有在变革中，智慧方能呼吸。”\n\n§H异星人的存在感如同件无重量的斗篷般降临，连空气似乎都在其陪伴下凝固了。§!\n\n“告诉我：人若不是在寻找那缺失之物，又是在寻找什么呢？”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3995`

### English

"The settled dream without meaning. Only in motion can counsel flow, and only in change can wisdom breathe."\n\n§HThe alien's presence settles like a weightless mantle, the air itself seeming to fall still in her company.§!\n\n"Tell me instead: what does anyone seek, if not what is absent?"

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4706`

## nomads.1515.c

你想要什么？

What do you want?

## nomads.1515.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H外星人沉默了许久，仿佛满足于让这份寂静作为回答。也许她并非在权衡你的话语，而是在掂量发问者的分量。§!\n\n“为了入座你的阴影，为打破沉寂时的话语，为了提醒你连星辰也在流浪。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3997`

### English

§HThe alien pauses for a long time, as though content to let her silence answer. Perhaps she is not weighing your words, but the worth of the one who asked them.§!\n\n"To sit in your shadow, to speak when silence fails, to remind you that even the stars wander."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4709`

## nomads.1515.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.d&lang=en)

你的智慧果真如此超群吗？

### English

Is your wisdom truly so great?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4711`

## nomads.1515.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1515.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H一瞬之间，她的目光变得犀利，你内心深处的某些东西被展露无遗。§!\n\n“若果真如此，我便无需开口。智慧是倾听的回响，而非言语的分量。\n\n“如果你听到了，那么智慧便已属于你。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3999`

### English

§HFor a heartbeat, her gaze grows piercing, and something in you is laid bare.§!\n\n"If it were, I would not need to speak. Wisdom is the echo of listening, not the weight of words.\n\n"If you hear, then wisdom is yours already."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4712`

§H$NAME_nomadic_sage$流露出一抹恼怒的神色，转瞬即逝，犹如掠过星间的残影。§!\n\n“那我就直说了：王座终将腐朽，疆界皆为谎言，唯有虚空永恒。如果这还不够直白，那或许是因为它还不够单纯。”

## leader_trait_nomadic_sage_desc

$NAME_nomadic_sage$不担负指挥的重任，但所有与她同行的人都会发现自己的步伐变得更加稳健。真正的智慧能为领导者扫清障碍。

## DESC_nomadic_naturalist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADESC_nomadic_naturalist&lang=en)

### 中文

曾任$grand_archive$的策展人$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$离开了那无尽的库房，转而追求游牧生活。他的日志中绘满了关于那些呼吸、生长与演变的星球的素描。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4007`

### English

Once the curator of a $grand_archive$, $NAME_nomadic_naturalist$ abandoned its endless vaults to seek a nomadic life. His journals overflow with sketches of worlds that breathe, grow, and change.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4724`
