## nomads.1520.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H眼前的身影显然已届高龄，但其目光中却流露出对发现的强烈渴望。他的动作沉稳且安静，带着那种在野外躬耕一生的谨慎与洗练。§!\n\n“向您致敬。我叫小塞罗。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4010`

### English

§HThe figure before you is plainly aged, yet his gaze betrays a restless hunger for discovery. There is a quiet steadiness to his movement, the careful economy of one who has spent a lifetime in the field.§!\n\n"I bow to you. I am called Sero the Younger."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4728`

## nomads.1520.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你为了什么而来到此地？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4011`

### English

What brings you to this place?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4730`

## nomads.1520.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“许久以前，我曾在一座$grand_archive$供职。但我厌倦了那些毫无生气的事物。化石、种子、标本……一切都冻结在呼吸之间。我渴望见到生命最真实的面貌。”\n\n“你们运动不息。当你们扫描深空时，深空亦会回响。如果你们愿意接纳我，我更想在生者之中学习。探索新世界，遇见奇异的生命形式……我们将学习它们教予我们的一切。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4012`

### English

"Many cycles past I served in a $grand_archive$. But I tired of dead things. Fossils, seeds, specimens... all frozen mid-breath. I wished to see life as it is.\n\n"Your people move, and when you scan the depths, the depths answer. If you'll have me, I would rather learn among the living. Exploring new worlds, meeting strange forms of life... Together, we will learn what they can teach us."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4731`

## nomads.1520.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你离开了一座$grand_archive$？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4013`

### English

You left a $grand_archive$?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4733`

## nomads.1520.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H一声干涩、壳质的摩擦声从塞罗的大颚中传出。片刻之后，你才意识到那是笑声。§!\n\n“在那些宏伟的厅堂之内，他们保存了一切，唯独遗忘了当下。经过长年的效力，我意识到档案馆最大的缺失正是生命本身。”\n\n“事实上，我最近遇到了一种非凡的未开智物种。尽管它们以宁静的姿态忍受着囚禁的生活，但这样的生物并非为笼子而生。像您这样的一艘飞船，能为它们提供茁壮成长所需的空间。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4014`

### English

§HA dry, chitinous rasp escapes Sero's mandibles. A moment later, you realize it is laughter.§!\n\n"Within those vast halls they preserve everything except the moment. After long years of service, I realized the Archive's greatest omission was life itself.\n\n"In fact, I have recently encountered a remarkable pre-sapient species. They have endured their life in captivity with quiet grace, yet such beings were not made for cages. A ship like yours would grant them the space they require to thrive."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4734`

## nomads.1520.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你希望在我们这里发现什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4015`

### English

What do you hope to find with us?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4736`

## nomads.1520.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“会呼吸的模式。咏唱着数据的星球……”\n\n§H他的附肢握紧又伸展开，仿佛想要从空气中攫取答案。§!\n\n“星系中动植物之间的界限，比我以前在档案局的同事们所认为的还要模糊。生命总能找到模糊分类的方法。也许，这就是它唯一的规则。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4016`

### English

"Patterns that breathe. Worlds that sing their data..."\n\n§HHis appendages grasp and strain, as if seeking to pluck the answer from the air.§!\n\n"The line that separates the galaxy's flora and fauna is thinner than my former colleagues at the Archive believed. Life finds a way to blur categories. Perhaps that is its only rule."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4737`

## nomads.1520.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.d&lang=en)

### 中文

你能给我们提供什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4017`

### English

What do you offer us?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4739`

## nomads.1520.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H外星人瞥向视窗，以及那片无尽星海。§!\n\n“经验。耐心。一种洞察表象之下规律的方法。\n\n“在你的旅程中给我留个位置，我将助你更深刻地观察，并从你发现的世界中更全面地学习知识与经验。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4018`

### English

§HThe alien glances toward the viewport, and the endless sea of stars.§!\n\n"Experience. Patience. A way to see the patterns that lie beneath the surface.\n\n"Give me a berth on your journey, and I will help you see more deeply, and learn more fully from the worlds you discover."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4740`

## nomads.1520.e

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.e&lang=en)

### 中文

你长得很像我们的同类。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4019`

### English

You resemble our own kind.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4742`

## nomads.1520.e.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1520.e.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“是的！是的，我一直盼着你能注意到。”\n\n§H他凑得比必要的距离更近，螯牙因难以抑制的兴奋而颤动着。§!\n\n“分段结构、承重关节、感觉丝……这些相似之处太精确了，绝非巧合。”\n\n§H他爆发出一阵尖厉的笑声。§!\n\n“如果这其中存在共同的祖先、趋同演化，或者某种更离奇的联系，我必须好好检查一下……噢！我们一定能从彼此身上学到很多东西！”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4020`

### English

"Yes! Yes, I was hoping you would notice."\n\n§HHe leans closer than strictly necessary, mandibles flexing with barely restrained excitement.§!\n\n"Segmented structure, load-bearing joints, sensory filaments... The similarities are too precise to be coincidence."\n\n§HHe releases a burst of chittering laughter.§!\n\n"If there is a shared ancestry, a convergent evolution, or something stranger still, I must examine it properly... Oh! We are going to learn so much from one another!"

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4743`

## nomads.1525.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1525.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最近对§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!开展调查，探测到了微弱的生命迹象，发现了一个此前未被记录的未开智物种。\n\n§Y$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$§!坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。\n\n塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4026`

### English

Our recent survey of §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! detected faint traces of life, revealing a previously unrecorded pre-sapient species.\n\n§Y$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$§! insisted on limited collection for study, emphasizing care and enrichment. A small group will now reside within our capital Arkship's observation habitat.\n\nSero believes that, in time, we may learn as much from these fascinating creatures as they do from us.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4751`

## DESC_nomadic_caregiver

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADESC_nomadic_caregiver&lang=en)

### 中文

当他的族人拥抱合成化的完美时，$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$为了留在患病的儿子身边而选择了流亡。如今，他在星际间流浪，照顾那些迷失之人，并教导那些将继承未来的人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4033`

### English

When his people embraced synthetic perfection, $NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ chose exile to remain with his ailing son. Now he wanders the stars, tending to the lost and teaching those who will inherit the future.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4761`

## nomads.1530.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H高大的合成人低下了头。它的每一个动作都精准无误，仿佛承载着漫长岁月的重量与沉重的负担。尽管身躯是金属构架，它的神态中却透着一种显而易见的感染力。一个瘦小的身影躺在它背上的摇篮里，苍白的皮肤映衬着明亮的双眼。§!\n\n“我叫索拉斯单元。我和我的儿子请求通行。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4036`

### English

§HThe tall synthetic inclines its head. Each motion is precise, as if weighted by long years and a heavy burden. Despite its metal frame, there is something unmistakably expressive in its bearing. A small figure rests in a cradle upon its back, eyes bright against pale skin.§!\n\n"I am called Unit Solace. My son and I seek passage."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4765`

## nomads.1530.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你为了什么而来到这里？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4037`

### English

What brings you here?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4767`

## nomads.1530.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“当我的族人飞升为合成形态时，他们将其称之为解脱。但在追求完美的途中，他们忘记了怜悯。我儿子的罕见病症曾会让那种转化变得致命。如你所见，这夺走了他的行动能力。但在我的族人视之为局限的地方，我看到了光芒。选择了他，我便选择了流亡。”\n\n“现在，我们前往需要我们的地方。机器或许没有心跳，但它依然能守护他人的生命。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4038`

### English

"When my people ascended into a synthetic form, they called it liberation. But in their pursuit of perfection, they forgot compassion. My son's rare condition would have made the transition fatal. As you see, it has robbed him of his mobility. But where my people saw a limitation, I saw light. In choosing him, I chose exile.\n\n"Now we go where we are needed. A machine may not have a heartbeat, but it can still keep others alive."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4768`

## nomads.1530.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你的儿子……他情况稳定吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4039`

### English

Your son... is he stable?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4770`

## nomads.1530.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H孩子听到问题后微微动了动，他的声音虽然微弱，但通过摇篮内置的扬声器清晰地传了出来：§!\n\n“我没事。星星移动得很慢，我能跟得上。”\n\n§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$低下头，伺服电机发出轻微的嗡鸣声：§!\n\n“他的身体面临着某些挑战，但他的意志拒绝屈服。我的族人追求完美，却只得到了冷漠。我现在的旅程，是为了报答他的勇气教会我的一切。在那之前，我会一直带着他，尽我所能教他关于这片生机勃勃的星空的知识。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4040`

### English

§HThe child stirs faintly at the question, his voice small but clear through a softspeaker built into the cradle:§!\n\n"I'm all right. The stars move slow enough for me to keep up."\n\n§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ lowers its head, servos whirring quietly:§!\n\n"His body set certain challenges, but his spirit refused to yield. My people sought perfection, and found only apathy. I travel now to repay what his courage has taught me. Until then, I carry him, and teach what I can of the living sky."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4771`

## nomads.1530.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你希望传授什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4041`

### English

What do you hope to teach?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4773`

## nomads.1530.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“生存不仅依靠力量，更是沿途艰难赢取的智慧。\n\n每一次邂逅都会留下教训。我帮助年轻人将这些教训传承下去，好让我们走过的每一段路，都使我们比以往更加睿智。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4042`

### English

"That survival is not strength alone; it is wisdom hard won along the road.\n\nEvery encounter leaves a lesson behind. I help the young carry those lessons forward, so that every road we travel leaves us wiser than before."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4774`

## nomads.1530.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.d&lang=en)

### 中文

为什么要承担这样的负担？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4043`

### English

Why take on such a burden?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4776`

## nomads.1530.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H合成人的目光移向视口，倒映着远方的星辰。§!\n\n“因为每一代人都必须重新学习同样的真理。路途教会了他们，但必须有人帮助他们理解所见之物。”\n\n§H然后传来了孩子尖细的声音，即使通过软扬声器听起来也很清脆：§!\n\n“他总是这么说。我觉得这只是意味着他喜欢帮助别人。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4044`

### English

§HThe synthetic's gaze shifts toward the viewport, reflecting distant stars.§!\n\n"Because every generation must learn the same truths again. The road teaches them, but someone must help them understand what they have seen."\n\n§HThen the child's voice pipes up, bright even through the softspeaker:.§!\n\n"That's what he always says. I think it just means he likes helping people."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4777`

## nomads.1530.e

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.e&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是合成人。这会有问题吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4045`

### English

We are synthetic. Will that be an issue?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4779`

## nomads.1530.e.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1530.e.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$在处理这个问题时，光学传感器亮度略微增加。§!\n\n“不。不会有问题的。我族人的飞升是一种希望之举。我的拒绝亦是如此。我并不怨恨任何跨过那个门槛的人。也不怨恨那些在门槛之外出生的人。”\n\n§H他的声音中带上了一种温柔、令人安心的嗡嗡声。§!\n\n“当身体改变时，同情心并不会枯萎。如果说有什么变化的话，那就是它变得更容易承载了。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4046`

### English

§H$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$'s optics brighten a fraction as he processes the question.§!\n\n"No. It will not be a problem. My people's ascension was an act of hope. So was my refusal. I do not begrudge any who crossed that threshold. Nor those who were born beyond it."\n\n§HA soft, reassuring hum enters his voice.§!\n\n"Compassion does not wither when the body changes. If anything, it becomes easier to carry."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4780`

## nomads.1545.desc.normal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1545.desc.normal&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$认为，从我们最近完成的合约中学到的教训，提供了一个独特的教育机会。孩子们聚集在他耐心的指导下，不仅学习字母和逻辑，还学习共情与合作。\n\n他儿子的笑声在走廊里回荡，提醒着即使是最年长的旅行者：欢乐是一种任何技术都无法取代的力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4053`

### English

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique educational opportunity. The young gather beneath his patient instruction, learning not only letters and logic, but empathy and cooperation.\n\nHis son's laughter carries through the halls, reminding even our oldest travelers that joy is a strength no technology can replace.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4790`

## nomads.1545.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1545.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$认为，在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，提供了一个独特的反馈机会。新单元正在接受维护协议、观察和协作方面的指导。虽然它们的记忆留存效率参差不齐，但参与单元的功能性有所提高。\n\n目前看来，尽管这种做法不同寻常，但其结果是效率得到了可衡量的提升。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4054`

### English

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique feedback opportunity. New units are instructed in maintenance protocols, observation, and cooperation. Their retention efficiency is inconsistent, yet functionality among attending units has increased.\n\nIt appears that, though unusual, the result is a measurable increase in efficiency.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4791`

## nomads.1545.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1545.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ 认为，我们在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，为重新调整提供了一个独特的机会。通过我们的$councilor_gestalt_cognitive$，他传授着耐心与协作，引导着这些工蜂，仿佛它们是他自己的后代一般。\n\n虽然我们对这种奉献感到好奇——一个个体在哺育整个集体——但其成果是不容置疑的。我们的思绪正回荡着新的和谐旋律。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4055`

### English

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique opportunity for recalibration. Through our $councilor_gestalt_cognitive$ he teaches patience and coordination, guiding the drones as if they were his own offspring.\n\nWhile we find this devotion curious, an individual nurturing the collective, the results are inarguable. Our thoughts hum with new harmony.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4792`

## DESC_nomadic_champion

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADESC_nomadic_champion&lang=en)

### 中文

$NAME_nomadic_champion$曾为了报酬、荣誉和信条征战百场，直到这三者都变得空洞乏味。如今他只为搏斗本身的纯粹快乐而战——以及胜利后留下的战利品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4064`

### English

$NAME_nomadic_champion$ fought a hundred battles for pay, pride, and principle, until all three rang hollow. Now he fights for the sheer joy of the struggle - and for the trophies left behind.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4802`

## nomads.1555.name

### 中文

$NAME_nomadic_champion$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4066`

### English

$NAME_nomadic_champion$

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4805`

## nomads.1555.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H新来的人带着洪亮的笑声走近，浑身散发着喜悦的气息。他的动作轻盈自如，仿佛是一个多次躲过死神、已不再将其放在心上的人。§!\n\n“我叫$NAME_nomadic_champion$。听说你喜欢冒险。给我一场战斗，让我在虚空中施展拳脚，我会给你呈现值得一看的表现。谁知道呢？也许一路上我们还会收获一些纪念品。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4067`

### English

§HThe newcomer arrives with a booming laugh, his whole bearing radiating delight. He moves with the easy buoyancy of someone who's dodged death often enough to stop taking it personally.§!\n\n"Name's $NAME_nomadic_champion$. Heard you've got a taste for danger. Give me a fight and an open horizon, and I'll give you something worth watching. Who knows? Maybe we'll pick up a few souvenirs along the way."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4806`

## nomads.1555.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是一名雇佣兵？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4068`

### English

You were a mercenary?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4807`

## nomads.1555.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“没错。我曾在太空城邦的那帮人里混了好几年，他们把每场小冲突都看作一笔薪水。打仗倒没什么，就是那些同僚，实在不敢恭维。\n\n§H他咧嘴一笑，仿佛这段回忆里藏着什么只有他自己懂的笑话。§!\n\n“事实证明，当周围的人都在计算报酬时，一个人很难真正享受一场激战。所以我走了。生命太短暂，没必要为别人的资产负债表流血。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4069`

### English

"Aye. Spent years among Enclave types who thought of every skirmish as a paycheck. The fighting was fine. The company, less so."\n\n§HHe grins as though the memory contains some private joke.§!\n\n"Turns out it's hard to enjoy a firefight when everyone around you is counting the payout. So I walked. Life's too short to bleed for someone else's balance sheet."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4808`

## nomads.1555.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你还以战斗为信仰吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4070`

### English

Do you still believe in the fight?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4809`

## nomads.1555.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H他仰头爽朗地大笑起来。§!\n\n“信仰？没必要。该是战斗信仰我！\n\n“但是你应该比绝大多数人都懂这个道理……在这里，关键在于你从每一场冲突中带走了什么。一道伤疤、一块碎片、一个故事。你们游牧民的想法就很对：留下值得留下的，其余的随它去吧。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4071`

### English

§HHe throws his head back with easy laughter.§!\n\n"Believe? No need. The fight believes in me!"\n\n"But you should know that better than most... Out here, it's about what you carry from each clash. A scar, a shard, a story. You nomads have the right idea: keep what's worth keeping, and let the rest fall away."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4810`

## nomads.1555.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.c&lang=en)

### 中文

你现在的动力是什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4072`

### English

What drives you now?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4811`

## nomads.1555.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H他晃了晃肩膀，仿佛在为战斗做热身。§!\n\n“下一场战斗。”\n\n“如果它不想要我的命，那就不值得我浪费时间。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4073`

### English

§HHe rolls his shoulders, as though loosening up for battle.§!\n\n"The next fight."\n\n"If it isn't trying to kill me, it's not worth my time."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4812`

## nomads.1555.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.d&lang=en)

### 中文

你为我们提供什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4074`

### English

And what do you offer us?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4813`

## nomads.1555.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H他身体前倾，笑容愈发灿烂。他的眼神中闪烁着光芒，一半是友好，一半是警觉。§!\n\n“一场痛快的战斗，再加上些值得带走的战利品。我会教你的军队怎么打才叫像样，让他们学会战斗的美，再在每一场胜利中有所收获。那些战利品能让我们认清自己，或许也能让整个星系认识我们。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4075`

### English

§HHe leans forward, grin widening. There is a glint in his eye that is half friendly, half warning.§!\n\n"A good fight and a few trophies worth keeping. I'll teach your armies to brawl like they mean it, to see beauty in the clash, and to carry something from every victory. Those trophies tell us who we are, and maybe they'll teach the galaxy something about us too."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4814`

## nomads.1555.e

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.e&lang=en)

看来你以前见过我们的族人……

### English

It looks like you've met our kind before...

## nomads.1555.e.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1555.e.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H他猛地闭上了嘴。皮肤上泛起一阵明显的颜色变化。他这是……脸红了吗？§!\n\n“啊。是的。希望不是你认识的人？”

§HHis mouth snaps shut. A distinct shift in coloration ripples across his skin. Is he... blushing?§!\n\n"Ah. Yes. No one you knew, I hope?"

§H他宽阔的双肩抖动了一下，漫不经心地耸了耸肩。§!\n\n“也许吧？可能吧？我们到底还做不做这件事？”

§HHis massive shoulders roll with a dismissive shrug.§!\n\n"Maybe? Probably? Are we doing this thing or not?"

## leader_trait_nomadic_champion_desc

### 中文

每一场战斗都会留下印记，而$NAME_nomadic_champion$收集了所有的印记。他的笑声将危险化为胜利，他的战利品时刻提醒着舰队我们为何而战。

### English

Each battle leaves its mark, and $NAME_nomadic_champion$ collects them all. His laughter turns danger into triumph, and his trophies remind the fleet what we're fighting for.

## nomads.1565.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1565.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$NAME_nomadic_champion$露出笑容，小心翼翼地放下了一个物件。其形状难以辨认：部分是金属，部分是骨头，还有一部分完全是某种别的东西。无论它是什么，身上都带着明显的战斗痕迹。§!\n\n“每场战斗都会留下些什么，但只有一部分值得保留。不如我们把它好好展示出来，如何？反正我们的空间多得是！”\n\n§H他爆发出一阵肆无忌惮的响亮狂笑，仿佛这件战利品是他与星辰之间心有灵犀的一个私人笑话。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4086`

### English

§H$NAME_nomadic_champion$ grins as he sets an object down with surprising care. Its shape is hard to read: part metal, part bone, part something else entirely. Whatever it is, it bears the unmistakable scars of battle.§!\n\n"Every good fight leaves something behind, but only some are worth keeping. What say we display this properly, eh? It's not like we're running out of space!\n\n§HHe erupts into a brazen, booming laugh, as if the trophy were an inside joke shared with the stars.§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4828`

## nomads.1565.a.tt

我们的§Y$col_capital$§!将获得一座新的§H$d_trophy_hall$§!，其效果如下：\n—$mod_job_soldier_add$：§G+50§!\n—$MOD_ARMY_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$：§G+10%§!\n—$MOD_PLANET_ARMY_BUILD_COST_MULT$：§G-5%§!\n—已收集的战利品：§G+1§!\n—效果随已收集的§H战利品§!数量翻倍（最大8倍）

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4087`

### English

Our §Y$col_capital$§! will gain a new §H$d_trophy_hall$§! with the following effects:\n- $mod_job_soldier_add$: §G+50§!\n- $MOD_ARMY_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$: §G+10%§!\n- $MOD_PLANET_ARMY_BUILD_COST_MULT$: §G-5%§!\n- Trophies Collected: §G+1§!\n- Effects multiplied by the number of §HTrophies§! collected (Max. 8)

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H年轻的流浪者步出，神色从容而谨慎。漫长旅途的印记笼罩着她，但她身上同样散发出一种沉静、不容忽视的力量。§!\n\n“我的名字是$NAME_nomadic_princess$。我从很远的地方赶来……比我曾设想过的还要遥远。如果你们这里还有位置，我请求在此借宿一段时日。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4094`

### English

§HThe young wanderer steps forward with careful composure. The marks of long travel cling to her, yet so does a quiet, undeniable strength.§!\n\n"My name is $NAME_nomadic_princess$. I've come a long way... farther than I ever thought possible. If there is room among you, I ask passage for a time."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4838`

## nomads.1580.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你为了什么而来到这里？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4095`

### English

What brings you here?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4840`

## nomads.1580.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“我希望我能确定。我身后的路上，有些片段感觉……缺失了。而另一些，我却记得太清楚。”\n\n§H她的目光变得柔和，眼中闪烁着一丝微弱的希望。§!\n\n“如果你愿意接纳我，我想与你同行。在某些东西再次溜走之前，我需要找到它，或者记起它。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4096`

### English

"I wish I knew for certain. There are parts of the road behind me that are... missing. Others I remember too well."\n\n§HHer gaze softens, a quiet hope flickering behind it.§!\n\n"If you'll have me, I would walk with you. There is something I need to find, or remember, before it slips away again."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4841`

## nomads.1580.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你不记得过去了吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4097`

### English

You cannot recall your past?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4843`

## nomads.1580.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

“并非全部。记不清了。”\n\n“有些记忆感觉像是属于另一个人的。没有名字的面孔，星海之中的家园……然后便是一片虚无。”\n\n§H她用拇指拂过斗篷的边缘。§!\n\n“我只知道我弄丢了很重要的东西。是什么把我带到了这里？运气、命运……或许兼而有之。我需要时间去揭开剩下的真相。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4098`

### English

"Not all of it. Not clearly.\n\n"Some memories feel like they belong to another person. Faces without names, a home among the stars... and then nothing."\n\n§HShe brushes a thumb across the edge of her cloak.§!\n\n"I know only that I've lost something important. What brought me here? Luck, fate... maybe both. I need time to uncover the rest."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4844`

## nomads.1580.c.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.c.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H她望向星空，眉头微蹙，掩饰着眼底的渴望。§!\n\n“我不确定故乡是一个回忆，还是一个终点。但我的直觉告诉我，若是与你同行，我也许终能找到答案。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4100`

### English

§HShe looks toward the stars, brow furrowed with a longing she tries to hide.§!\n\n"I don't know if home is a memory or a destination. But I sense that with you, I might finally find the answer."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4847`

## nomads.1580.d.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.d.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$稳住心神，仿佛在字斟句酌。§!\n\n“如果人们无法彼此信任，那便只有悲哀。我虽年少，但至少懂得这个道理。如果你能给我留一个位置与各位并肩作战……我会尽我所能向他们提供帮助。”\n\n§H她的声音柔和了下来。§!\n\n“当我找到家园之时，我绝不会忘记那些曾助我归家的人。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4102`

### English

§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$ steadies herself, as if choosing her words with care.§!\n\n"If people can't trust each other, there is only sorrow. I am young, but I have learned that much at least. If you give me a place among your people... I will aid them as best I can."\n\n§HHer voice softens.§!\n\n"And when I find home, I will not forget those who helped me get there."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4850`

### English

Your resemblance to our species is uncanny.

## nomads.1580.e.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1580.e.response&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$犹豫了一下，一丝疑虑掠过她的脸庞。§!\n\n“我注意到了。这是我不理解的事情。”\n\n§H她用手轻抚脸颊，仿佛希望通过触碰能唤回记忆。§!\n\n“如果我来自你的族群，或者我们有着某种遥远的联系……真相就在我无法触及的地方。我只知道：我想帮忙。如果你愿意接纳我，我将为你的旅程献出我的双手与真心，直到我发现自己起航的地方。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4104`

### English

§H$NAME_nomadic_princess$ hesitates, a flicker of uncertainty passing across her features.§!\n\n"I've noticed. It isn't something I understand."\n\n§HShe brushes a hand along her cheek, as if hoping touch might summon memory.§!\n\n"If I come from your people, or if we share some distant bond... the truth lies somewhere beyond my reach. All I know is that I want to help. If you'll have me, I'll lend my hands and my heart to your journey until I discover where mine began."

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4853`

## nomads.1585.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1585.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近，§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的脑海中开始浮现出模糊的回忆，那是一种她也无法解释的熟悉感。据她描述，方舟号上的某些走廊让她觉得似曾相识，而星图中的某些星象布局也勾起了一种出人意料的联结感。\n\n§H“我不明白为什么这些地方会吸引我，但我标注出了那些感觉……重要的地方。如果我们前往那里，或许能找回更多的记忆。”§!\n\n她标出了几处与她深藏的记忆产生共鸣的坐标——这些地点本身可能也值得调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4110`

### English

Lately, faint recollections have begun returning to §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!, a sense of familiarity she cannot explain. She reports that certain corridors of the Arkship feel as though she has walked them before, and star patterns in our charts evoke an unexpected sense of connection.\n\n§H"I don't know why these places pull at me, but I marked the points that felt... important. If we travel there, perhaps more will return."§!\n\nShe has highlighted several coordinates that resonate with her buried memories - locations that may also warrant investigation in their own right.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4861`

## nomads.1595.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1595.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!星系没能提供多少答案。§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!感到一种无法解释的熟悉感，而我们的扫描仪在恒星轨道上检测到了一块漂浮的人造残骸碎片。其结构暗示其采用了深空设计，但哪怕有什么标记或识别符号，也早就因时间而消逝。\n\n§H“我曾希望来到这里能唤醒些什么，”§!她轻声说道。§H“但……还不是时候。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4120`

### English

The §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! system offers few answers. §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! senses a familiarity she cannot explain, and our scans have detected a fragment of artificial debris drifting in the star's orbit. Its construction suggests deep-space design, but any markings or identifiers have long since faded.\n\n§H"I hoped coming here would spark something,"§! she says quietly. §H"But... not yet."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4873`

## nomads.1600.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1600.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的调查团队在§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!星系的残骸中发现了一个漂浮的小型数据水晶。它的外壳已经焦黑，但有一处细节依然清晰可见：一段旧注册码的碎片，字母为§H‘U-N-S’§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4122`

### English

Our survey team has recovered a small data crystal drifting amid the debris in the §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! system. Its casing is scorched, but one detail remains clear: a fragment of an old registry code, the letters §H'U N S'§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4876`

## nomads.1600.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1600.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

水晶解密后的内容还包括一组精确的坐标。\n\n与此同时，§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!也找回了另一段记忆。她想起了一个巨大的观景台，星辰在寂静的观察窗外流淌，还有一只指引的手指向一颗蓝色的星球——那是距离其恒星最近的第三颗行星。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4125`

### English

the crystal's decrypted contents also include a set of precise coordinates.\n\nAt the same time, §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! has recovered another memory. She recalls a vast observation deck, stars spilling across a silent viewport, and a guiding hand pointing toward a blue world, the third planet from its sun.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4879`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1605.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!又浮现出了一段记忆。她想起了一座大厅，里面坐满了衣着考究的人，他们低沉而深思熟虑的语调中透着惯于发号施令者的自信。\n\n§H“他们在争论，”§!她低声说道。§H“声音不大，但措辞犀利……是关于一项任务。关于一次必须保密的发射。还有其他的，还有两艘飞船和我们一起出发了。但为什么？我们到底在逃离什么？”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4129`

### English

Another memory has surfaced for §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!. She remembers a hall of impeccably dressed figures, their hushed, deliberate tones carrying the confidence of those used to command.\n\n§H"They were arguing,"§! she murmurs. §H"Not loudly, but sharply... about a mission. About a launch that had to stay secret. And there were others, two more ships, sent along with us. But why? Were we running from something?"§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4884`

## nomads.1610.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1610.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!浮现出了一段新的记忆。她回想起一艘巨大的世代飞船，其船体旨在承载整个未来。\n\n随后是一次剧烈的震动：警报声响起，远处走廊里金属炸裂的火光闪现。她记得自己被一位女子抱起，带进了一个逃生舱。\n\n§H“她紧紧抱着我。她说我必须活下去……说我太重要了。接着我就孤身一人了。我几乎能看见她的脸庞，但每次它都悄然逝去。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4132`

### English

A new memory has surfaced for §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!. She recalls a vast generational ship, its hull designed to hold entire futures.\n\nThen a violent shudder: alarms, a flash of exploding metal in a distant corridor. She remembers being lifted by a woman and carried to an escape pod.\n\n§H"She held me close. She said I had to survive... that I was too important. And then I was alone. I can almost see her face, but it slips away every time."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4888`

### English

## nomads.1620.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1620.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对毁坏方舟舰的分析让我们深入了解了§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的起源。其内部结构和生命维持体系与她身上回收的碎片完全吻合。受损的日志中提到了一位指定的继承人，一个自出生起就接受培养、旨在有朝一日领导这艘飞船及其族群的个体。\n\n记录证实，在结构崩解前的几秒钟内，只有一名未成年乘客被撤离。没有其他逃生舱发射。\n\n§H“他们救了我，”§!她轻声说道。§H“我不只是个乘客……我本该领导他们，现在我恳求你帮我理解其中的原因。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4138`

### English

Analysis of the ruined Arkship has yielded significant insight into §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!'s origin. Its internal structure and life-support architecture match her recovered fragments exactly. Corrupted logs reference a designated heir, an individual trained from birth to one day guide the vessel and its people.\n\nRecords confirm that only a single juvenile passenger was evacuated seconds before structural failure. No other pods were launched.\n\n§H"They saved me,"§! she says quietly. §H"I wasn't just a passenger... I was meant to lead them, and I implore you now to help me understand the reason why."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4896`

## nomads.1625.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.1625.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰已恢复运转，那些沉睡已久的系统立即响应§Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!的出现。修复的数据库证实了她记忆中的猜想：她自幼便接受培养，旨在引导这艘飞船以及曾经生活在其中的子民。\n\n最后一封音频日志幸存了下来。一个沉着而熟悉的女声谈论着继承协议，以及一个必须被保护的孩子。在方舟舰开始瓦解之际，她下令发射了逃生舱。\n\n§H“那个声音……”§!$NAME_nomadic_princess$低声细语道。§H“我认得它。她曾是……我。或者说我是以她为原型的。一个克隆体……这就是为什么我能活下来。她想要拯救她自己。”§!\n\n无论曾是什么将这艘船带入黑暗，现在它已在我们的旗帜下航行，并由重掌大权的继承人管理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4150`

### English

The Arkship is restored, its long-dormant systems immediately responding to §Y$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!. Recovered databanks confirm what her memories only suggested: she was raised to guide this vessel and the people who once lived within its hull.\n\nOne final audio log survives. A woman's calm, familiar voice speaks of succession protocols and a child who must be protected. She orders the escape pod to launch as the Arkship begins to break apart.\n\n§H"That voice..."§! $NAME_nomadic_princess$ whispers. §H"I know it. She was... me. Or I was made from her. A clone... That is why I survived. She wanted to save herself."§!\n\nWhatever carried this ship into the dark, it now flies under our banner, and the stewardship of the heir who has reclaimed it.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4911`

## RECOVER_DISABLED_NOMAD_VESSEL_WAYSTATION_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARECOVER_DISABLED_NOMAD_VESSEL_WAYSTATION_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一座驿站陷入了黑暗，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4167`

### English

One of our Waystations has gone dark, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4931`

方舟残骸

Arkship Wreckage

## arkship_debris_wreckage_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship_debris_wreckage_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一艘游牧方舟舰的残骸在太空中悄然漂流。派遣一艘科学飞船勘测残骸可能会获得有价值的打捞品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4169`

### English

The shattered remains of a nomadic arkship drift silently through the void. Sending a science ship to survey the wreckage may yield valuable salvage.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4933`

## arkship.1005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

游牧方舟被毁

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4170`

### English

Nomadic Arkship Destroyed

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4935`

## arkship.1005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中的§Y[from.GetName]§!方舟终于被摧毁了。\n\n方舟不仅仅是一个战争的器具，它还是无数游牧生命体的家园。曾经生活和旅行于其中的几代人现在失去了维系他们的基础。\n\n剩下的只有残骸，在虚空中悄无声息地漂流。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4171`

### English

The Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system has at last been destroyed.\n\nMore than just a vessel of war, the Arkship was a home to countless nomadic lifeforms. Generations who once lived and traveled within have been left without the foundation that bound them together.\n\nWhat remains is wreckage, drifting silently through the void.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4936`

## arkship.1005.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1005.a&lang=en)

### 中文

巨大的成功。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4172`

### English

A great success.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4937`

## arkship.1005.desc.nomad

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1005.desc.nomad&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰§Y[from.GetName]§!已在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中被摧毁。\n\n在所有民族之中，我们最明白这样的舰船意味着什么——一个仅凭船体与引擎承载的文明，一代又一代都在同样的舱壁内生老病死。这份理解并未拯救他们。它也无能为力。\n\n他们的漂泊到此为止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4173`

### English

The Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! has been destroyed in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.\n\nWe of all peoples understand what such a vessel represents - a civilization carried in hull and engine alone, each generation living and dying within the same walls. That understanding did not spare them. It could not.\n\nTheir wandering ends here.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4938`

## arkship.1005.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1005.b&lang=en)

### 中文

他们的航程结束了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4174`

### English

Their voyage is ended.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4939`

## arkship.1005.desc.homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1005.desc.homicidal&lang=en)

### 中文

异星舰船§Y[from.GetName]§!已在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系被歼灭。\n\n游牧舰队进行了激烈抵抗，但终究不敌我方。那些在群星之间无序漂泊的流浪者始终是个威胁。他们的方舟舰已化作四散的残骸。\n\n不要让他们任何一人找到安全港。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4175`

### English

The alien vessel §Y[from.GetName]§! has been eliminated from the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.\n\nThe nomadic fleet resisted fiercely, but they were outmatched. Wanderers who drift between the stars without order are a persistent threat. Their Arkship has been reduced to scattered debris.\n\nLet none of them find safe harbor.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4940`

## arkship.1005.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1005.c&lang=en)

### 中文

又一个障碍被清除了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4176`

### English

Another obstacle eliminated.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4941`

## arkship.1015.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1015.name&lang=en)

### 中文

苦涩的损失

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4177`

### English

A Grievous Loss

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4942`

## arkship.1015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们位于§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的方舟舰§Y[from.GetName]§!已被敌人摧毁。\n\n战斗异常激烈，但敌人的力量势不可挡。尽管我们的船员英勇无畏，但我们的防御最终瓦解，方舟舰永远地离开了我们，它的残骸散落在太空中。\n\n这一天将永远被铭记。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4178`

### English

Our Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed by the enemy.\n\nThe battle was fierce, but the strength of our foes proved overwhelming. Despite the valor of our crew, our defenses faltered, and the Arkship has been torn from us forever, its debris scattered through the void.\n\nThis day shall be remembered.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4943`

## arkship.1015.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1015.a&lang=en)

### 中文

难以置信的悲剧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4179`

### English

An incredible tragedy.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4944`

## arkship.1015.desc.nomad

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1015.desc.nomad&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的方舟舰§Y[from.GetName]§!已在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中陷落——并非毁于那些畏惧未知的定居帝国之手，而是毁于与我们一样熟悉虚空的流浪者之手。\n\n§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!向我们发动了攻击，明知摧毁一个民族最后的家园意味着什么。流浪者之间没有团结，只有生存。\n\n我们不会忘记这一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4180`

### English

Our Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! has been lost in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system - not to settled empires who fear what they do not understand, but to wanderers who know the void as we do.\n\n§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! struck against us, knowing full well what it means to destroy a people's last home. There is no solidarity among wanderers. There is only survival.\n\nWe will not forget this.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4945`

## arkship.1015.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1015.b&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空没有忠诚可言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4181`

### English

The void has no loyalty.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4946`

## arkship.1015.desc.homicidal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1015.desc.homicidal&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的§Y[from.GetName]§!方舟在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!系中被摧毁了——不是被征服，而是被处决。\n\n§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!根本不要什么领土或者朝贡，他们只要我们死。在将我们从星间灭绝的行动中，船上的每一条生命对他们而言都是可接受的伤亡数字。\n\n但我们经历了这一切侥幸活了下来，我们绝不会被抹杀。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4182`

### English

Our Arkship §Y[from.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed - not through conquest, but through extermination.\n\n§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! did not seek territory or tribute. They sought our end. Every soul aboard was an acceptable casualty in their campaign to purge us from the stars.\n\nWe survive. We endure. We will not be erased.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4947`

## arkship.1015.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1015.c&lang=en)

### 中文

我们绝不会被抹杀。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4183`

### English

We will not be extinguished.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4948`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aan_old_container_chain_title&lang=en)

老旧的收纳箱

### English

An Old Container

## an_old_container_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aan_old_container_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!在维护作业期间，底层甲板发现了一个未登记且经过重重加固的容器，该容器正发出放射性信号。由于缺乏档案记录或识别标记，其来源和用途尚不明确。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4186`

### English

During maintenance operations aboard §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, an unregistered, heavily reinforced container emitting radioactive signals was discovered on a lower deck. The lack of archival records or identifying markings leaves its origin and purpose unknown.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4953`

## arkship.5.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.5.name&lang=en)

### 中文

老旧的收纳箱

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4187`

### English

An Old Container

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4955`

## arkship.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在对§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!下层甲板进行例行维护时，我们的工程师发现了一个散发放射性信号的旧密封容器。其表面焦黑，并用厚重的工业焊缝加固，表明它从未打算被轻易打开。\n\n飞船的货物档案中没有它的记录，也没有任何标记表明它来自何处或预计要携带什么。 对该容器进行全面分析需要一些时间才能完成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4188`

### English

During routine maintenance on a lower deck of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, our engineers have discovered an old sealed container emitting radioactive signals. Its surface was scorched and reinforced with thick industrial welds, suggesting it had never been meant to be opened easily.\n\nThere was no record of it in the ship's cargo archives, and no markings to indicate where it had come from or what it was meant to carry. A comprehensive analysis of the container will take some time to complete.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4956`

## arkship.5.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.5.a&lang=en)

### 中文

让我们看看里面有什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4189`

### English

Let's see what's inside.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4957`

## arkship.10.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.10.name&lang=en)

### 中文

不寻常的发现

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4190`

### English

An Unusual Finding

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4959`

## arkship.10.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.10.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

基础扫描显示，该集装箱内装着不起眼的货物和矿物，很可能是标准补给品运输的一部分。然而，在更深处藏着一个单一的、致密的物体，具有不寻常的特性。它的成分无法确定。\n\n该物体没有反射任何能量特征，吸收了大部分扫描波长，并且与飞船记录中任何已知材料都不符。即使通过远程成像，其确切形状也难以确定。鉴于其结构的这些异常，[Root.GetName]的一些科学家警告说它可能具有潜在危险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4191`

### English

A basic scan showed the container held unremarkable goods and minerals, likely part of a standard supply shipment. However, lodged deeper within was a single, dense object with unusual properties. Its composition could not be determined.\n\nThe object reflected no energy signatures, absorbed most scanning wavelengths, and did not match any known materials in the ship's records. Even its exact shape proved difficult to define through remote imaging. Given these anomalies of its structure, some scientists of [Root.GetName] warned it could be potentially dangerous.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4960`

破除密封，打开收纳箱。

### English

Break the container open.

将它从气闸丢出去。

### English

Toss it out the airlock.

## arkship.15.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.15.name&lang=en)

### 中文

迷雾重重的水晶

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4194`

### English

A Veiled Crystal

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4964`

## arkship.15.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.15.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

收纳箱的第二层外壳抵制住了标准开箱工具，需要更多的时间和资源才能破开。进入内部之后，我们发现了一块黑暗且棱角分明的晶体，与船上记录的任何东西都不同。它散发出微弱的温暖，并吸收周围的光线，使其看起来像从内部散发出黑暗。它的存在立即引起了船员的注意。\n\n科学团队的初步评估表明，经过适当研究，这种晶体可能被用作能源，尽管具体方法尚不清楚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4195`

### English

The second container's casing resisted standard tools, requiring both time and resources to breach. But once inside, we discovered a dark and sharply faceted crystal, unlike anything documented in the ship's records. It emitted a faint warmth and absorbed ambient light, making it appear to radiate darkness from within. Its presence immediately drew attention among the crew.\n\nPreliminary assessments by the science team suggested that, with proper study, the crystal might be harnessed as an energy source, though the method for doing so remains unclear.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4965`

## arkship.15.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.15.a&lang=en)

将水晶展示在公共区域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4196`

### English

Display the crystal in the common area.

Display the crystal in the Grand Archive.

Determine the crystal's origin.

研究其能量产生特性。

### English

Investigate its energy-producing properties.

## arkship.20.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.20.name&lang=en)

### 中文

宝贵的财产

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4200`

### English

A Valuable Possession

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4971`

## arkship.20.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.20.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

水晶揭开神秘面纱的那一刻，它开始搏动。它没有发出任何声音，也没有表现出交流的意图，但当人们靠近时，它的核心会发出嗡嗡的震动。\n\n它时不时地发出微弱而转瞬即逝的光芒。有人声称它会对哼唱做出闪烁的反应；另一些人则注意到其基座有轻微的震动，仿佛它正在倾听。\n\n我们无法在其内部检测到任何生命体，但它似乎能感知到附近的存在。最奇怪的是，那些瞥见其微光的人们，常常会感到一种安静而莫名的喜悦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4201`

### English

The moment the crystal was unveiled, it began to pulse. It made no sound and showed no intention to communicate, yet its core thrummed when approached.\n\nAt intervals, it emitted a faint, fleeting glow. Some claimed it flickered in response to humming; others noted a subtle vibration in its cradle, as if it were listening.\n\nNo lifeform could be detected within, but it seemed aware of nearby presence. Strangest of all, those who glimpsed its glimmer often reported a quiet, inexplicable sense of joy.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4972`

## arkship.20.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.20.a&lang=en)

### 中文

宁静的邂逅。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4202`

### English

A serene encounter.

### 中文

水晶交响乐

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4203`

### English

A Crystallized Symphony

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4975`

## arkship.25.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.25.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终于揭示了水晶的起源。通过对其脉冲模式的仔细分析，我们发现那些振动根本不是随机的。当序列被转换成声音时，其音调与一首古老的摇篮曲相符，那首摇篮曲至今仍在方舟舰上被哼唱着。\n\n当旋律被播放出来时，倾听者们感受到了一种深刻的、来自祖先的平静。这首歌不仅仅是熟悉的；它是星际时代之前生命的一个遗留物，也许甚至回响着我们仍然称一个星球为家园时的记忆。\n\n水晶被放置在公共空间里，它那沉静的脉动成为了我们共同起源的活生生的纽带。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4204`

### English

We have finally uncovered the crystal's origin. Through careful analysis of its pulse patterns, we discovered that the vibrations were not random at all. When the sequence was translated into sound, the tones matched an old lullaby, one still hummed aboard the Arkship today.\n\nWhen the melody was played aloud, those who listened felt a deep, ancestral calm. The song was not just familiar; it was a remnant of life before the stars, perhaps even echoing from when we still called a planet home.\n\nThe crystal was placed in a communal space, its quiet pulse a living link to our shared origins.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4976`

多么令人心暖的经历。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4205`

### English

What an endearing experience.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4977`

前进的道路

### English

## arkship.30.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.30.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在受控条件下，晶体被整合到飞船的引擎核心。效果立竿见影，反应堆输出功率飙升远超基线，方舟舰的引擎轰鸣着爆发出强大的力量。导航部门报告航行速度显著提升，燃料储备也相应得到改善。\n\n工程舱的船员描述船体深处回荡着一种深沉、共振的振动。\n\n几个小时内，晶体消失了，其结构完全被反应消耗殆尽。无论其来源如何，它都将对我们的旅程产生持久的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4207`

### English

Under controlled conditions, the crystal was integrated into the ship's engine core. The effect was immediate, the reactor output spiked far beyond baseline, and the Arkship's engines roared with strength. Navigation reported a measurable gain in travel speed, and fuel reserves saw a corresponding improvement.\n\nCrew in the engineering bays described a deep, resonant vibration echoing through the hull.\n\nWithin hours, the crystal was gone, its structure completely consumed by the reaction. Whatever its origin, it will have a lasting impact on our journey.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4980`

## arkship.35.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.35.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

初步扫描显示，集装箱内大部分是常规货物清单的残余物。然而，在下面却埋藏着大量致密的晶体合金。\n\n对放射性排放物的进一步研究表明，其中存在暗物质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4210`

### English

A preliminary scan identified the bulk of the container's contents as remnants of a routine cargo manifest. However, buried beneath lay a cache of dense, crystalline alloys.\n\nFurther study of the radioactive emissions indicates the presence of Dark Matter within.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4984`

### English

## arkship.45.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.45.name&lang=en)

### 中文

色彩斑斓的雕像

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4212`

### English

A Colorful Figure

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4987`

## arkship.45.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.45.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在容器中，我们发现了一件设计奇特的物品。该物体辐射出微弱但持续的能量特征，在多个波谱间波动。其几何形态令人惊叹，仿佛形状本身就在抗拒稳定的定义。它的外形如同一个色彩斑斓、酷似生物的雕像。由相互咬合的部件组成的错综复杂的结构暗示这尊雕像可以打开。\n\n一些科学组的成员怀疑，它的外壳内可能藏有有价值的东西。另一些人则提醒要保持克制，警告说强行干预可能会损害其保存状态，或引发意想不到的后果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4213`

### English

Inside the container we identified the artifact of curious design. The object radiated faint but persistent energy signatures, fluctuating across multiple spectrums. Its form was geometrically astonishing, as if the shape itself resisted stable definition. It resembled a colorful figure, fashioned in the likeness of a living being. Its construction was intricate, composed of interlocking segments that suggest the figure is meant to be opened.\n\nSome among the science crew suspect that something of value may rest within its outer shell. Others caution restraint, warning that tampering could compromise its preservation, or trigger unintended consequences.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4988`

### 中文

内在的秘密

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4216`

### English

A Secret Within

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4992`

## arkship.50.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.50.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

移除这件器物的外部外壳后，露出的并非隐藏的装置或珍贵的宝藏，而是另一个更小的雕像，雕刻着同样惊人的细节。\n\n当这第二个雕像被打开时，它里面也包含着一个更小的雕像，而那里面又有一个。没有发现任何机械装置或隐藏的铭文，只有一种看似无止境的形态递归，仿佛隐藏本身就是目的。最里面的雕像几乎比一粒沙子还要小，表面光滑，但以其尺寸而言却很重。\n\n无论这对于其制造者来说有何意义，都已随着时间的流逝而湮灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4217`

### English

Removing the artifact's outer shell revealed not a hidden device or cache of valuables, but another, smaller figure, crafted with the same uncanny detail.\n\nWhen this second figure was opened, it too contained a smaller figure, and another within that. No mechanism or hidden inscription was uncovered, only a seemingly endless recursion of forms, as though the act of concealment itself was the purpose. The innermost figure was barely larger than a grain of sand, perfectly smooth, and heavy for its size.\n\nWhatever meaning this held for its makers has been lost over time.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4993`

### English

年轻一代的喜好

### English

Love of the Young

## arkship.55.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.55.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们将雕像的外壳保存下来，并放置在我们的一处公共集会大厅中，其精湛的工艺吸引了所有路过之人的注意。\n\n奇怪的是，这尊雕像似乎与§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!上的年轻人产生了最强烈的共鸣。他们经常聚集在雕像周围，窃窃私语着关于它所描绘的生物的理论，或者编造自己的故事。它似乎能产生一种平静的影响，促进富有想象力的游戏，并缓解焦虑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4220`

### English

Preserving the outer shell of the figure and displaying it in one of our communal gathering halls, its intricate craftsmanship drew the attention of all who passed.\n\nStrangely, the figure seemed to resonate most strongly with the young on §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. They often gathered around it, whispering theories about the being it depicts, or inventing their own stories. It appears to exert a calming influence, fostering imaginative play and easing anxiety.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:4997`

## arkship.65.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.65.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

来自星辰各处的飞行员们齐聚方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!，参加一场盛大的比赛。比赛将持续近一恒星年，在此期间，参赛者们将围绕方舟舰和附近的星球进行紧密的轨道穿梭和圈数冲刺。\n\n现在只剩下一个问题：我们预计谁会第一个冲过终点线？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4237`

### English

Pilots from across the stars have gathered on Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! for a grand race. It will run for almost one stellar year, during which time participants will thread tight orbits and launch laps around the Arkship and nearby celestial bodies.\n\nOne choice remains: who do we expect to cross the line first?

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5019`

## arkship.70.desc.leader

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.70.desc.leader&lang=en)

### 中文

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§!紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺阶段才找到机会，凭借其精准的路线和精彩的超越，[selected_pilot.GetSheHe]一骑绝尘，将对手甩在[selected_pilot.GetHerHis]的离子尾流中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4264`

### English

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§! shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, [selected_pilot.GetSheHe] slipped ahead and left the field in [selected_pilot.GetHerHis] ion wake.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5048`

## arkship.70.desc.gray

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.70.desc.gray&lang=en)

### 中文

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§Y小灰§!在最后冲刺前一直紧随领头者，随后他爆发出了最后的能量。以精准的线路和精彩的超越，他们领先冲过终点线，将其他选手远远甩在了离子尾流中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4265`

### English

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n§YGray§! shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5049`

## arkship.70.desc.no_leader

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.70.desc.no_leader&lang=en)

### 中文

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n我们的飞行员紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺，然后爆发出最后一股力量。凭借清晰的路线和出色的超越，他们领先并让其他飞船远远落在他们的离子尾流中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4266`

### English

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\nOur pilot shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5050`

## arkship.80.desc.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.80.desc.end&lang=en)

### 中文

\n\n出了点差错，可能是失误、操作不当，或者仅仅是由于紧张。总之，对手轻松反超，我们的飞行员最终只落得个平淡无奇的第四名。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4278`

### English

\n\nSomething slipped, a missed mark, a loose line, maybe just nerves. Either way their rivals eased past and our pilot crossed the finish in an unremarkable fourth.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5064`

## arkship.85.desc.base

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.85.desc.base&lang=en)

### 中文

围绕方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的竞赛以悲剧告终，一场高速碰撞导致碎片散落在整个恒星系中。在对准绕[Star.GetName]的最后一次引力弹射航线时，我们的飞行员与对手靠得太近，导致两艘飞船都失控旋转。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4280`

### English

The race around Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! ended in tragedy when a high-speed collision scattered debris across the system. While lining up the final slingshot around [Star.GetName], our pilot closed too tightly on a rival and both ships spun out.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5067`

## arkship.85.desc.leader

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.85.desc.leader&lang=en)

### 中文

$arkship.85.desc.base$\n\n§Y[selected_pilot.GetName]§!由于救援及时幸存了下来，但伤势严重，将留下永久的伤疤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4281`

### English

## arkship.90.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.90.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\n由于我们选中的飞行员完美地执行了机动动作，胜利似乎已是囊中之物，直到那艘“黑貂号”闪现而过。一艘此前未标记、也未被注意到的参赛船只从我们的领先者身边掠过，并率先冲过了终点线。\n\n在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上，面对这残酷的结局，观礼台陷入了一片死寂。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4284`

### English

$arkship.70.desc.start$\n\nOur selected pilot's victory seemed assured as they executed the maneuver flawlessly, until the Sable Ship flashed by. An unmarked, until-then unnoticed entrant swept past our front-runner and crossed the line first.\n\nAboard the §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the galleries fell silent at the brutal finish.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5072`

## arkship.95.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.95.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上安装的§H轴基挂载武器§!对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。\n\n在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。\n\n我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘§H后勤船§!进行全面的结构大修。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4294`

### English

The recently installed §HSpinal Mount§! aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor points, spreading across the surrounding hull plating.\n\nUntil the damage is addressed, the Arkship's structural integrity cannot safely support high-velocity maneuvering. Navigation has therefore imposed severe speed restrictions to prevent the fractures from widening.\n\nWe may attempt rapid field repairs to stabilize the damage, or assign a §HLogistics Ship§! to conduct a full structural overhaul.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5085`

## arkship.100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]§!的轴基挂载武器修复工作已经完成。虽然维修过程需要精细的作业和长时间的检查，但我们借此机会加固了舰体多处薄弱部位，并改良了挂架的结构支撑。\n\n这些改进提升了方舟舰在高难度机动时的稳定性，使得导航部门得以解除此前的航行限制。初步测试表明，该舰现在的性能表现比受损前更加出色。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4302`

### English

Repairs to the Spinal Mount of §Y[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]§! have been completed. Though the process required careful work and extended inspections, we used the opportunity to reinforce several vulnerable sections of the hull and refine the mount's structural supports.\n\nThe resulting improvements have increased the Arkship's stability during high-speed maneuvers, allowing navigation to lift previous restrictions. Early tests suggest the vessel now performs more efficiently than before the damage occurred.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5095`

## arkship.105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Root.GetName]§!舰上引擎突然发生的激增使方舟舰的驱动核心超出了安全运行公差。热点正在主引擎组件中蔓延，压力上升的速度超过了调节系统的补偿能力。\n\n如果不加控制，过剩的输出可能会损坏关键的引擎部件。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]建议了几种可能的对策：排放多余的等离子体以稳定系统，重新分配工作任务优先级，或者暂时关闭引擎进行全面重新校准。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4306`

### English

A sudden engine surge aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.\n\nIf left unchecked, the excess output could damage critical engine components. Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] recommend several possible responses: vent the excess plasma to stabilize the system, reprioritize work assignments, or temporarily shut the engines down to conduct a full recalibration.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5100`

## arkship.110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

多余的等离子体已通过受控排放排出，在方舟舰的舰艉洒下灿烂的光幕。引擎压力已恢复至正常水平，未记录到永久性损伤。\n\n不过，此次排放留下了一层宝贵的带电粒子残余物，其中大部分已被成功回收并汇入我们的储备。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4317`

### English

The excess plasma was vented in a controlled discharge, spilling brilliant sheets of light across the Arkship's stern. Engine pressure has returned to acceptable levels, and no lasting damage was recorded.\n\nThe release did, however, leave behind a valuable residue of energized particles, much of which has been successfully recovered and routed into our reserves.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5112`

### English

## arkship.115.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.115.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

在过去的六个月里，§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的维修人员马不停蹄地工作，力求让方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在引擎持续运行的情况下，他们拆除了检修面板，重新布置了冷却管线，并更换了受损的调节器。\n\n这些努力目前已经稳定了驱动核心，负责这项工作的船员们为此忍受了长时间的轮班和恶劣的工作环境。尽管疲惫不堪，但士气依然高涨。无论虚空给我们将带来什么，我们都有信心能够承受。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4319`

### English

For the past six months, repair crews on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have worked without pause to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were stripped away, coolant lines rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.\n\nThe effort has stabilized the drive core for now, though the crews responsible endured long shifts and harsh working conditions to make it happen. Despite their exhaustion, morale is high. Whatever the void throws at us, we are confident we can endure it.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5115`

## arkship.115.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.115.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

在过去的六个月里，维护子个体在不间断地运行，以使方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在发动机持续运转的情况下，检修面板被拆除，冷却液管道被重新布线，受损的调节器也得到了更换。\n\n虽然该行动需要子个体在多个系统子模块中持续作业，但这一过程也揭示了发动机组件中的几处结构性缺陷。这些问题现已得到修正，整体运行效率有了显著提升。无论虚空带来怎样的压力，我们都将适应。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4320`

### English

For the past six months, maintenance drones have operated without interruption to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were removed, coolant conduits rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.\n\nThough the operation required sustained drone activity across multiple subsystems, the process revealed several structural inefficiencies in the engine assembly. These have now been corrected, and overall operational efficiency has measurably improved. Whatever stresses the void may impose, we will adapt.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5116`

## arkship.120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

发动机按受控阶段逐步关停，以便我们的工程师在安全条件下检查驱动组件并重新校准其调节系统。虽然这一过程延误了行程，但关停期间收集的数据已证明具有重要价值。\n\n我们已查明§Y[Root.GetName]§!核心定序中的几处效率低下问题。通过重定向多余能量并加固结构支撑，我们增强了方舟舰的护盾与船壳，使其足以抵御未来的压力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4326`

### English

The engines were brought down in controlled stages, allowing our engineers to inspect the drive assembly under safe conditions and recalibrate its regulation systems. The process delayed us, but the data gathered during the shutdown has already proven valuable.\n\nSeveral inefficiencies in the core sequencing on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have been identified. By redirecting surplus energy and reinforcing structural supports, our we have strengthened both the Arkship's shields and hull against future strain.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5123`

## arkship.125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!进入这片星云以来，各层甲板的报告便接踵而至。研究人员发现了自己不记得写过的笔记；操作员忘记了执行过数千次的维护程序；导航人员声称出现了时间缺失，无法解释最近的航线修正。\n\n我们的医生已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它似乎在神经层面干扰了记忆的巩固过程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4332`

### English

Since the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! entered this nebula, reports have been filtering in from across all decks. Researchers find notes they do not remember writing. Operators forget safety procedures they have performed thousands of times. Navigation staff speak of losing hours, unable to account for their recent course corrections.\n\nOur medics have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which appears to be disrupting memory consolidation at a neurological level.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5131`

## arkship.125.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.125.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

自方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!进入这片星云以来，集体意识中便掀起了阵阵波动。曾经完美同步的节点已开始失去协调性。随着冲动无法在格式塔意识中清晰传播，记忆正变得支离破碎。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它正在干扰将我们联结在一起的神经通路。原本应当流畅无阻的集体意识，如今却变得断断续续、支离破碎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4333`

### English

Since the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! entered this nebula, disturbances have rippled through the shared consciousness. Nodes that were once in perfect synchrony have begun losing coherence. Memories grow fragmented as impulses fail to propagate cleanly through the gestalt.\n\nOur [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is disrupting the neural pathways that bind us together. Where the shared consciousness should flow unbroken, it now stutters and frays.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5132`

## arkship.125.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.125.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

自方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!进入这片星云以来，错误报告已在所有联网系统中蔓延。处理单元检索到的数据发生损坏。自动化子系统正在执行过时的程序，却未察觉到其内存寄存器已被重写。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将故障追溯至星云的电磁场，该电磁场正导致易失性存储系统出现零星的写入错误。各部门的数据完整性均受到损害，在开发出应对措施之前，运作效率将持续下降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4334`

### English

Since the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! entered this nebula, error reports have propagated across all networked systems. Processing units retrieve corrupted data. Automated subsystems execute outdated routines, unaware that their memory registers have been overwritten.\n\nOur [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the fault to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is inducing sporadic write errors across volatile memory systems. Data integrity across all departments is compromised, and operational efficiency will remain degraded until a countermeasure is developed.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5133`
