## arkship.1140.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1140.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

进入该层后，团队立即报告感受到了心理上的压抑。这个地方最初看起来像是一处拘留区，实则更接近一座被遗弃的精神病院。走廊两旁排列着加固的牢房，地板上固定着束缚具。诊断设备与刑罚工具融合在一起，模糊了治疗与惩罚之间的界限。\n\n证据表明，我们的祖先是有意选择埋葬这个地方的。出于羞耻或是为了保护后人，他们将其从记忆中抹去。也许他们认为，遗忘才是更安全的做法。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4682`

### English

Upon entering the level, the team reported immediate psychological distress. What first appeared to be a detention block proved closer to an abandoned asylum. Reinforced cells lined the corridors, restraints bolted into the floors. Diagnostic equipment stood fused with instruments of coercion, blurring any distinction between care and punishment.\n\nThe evidence suggests our ancestors chose to bury this place deliberately. Whether from shame or a desire to protect those who came after, they erased it from memory. Perhaps they believed it safer forgotten.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5574`

## arkship.1145.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1145.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

电梯门开启，映入眼帘的是一座巨大的陈列馆，两旁排列着风格各异的雕像。有些雕像优雅大方，有些则怪诞诡异，它们全部伫立在大理石底座上，仿佛在沉默地审视着闯入者。\n\n在破碎的展柜和崩塌的板壁后，团队发现了一间密室，里面堆满了保存完好的§Y稀有水晶§!。一座高大的白色雕像守卫着这批财宝。当团队成员移动时，那张酷似我们族类的面孔似乎在跟随着他们的身影。尽管起初团队成员觉得取走水晶无异于偷窃，但很快我们便对这座雕像产生了一种奇特的喜爱之情。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4685`

### English

The elevator opened onto a vast gallery lined with statues of varied make and style. Some were elegant, others grotesque, all mounted on marble pedestals and turned toward the intruders in silent appraisal.\n\nBehind shattered cases and crumbling panels, the team uncovered a hidden chamber packed with carefully preserved §YRare Crystals§!. A tall white statue stood watch over the hoard. As they moved, its face, shaped just like one of our kind, seemed to follow. Despite the team's initial sense that removing the crystals bordered on theft, we quickly developed a peculiar fondness for the statue.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5578`

乌有的引擎

### English

Engines for Nothing

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5582`

## arkship.1150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这层空间回荡着机械的轰鸣声。装配线仍在开足马力运转，将废料锻造成引擎，却在最后阶段又将其拆解，使产出物回归为原始金属。这种循环毫无意义地重复着。\n\n在更深处，一个制造单元正超负荷运作，组装起机器人骨架并为其安装处理器核心。每一个构装体都在激活后的瞬间崩塌，其结构极不稳定。有些在归于沉寂前闪烁着短暂而令人不安的意识迹象，而大多数则自行启动了关机程序。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4689`

### English

The level roared with machinery. Assembly lines still ran at full capacity, forging scrap into engines, only to dismantle them in the final stage and return the output to raw metal. The cycle repeated without purpose.\n\nDeeper inside, a fabrication unit operated beyond safe limits, assembling robotic frames and fitting them with processing cores. Each construct collapsed moments after activation, its form structurally unsound. Some flickered with brief, unsettling signs of awareness before falling still. Most initiated their own shutdown sequences.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5583`

黑洞现象

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4691`

### English

Black Hole Phenomenon

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5586`

## arkship.1160.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1160.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的仪器记录到了来自§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!星系黑洞的异常辐射。远距离扫描捕捉到一个不明物体正接近奇点。那艘巨大的舰船发出的技术信号远超我们的理解，干扰了我们的读数，导致无法进行精确分析。视觉确认也极其短暂，与其说是实物，倒不如说更像是一场幻觉。\n\n在那艘船进入未知领域的前一刻，我们观察到了一个诡异的景象：船只完好无损地穿过了黑洞，且显然是有意为之。随后，所有信号都消失了。该船是被摧毁了、位移了，还是以某种无法理解的状态幸存下来，仍然不得而知。可以确定的是，黑洞产生了反应，而我们可能瞥见了一些尚无法解释的东西。无论在那道视界线上发生了什么，显而易见的是，这次观测并非没有带给我们任何改变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4692`

### English

Our instruments aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! registered anomalous emissions from the black hole in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system. Long-range scans detected the glimpse of an unidentified object approaching the singularity. Their immense vessel emitted technological signatures far beyond our understanding, interfering with our readings and rendering precise analysis impossible. Visual confirmation was fleeting at best, resembling a hallucination more than anything tangible.\n\nMoments before the vessel crossed into the unknown, we observe a strange sight: the ship passing through the black hole intact, clearly intentionally. Then, all signals ceased. Whether the vessel was destroyed, displaced, or survived in some incomprehensible state remains unknown. What is certain is that the black hole reacted, and we may have glimpsed something we cannot yet explain. Whatever transpired at that horizon, it is clear that we have not emerged from this observation unchanged.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5587`

### English

## arkship.1165.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1165.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在经过§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!星系内的一颗殖民星球时，我们观察到其背阳面爆发了同步的光束。一开始我们怀疑有动乱爆发，后来被证明这种担忧是多余的。这些爆发的光束是受控的、遍及全球的烟火表演，完全处于非军事参数范围之内。\n\n进一步的分析显示，这场盛景是在刻意与某种天文信号进行对齐。我们可以有把握地得出结论：当地居民正在用光编码信息。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]记录了这些模式，从而对大规模协作和符号化交流有了更深入的了解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4696`

### English

While passing a colonized world in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system, we observed its nightside erupt in synchronized bursts of light. Initial fears of unrest proved unfounded. The emissions were controlled, planet-wide pyrotechnic displays, well within non-military parameters.\n\nCloser analysis revealed deliberate astronomical alignments woven into the spectacle. It feels safe to conclude that the inhabitants are encoding meaning in light. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have documented the patterns, gaining insight into large-scale coordination and symbolic communication.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5592`

## arkship.1170.name

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4709`

### English

The Skin of a Giant

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5606`

## arkship.1170.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1170.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在穿过§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!星系的行星带时，我们观察到在碎片中漂浮着几个闪烁着微光的天体。初步扫描显示它们是形状不规则的小行星，但通过进一步的近距离观察，我们发现它们存在层状的鳞片式结构，这些结构在恒星光芒的照射下反射出不断变幻的色带。\n\n进一步的分析表明，这些碎片部分源自矿物，部分源自生物。它们看起来像是一头§Y以太巨龙§!的残骸，这头巨龙似乎被一颗小行星撞击，在离开该星系之前失去了部分装甲外皮。星光照耀在这些被丢弃的鳞片上，将棱镜般的七彩光芒洒落在方舟舰上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4710`

### English

While passing through the planetary belt in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system, we observed several faintly shimmering objects drifting among the debris. Initial scans suggested irregular asteroids, but closer inspection revealed layered, scale-like structures reflecting stellar light in shifting bands of color.\n\nFurther analysis indicates these fragments were partly mineral in origin, partly biological. It seemed to be remnants of an §YEther Drake§! that appeared to have been hit by an asteroid and lost part of its armored hide before leaving the system. Starlight catches the discarded scales, scattering prismatic light across the Arkship.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5607`

### English

### English

Reinforcing the Arkship

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5611`

## arkship.1175.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1175.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在研究这些散落的鳞片时，我们注意到了这种材料超乎寻常的韧性。其复杂的层状结构揭示了生物生长与天然装甲工程的融合，远超我们之前的设想。鳞片的叠层成分对高温、动能冲击和能量释放表现出了卓越的抵抗力。\n\n我们尝试复制了这种装甲板并将其嵌入方舟舰的外壳中，从而增强其防御能力。曾经身为游荡巨龙的盔甲，如今将为我们的知识所用，在虚空等待着的重重危险中保护我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4715`

### English

While studying the scattered scales, we noted the extraordinary resilience of the material. The complex, layered structure reveals a fusion of biological growth and natural armor engineering far beyond our previous assumptions. The scales' layered composition exhibits remarkable resistance to heat, kinetic impact, and energy discharge.\n\nWe experimented with replicating the plating and inserted it into the Arkship's outer hull, where we can enhance its defensive capacity. What once was the armor of a roaming drake will now serve our knowledge to shield us against the many dangers that await in the void.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5612`

## arkship.1180.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1180.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

位于§Y[solar_system.GetName]§!星系中漂浮的§Y以太巨龙§!的龙鳞碎片引起了广泛关注。\n\n这些鳞片经过清洗和精心打磨后，被制作成了引人注目的装饰品。这些传奇生物的遗骸一经上市便拍出了极高的价格，事实证明它们既令人惊叹又利润丰厚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4718`

### English

The drifting fragments of §YEther Drake§! scales in the §Y[solar_system.GetName]§! system have attracted significant attention.\n\nThe scales were cleaned and carefully polished before being crafted into striking ornamental pieces. Once offered on the market, these relics of a legendary creature fetched an exceptionally high price, proving very impressive and profitable.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5615`

## arkship.1185.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1185.name&lang=en)

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5624`

## arkship.1185.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1185.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!上正在开展常规审计，结果发现了货物记录中存在差异。\n\n监控录像显示，方舟舰居民中已经形成了一个非正式的交换网络。一个以物易物的系统在船员和定居者之间悄然兴起。易腐物品、工具、奢侈品和个人服务在监控有限的僻静角落被进行交易。\n\n这一发现引发了一些令人不安的问题。有人赞赏其中展现出的聪明才智；而另一些人则警告说，方舟舰上的任何监管疏忽都可能带来严重的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4727`

### English

A routine audit aboard §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! has uncovered discrepancies in our cargo records.\n\nSecurity footage indicates the formation of an informal exchange network among the Arkship's residents. A barter system has quietly emerged among crew and civilians. Perishables, tools, luxury goods, and personal services are traded in secluded corners where surveillance is limited.\n\nThe discovery raises uncomfortable questions. Some admire the ingenuity on display. Others warn that any lapse in oversight aboard an Arkship could carry serious risks.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5625`

## arkship.1190.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1190.name&lang=en)

### 中文

自由的市场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4731`

### English

A Free Market

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5630`

## arkship.1190.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1190.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰内部的非法以物易物网络已被证明极其稳定。尽管缺乏官方监管，该网络通过信任和相互依赖实现了自我调节。纠纷鲜少发生，且在方舟舰正式分配系统难以维持进度时，必需品仍能持续流通。通过将此类交易合法化并建立清晰的界限，方舟舰在其内部接纳了有限的自由市场。\n\n对许多居民而言，这一改变不仅提供了获取商品的途径，还赋予了他们在方舟舰庞大体制内的自主权、责任感以及焕发出的使命感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4732`

### English

The unauthorized barter network within the Arkship has proven remarkably stable. Despite the lack of official oversight, the network has regulated itself through trust and mutual dependence. Disputes are rare, and essential goods continue to circulate where the Arkship's formal distribution systems struggle to keep pace. By legalizing the exchanges and establishing clear boundaries, the Arkship embraced a limited free market within its walls.\n\nFor many residents, the change offers more than access to goods. It provides agency, responsibility, and a renewed sense of purpose within the vast machinery of the Arkship.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5631`

## arkship.1190.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1190.a&lang=en)

### 中文

让这个市场繁荣起来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4733`

### English

Let the market thrive.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5632`

## arkship.1195.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1195.name&lang=en)

### 中文

恢复控制

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4734`

### English

Control Regained

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5634`

## arkship.1195.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1195.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该非法市场已成功关闭。我们的安保团队已开始拆除相关网络。用于交易的储物柜已被封存，且低能见度区域的监控范围也已扩大。那些组织交易的人员已被正式调岗或受到纪律处分。\n\n虽然这种以物易物的网络曾给部分居民带来了一种自主感和机遇感，但方舟舰的设计初衷绝非支持非官方的分配方式。在一艘每一份资源都必须记录在案的舰船上，管控与可预测性始终是重中之重。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4735`

### English

The unauthorized market was shut down successfully. Our security teams have begun dismantling the network. Storage lockers used for trading have been sealed, and surveillance expanded in the low-visibility areas. Those organizing exchanges have been formally reassigned or received disciplinary actions.\n\nWhile the barter network had provided some residents with a sense of autonomy and opportunity, the Arkship was never designed to support unofficial means of distribution. On a vessel where every resource must be accounted for, control and predictability remain of highest importance.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5635`

## arkship.1200.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1200.name&lang=en)

### 中文

死亡和稅收

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4736`

### English

Death and Taxes

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5637`

## arkship.1200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰维护通道内的以物易物网络展现出了惊人的效率。货物持续通过非官方渠道流通，填补了方舟舰配给系统中微小但持续存在的缺口。\n\n某些中间人已受到秘密接触，他们通过提供合作来换取免受执法干扰。每笔交易中都有一小部分份额流入了我们的官方账户。对居民而言，该市场仍处于非官方状态，且在很大程度上避开了当局的视线。然而在实际操作中，其流量均在严密监控之下，且利润丰厚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4737`

### English

The barter network operating within the Arkship's maintenance corridors has proven surprisingly efficient. Goods continue to circulate through unofficial channels, filling small but persistent gaps in the Arkship's distribution systems.\n\nCertain intermediaries have been discreetly approached and offered protection from enforcement in return for cooperation. A modest share of each transaction now finds its way back into our official accounts. To the residents, the market remains unofficial and largely invisible to authority. In practice, however, its flows are carefully observed and surprisingly profitable.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5638`

## arkship.1200.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1200.a&lang=en)

### 中文

贸易兴，则营收旺。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4738`

### English

If trade flows, so will revenue.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5639`

## arkship.1200.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1200.b&lang=en)

### 中文

税收是繁荣的代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4739`

### English

Taxation is the price of prosperity.

## arkship.1205.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1205.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!储存库的最深处，档案管理员们在被遗忘已久的库存中发现了一个密封的小箱子。里面装有一枚不起眼的微芯片，虽有记录但从未被妥善索引。如果它真的具有什么价值，大概也就不会被遗忘在储存箱里了。\n\n这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4746`

### English

Deep within the §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value, it would likely not have ended up forgotten in a storage crate.\n\nThe technology was severely outdated, using data formats that predate several generations of Arkship systems. Some speculate that it may originate from the early days of the journey, perhaps even from the era when our species still lived on a planetary surface.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5650`

### English

## arkship.1210.desc.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.a&lang=en)

### 中文

数据经恢复后，展示了一个古老的季节性庆典，它可以追溯到我们过往在行星上生活的岁月。它似乎是为了标记寒冷月份的流逝和自然的苏醒。社群成员聚集在一起，迎接温暖与光明的回归。人们点燃篝火，在参与者之间散播鲜艳的色彩。记录还描述了分享特制的甜点、共同歌舞，以及静静观赏季节中首批花朵绽放的情景。\n\n尽管这种季节性变化在方舟号上已不复存在，但这些碎片让我们得以一窥祖先们曾经如何庆祝这一节日。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4750`

### English

The recovered data shows an old seasonal celebration from our planetary past. It appears to have marked the passing of the colder months and the awakening of nature. Communities gathered to welcome the return of warmth and light. Bonfires were lit, bright colors were spread among participants. The records also describe the sharing of special sweets, singing and dancing together, and simply watching the first blooms of the season as they appeared.\n\nThough such seasonal changes no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the fragments offer a small glimpse into how our ancestors once celebrated this fetsivity.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5655`

## arkship.1210.desc.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.b&lang=en)

### 中文

从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一个与年度周期交替相关的季节性庆典。它发生在一年中最黑暗的时期，那时白昼稀少，寒冷笼罩着星球的大部分地区。社区通过用灯光装饰房屋和公共场所来应对，将漫漫长夜变得明亮且富有节日气氛。人们聚集在一起交换礼物，分享异常丰盛的美食。\n\n方舟舰上已不再有这样的冬天，这些数据展示了我们的祖先曾经如何用温暖与光亮回应最黑暗的季节。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4751`

### English

The entry recovered from the microchip describes a seasonal celebration tied to the changing of the year's cycle. It took place during the darkest period of the year, when daylight was scarce and colder conditions dominated much of the planet. Communities responded by decorating their homes and public spaces with lights, turning the long nights into something bright and festive. People gathered to exchange gifts and share unusually rich foods.\n\nSuch winters no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the data shows how our ancestors once answered the darkest season with warmth and light.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5657`

## arkship.1210.desc.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.c&lang=en)

### 中文

该条目似乎描述了曾经在我们母星上很常见的一种个人庆祝活动。记录提到，这是一个标志着个人年度生命周期更迭的时刻。在这一天，家人和朋友会聚集在一起，为该成员及其度过的岁月举杯欢庆。这一传统似乎还包括共同分享专为此活动准备的食物。\n\n尽管方舟舰上的生活如今遵循着不同的节奏，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经每年都会停下脚步，在众生之中为每一个独立生命的延续而庆祝。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4752`

### English

The entry appears to describe a personal celebration once common on our homeworld. The records refer to an occasion marking the passing of an individual's yearly life cycle. On this day, family and friends would gather to celebrate the person and the years they had lived. The tradition seems to have involved sharing sustenance together specifically prepared for the event.\n\nThough life aboard the Arkship now follows different rhythms, the records suggest that our ancestors once paused each year to celebrate the continuation of a single life among many.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5659`

## arkship.1210.desc.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.d&lang=en)

### 中文

修复后的微芯片似乎揭示了标记新年度周期开始的庆祝活动。我们的祖先首先会打扫他们的居住空间。随着太阳周期更替的临近，各个社区聚集在一起，为最后的时刻进行倒计时。新周期的到来伴随着明亮的灯光、舞蹈和广泛的庆祝。参与者还会记录下对来年的个人意向，即旨在指导未来行动和改进的“决心”。\n\n尽管方舟舰上的生活现在遵循严格监管的周期而非行星历法，但数据表明，我们的祖先曾如何以对未来的持续希望来标记时间的流逝。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4753`

### English

The recovered microchip appears to reveal celebrations marking the beginning of a new yearly cycle. Our ancestors would first clean their living spaces. As the renewal of the sun cycle approached, communities gathered to count down the final moments. The arrival of the new cycle was greeted with bright lights, dancing, and widespread celebration. Participants also recorded personal intentions for the coming year, resolutions meant to guide their actions and improvements in the time ahead.\n\nThough life aboard the Arkship now follows carefully regulated cycles rather than planetary calendars, the data shows how our ancestors once marked the passing of time with a continuous hope for the future.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5661`

## arkship.1210.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们应当从中学习。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4754`

### English

We should learn from this.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5662`

## arkship.1210.desc.e

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.e&lang=en)

### 中文

从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一种以两人正式结合为中心的社会传统。根据记录，社群成员会聚集在一起，见证两人公开向彼此表达承诺。这些仪式通常涉及象征性的服饰、口头誓言，以及作为见证人出席的亲朋好友。\n\n虽然方舟舰上的伴侣关系通常是通过行政系统记录，而非通过繁复的仪式，但档案显示，我们的祖先曾以隆重的仪式和全社群的庆祝来纪念此类结合。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4755`

### English

The entry recovered from the microchip describes a social tradition centered on the formal union of two individuals. According to the records, communities gathered to witness the pair publicly declare their commitment to one another. These ceremonies often involved symbolic clothing, spoken vows, and the presence of family and friends acting as witnesses.\n\n While partnerships aboard the Arkship are often recorded through administrative systems rather than elaborate rituals, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked such unions with considerable ceremony and communal celebration.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5664`

## arkship.1210.desc.f

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.f&lang=en)

### 中文

从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了曾在家园行星上庆祝的一个热闹节日。参与者身着精致的服饰并佩戴面具，在庆典期间暂时换上新的身份。数据中还提到了有组织的游行，装饰华丽的平台在公共空间缓缓移动，人群则跟随其后，载歌载舞。\n\n相比之下，方舟舰上的庆祝活动要克制得多，受限于值勤周期和有限的资源。记录表明，在另一个时代，我们的祖先偶尔会抛开实用主义，转而追求场面与纵情。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4756`

### English

The record recovered from the microchip describes a lively festival once celebrated on our homeworld. Participants dressed in elaborate costumes and masks, temporarily adopting new identities for the celebration. The data also references organized processions, decorated platforms moving through public spaces while crowds followed while dancing and cheering.\n\nCelebrations aboard the Arkship are far more restrained by comparison, shaped by duty cycles and limited resources. The records suggest that, in another time, our ancestors occasionally set practicality aside in favor of spectacle and indulgence.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5666`

## arkship.1210.desc.g

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.g&lang=en)

### 中文

这枚微芯片揭示了一项来自我们物种行星时代的季节性节日记录。它似乎是在收获季节结束时举行的，当时各个社群聚集在一起，为一年中采集到的食物表达感激之情。这场庆典也标志着一年中阴暗时期的临近，届时白昼将变得稀缺，寒冷的气候亦会回归。参与者们身着令人不安的伪装，或许是为了模仿或驱散想象中的灵体。\n\n尽管方舟号的农业周期经过精心调节，我们也不再需要这些传统，但档案表明，我们的祖先曾以感恩、创意和一丝顽皮来纪念季节的更迭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4757`

### English

The microchip revealed the record of a seasonal festival from our species' planetary era. It appears to have been held at the end of the harvesting season, when communities gathered to give thanks for the food collected during the year. The celebration also marked the approach of a darker time of year, when daylight would grow scarce and colder conditions returned. Participants dressed in unsettling disguises, perhaps to imitate or ward off imagined spirits.\n\nThough the Arkship's agricultural cycles are carefully regulated, and we do not have any need for these traditions, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked the changing seasons with gratitude, creativity, and a touch of mischief.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5668`

## arkship.1210.desc.h

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.h&lang=en)

### 中文

微芯片揭示了一份文化记录。它展示了一种以缅怀逝者为中心的传统。根据数据显示，社群会为去世的亲友设立小型展示台，并用鲜花、食物以及与逝者相关的个人物品进行装饰。这种场合并非在沉默中哀悼，而似乎既有反思，又带有庆祝的色彩。\n\n虽然方舟舰上的世代表更迭已经改变了我们纪念死者的方式，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经不仅拨出时间来悲伤，也用来庆祝那些塑造了生者的生命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4758`

### English

The microchip revealed a cultural record. It showed a tradition centered on remembering those who had passed away. According to the data, communities would create small displays dedicated to deceased relatives and friends, decorating them with flowers, food, and personal items connected to the departed. Rather than mourning in silence, the occasion appears to have been both reflective and celebratory.\n\nThough generations aboard the Arkship have changed how we remember the dead, the records suggest that our ancestors once set aside time to grieve, but also to celebrate the lives that shaped those who remained.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5670`

## arkship.1210.desc.avian.reptilian

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.avian.reptilian&lang=en)

### 中文

从微芯片中恢复的记录展示了我们的祖先曾举行的一种繁育仪式。那是一场向社区展示首窝卵的聚会。在家族成员和见证者的注视下，卵被小心地放置在准备好的筑巢空间内。仪式使用了装饰性的筑巢材料和具有象征意义的贝壳排列，并举行公共宴会以庆祝血脉的延续。\n\n值得注意的是，记录表明这些产卵仪式曾经持续数周，涉及漫长的仪式和准备工作。相比之下，方舟舰上的此类事务处理得既迅速又私密，如今只需花费几个小时进行精心管理的流程即可完成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4759`

### English

The entry recovered from the microchip shows of a reproductive ceremony once practiced by our ancestors. It was a gathering during which the first clutch of eggs was presented to the community. The eggs were carefully placed within prepared nesting spaces while family members and witnesses observed. Decorative nesting materials were used as well as a symbolic arrangements of shells, and communal feasts celebrating the continuation of the lineage.\n\nNotably, the records indicate that these egg-laying ceremonies once lasted weeks, involving extended rituals and preparations. By comparison, such matters aboard the Arkship are handled quickly and privately, nowadays it occupies little more than a few hours of carefully managed procedure.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5672`

## arkship.1210.desc.fungoid.plantoid

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.fungoid.plantoid&lang=en)

### 中文

从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在繁茂生长期延续的一种公社传统。记录中提到，人们会在茂密的树丛中聚集，培育奇特而鲜艳的果实植物，各群体之间会互相走访，观摩那些格外引人注目的生长成果。不同品种被排列在一起，构成了色彩、质感与气味交织出的复杂而生动的图案。为了在聚会期间促成稀有或奇特的花朵绽放，祖先们还会刻意改变湿度、养分和光照。\n\n方舟舰上的生活几乎没有空间进行这种自发的耕作。如今，生长周期由农业系统严格监管，大多数菌株的优化目标是效率而非表达。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4760`

### English

The record recovered from the microchip describes a communal tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of abundant growth. The records refer to gatherings in dense groves where individuals would cultivate unusual and vibrant fruiting plants with colonies visiting one another to observe particularly impressive growths. Different strains were arranged together to create elaborate living patterns of color, texture, and scent. Our ancestors would deliberately alter humidity, nutrients, and light to encourage rare or unusual blooms during the gathering.\n\nLife aboard the Arkship leaves little room for such spontaneous cultivation. Growth cycles are now carefully regulated by agricultural systems, and most fungal strains are optimized for efficiency rather than expression.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5674`

## arkship.1210.desc.infernal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.infernal&lang=en)

### 中文

回收的记录描述了我们祖先传承的一项古老传统。档案中记载，人们会聚集在受控的活火坑周围，刻意将自己暴露在酷热之中，以此展示韧性与生命力。参与者将火焰塑造成复杂的图案，并向其中添加稀有气体和燃料，使火焰呈现出异乎寻常的色彩。随着火势升高，观察者们会吟唱并欢庆，将这一盛事视作奇观与集体仪式。\n\n在方舟舰上，明火受到严格管控，因为它们会对基础设施造成高度风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4761`

### English

The recovered records describe an ancient tradition practiced by our ancestors. The archive describes gatherings around controlled pits of living flame, where individuals would deliberately expose themselves to intense heat as a demonstration of resilience and vitality. Participants shaped the flames into elaborate patterns, feeding them with rare gases and fuels that caused the fire to burn in unusual colors. Observers would chant and celebrate as the flames rose higher, marking the event as both spectacle and communal ritual.\n\nAboard the Arkship, open flame is strictly regulated as they cause a high risk to infrastructure.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5676`

## arkship.1210.desc.mammalian

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.mammalian&lang=en)

### 中文

修复后的记录描述了一项围绕后代早期成长的传统。根据记载，当幼小的个体在巢穴外迈出独立的第一步时，家人们会聚集在一起。那一时刻似乎被视为一个微小但具有意义的里程碑，人们通常会通过鼓励、分享食物以诱导幼崽走出巢穴，以及亲友们的关注来予以庆祝。\n\n在方舟舰上的生活，极少允许为个人里程碑举行此类聚会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4762`

### English

The recovered entry describes a tradition centered on the early development of our offspring. According to the records, families would gather when a young individual took their first independent steps outside the den. The moment appears to have been treated as a small but meaningful milestone, often celebrated with encouragement, shared food to coax the young ones out, and the attention of relatives and friends.\n\nLife aboard the Arkship rarely allows for such gatherings around individual milestones.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5678`

## arkship.1210.desc.arthropoid

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.arthropoid&lang=en)

### 中文

从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了一项与我们祖先生命周期中的自然阶段紧密相连的传统。记录显示，在个体脱落旧外骨骼期间，人们会举行集体聚会。这些蜕皮阶段并非在隔离中进行，而是通常以仪式作为标志，旧皮有时会被装饰或保存，作为成长与新生的象征。一旦旧壳脱落，新形成的外骨骼便会被自豪地展示出来。\n\n在方舟号上，蜕皮周期通常在受控的生物设施中管理，以确保安全与效率，并配备工作人员以应对任何可能出现的并发症。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4763`

### English

The recovered entry from the microchip describes a tradition tied to a natural stage in the life cycle of our ancestors. They show communal gatherings during periods when individuals shed their old exoskeletons. Rather than occurring in isolation, these molting phases were often marked by ceremony and the old skin was sometimes decorated or preserved as symbols of growth and renewal. Once the old shells were shed, the newly formed exoskeletons were displayed with pride.\n\nAboard the Arkship, molting cycles are typically managed in controlled biological facilities to ensure safety and efficiency with staff to help if any possible complications occur.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5680`

## arkship.1210.desc.toxoid

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.toxoid&lang=en)

### 中文

这段恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在大气高度饱和时期所信奉的一种传统。人们会聚集在特备区域，刻意将体内积聚的气体和化学副产品释放到周围环境中。参与者们会相互竞争，看谁能产生最绚丽或最奇特的化学烟羽。由此产生的云雾在空气中形成了变幻莫测的色彩和反应图案。旁观者们兴致勃勃地观赏，而那些气味最刺鼻的气体往往会引起围观人群的阵阵笑声。\n\n如今在方舟舰上，大气系统严格监管此类排放，以维持安全的环境条件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4764`

### English

The recovered record describes a tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of heavy atmospheric saturation. Individuals would gather in specially prepared areas to deliberately release built-up gases and chemical byproducts into the surrounding environment. Participants would compete to produce the most vibrant or unusual chemical plumes. The resulting clouds created shifting colors and reactive patterns in the air. Spectators observed with great enthusiasm, while the most pungent gases often provoked laughter among the gathered crowd.\n\nNowadays aboard the Arkship, atmospheric systems strictly regulate such emissions to maintain safe environmental conditions.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5682`

## arkship.1210.desc.lithoid

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.lithoid&lang=en)

### 中文

恢复的记录描述了我们祖先曾践行的一种充满活力的传统。根据记载，成群的人会聚集在开阔的岩石地带，进行有组织的掷石决斗。参与者互相投掷松散的石块，试图从对手的外层击碎或削下碎片。在冲突中掉落的小碎片有时会被收集起来作为纪念品，象征着韧性与友好的竞争。\n\n在方舟舰上，此类活动显然会对基础设施构成威胁。船体完整性协议严禁投掷石块，这些竞赛早已从日常生活中消失。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4765`

### English

The recovered entry describes an energetic tradition practiced by our ancestors. According to the records, large groups would gather in open rocky fields to engage in organized stone fights. Participants hurled loose rocks at one another while attempting to crack or chip pieces from their opponents' outer layers. Small fragments broken off during the clashes were sometimes collected as keepsakes, symbols of resilience and friendly rivalry.\n\nAboard the Arkship, such activities would pose an obvious risk to infrastructure. Hull integrity protocols strongly discourage the throwing of rocks, and these contests have long since disappeared from daily life.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5684`

## arkship.1210.desc.aquatic.mulluscoid

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1210.desc.aquatic.mulluscoid&lang=en)

### 中文

回收的微芯片描述了我们的水生祖先在母星深海中延续的一种传统。个体们会聚集在一起，共同潜入比平时栖息地更深的水域。这些潜水活动既是挑战也是庆典。深水区存在着奇异的地质结构和陌生、甚至危险的生命形式，使下潜过程充满了刺激与危险。那些抵达最深处的人往往会受到众人的钦佩。\n\n方舟舰上的水生生境受到严格监管，深度因工程限制而受限。古老海洋那巨大的压力和无尽的黑暗已无法再亲身体验。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4766`

### English

The recovered microchip describes a tradition practiced by our aquatic ancestors in the depths of their world's oceans. Individuals would gather to descend together into deeper waters than normally inhabited. These dives were both a challenge and a celebration. The deeper zones contained strange geological formations and unfamiliar, sometimes even dangerous life forms, making the descent both thrilling and dangerous. Those who reached the greatest depths were often regarded with admiration.\n\nWater habitats on the Arkship are carefully regulated and depth is limited by engineering constraints. The vast pressures and endless darkness of the ancient oceans can no longer be experienced.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5686`

## arkship.1215.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1215.name&lang=en)

### 中文

真菌感染

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4767`

### English

Fungal Contamination

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5688`

## arkship.1215.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1215.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近的报告显示，一种侵入性真菌物种已蔓延至§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!的整个水培甲板。该生物似乎在方舟舰农业系统受控的湿度和营养丰富的基质中茁壮成长，在多个生产层级形成了密集的菌丝网络。\n\n遏制措施已被证明无效，因为该真菌对标准的除草处理没有产生可测量的反应。我们怀疑该物种可能已迅速适应了飞船的封闭生态系统。如果不加以控制，此次爆发可能会显著降低粮食产量，并对方舟舰有限的农业生产能力造成额外压力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4768`

### English

Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. The organism appears to thrive in the controlled humidity and nutrient-rich substrates of the arkship's agricultural systems, forming dense mycelial networks across multiple production tiers.\n\nContainment attempts have proven ineffective, as the fungus shows no measurable reaction to standard herbicidal treatments. We suspect the species may have adapted rapidly to the enclosed ecosystem of the vessel. If left unchecked, the outbreak could significantly reduce food yields and place additional strain on the arkship's limited agricultural capacity.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5689`

### English

## arkship.1220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

常规治理手段失效后，受污染的水培层进行了受控焚烧。不幸的是，方舟舰的大部分食用植物储备在此过程中损失殆尽。整个生长床随同感染物一起化为灰烬，导致数个农业区域暂时荒废。\n\n尽管如此，行动似乎已达到预定目标。随着每一个带有孢子的表面都被灭菌，剩余的基础设施也经过了彻底清除，该真菌物种已从生态系统中被永久根除。这些经验将有助于我们应对未来可能在方舟舰上落户的其他外来入侵物种。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4773`

### English

Conventional treatments having failed, the contaminated hydroponics tiers were subjected to controlled incineration. Unfortunately, much of the arkship's edible plant stock was lost in the process. Entire growth beds were reduced to ash alongside the infestation, leaving several agricultural sections temporarily barren.\n\nStill, the operation appears to have achieved its objective. With every spore-bearing surface sterilized and the remaining infrastructure thoroughly purged, the fungal species has been eradicated from the ecosystem for good. This knowledge will help us prepare for any other invasive species that might decide to settle on the arkship in the future.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5695`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5698`

## arkship.1225.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1225.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!上的入侵物种通过一个分布式的真菌菌丝网络运作，该网络能够迅速隔离并牺牲个体节段。每当我们尝试提取活体样本时，周围的生长物几乎会瞬间枯萎，其养分似乎通过网络被重新定向，用于保证在水耕平台的其他区域发出新芽。\n\n在经历了多次失败的尝试后，我们终于成功分离出了一个足够稳定的样本进行受控观察。这种真菌拥有极高效率的养分再分配系统，这种系统可能适用于方舟上的闭环生态环境，甚至可能在模仿我们自己的分配系统。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4776`

### English

The invasive species on §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! operates through a distributed mycelial network capable of rapidly isolating and sacrificing individual segments. Whenever we attempted to extract living samples, the surrounding growth would wither almost instantly, its nutrients seemingly redirected through the network to fuel new blooms elsewhere in the hydroponics decks.\n\nAfter numerous failed attempts, we finally managed to isolate a sufficiently stable sample for controlled observation. The fungus possesses an extraordinarily efficient nutrient redistribution system, one that may have applications in closed ecological environments such as those aboard the arkship, perhaps even copying our own distribution systems.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5699`

### English

## arkship.1230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对真菌生长的进一步实验揭示了一种异常的化学反应。该生物体暴露于特定化合物时，会迅速代谢这些添加物，并释放出一种独特的混合气体副产物。我们意识到，这些气体可以被收集并提炼。\n\n这种真菌能有效地将简单的化学输入转化为稳定的挥发性化合物流，这是一个意料之外但可能很有用的过程。通过在隔离室中培养受控的真菌生长，我们相信该生物体可以被重新利用为一个小型的生化处理系统。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4780`

### English

Further experimentation with the fungal growth has revealed an unusual chemical reaction. When exposed to specific compounds, the organism rapidly metabolizes the additives and releases a distinct mixture of gaseous byproducts. We realized that these fumes could be harvested and refined.\n\nThe fungus effectively converts simple chemical inputs into a steady stream of volatile compounds, an unexpected but potentially useful process. By cultivated controlled fungal growth in isolated chambers, we believe that the organism could be repurposed as a small-scale biochemical processing system.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5704`

### English

### English

## arkship.1235.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1235.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对真菌生长的进一步观察揭示了一些规律，表明其庞大的菌丝网络内部存在某种形式的生物信号传输。对大多数物种而言，这种行为或许微不足道，但我们自身的生物特性使我们能够识别并适应这种微妙的交流。\n\n通过引入精心校准的生化信号，我们与该生物体建立了初步的对话。从那时起，它开始通过其网络重新分配养分，并保护农作物免受有害微生物的侵害。很快我们便意识到，我们曾以为的入侵，已演变成与花园中另一种生命形式之间富有意义的共生关系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4783`

### English

Closer observation of the fungal growth has revealed patterns that suggest a form of biological signaling within its vast mycelial network. To most species this behavior might seem insignificant, but our own biology allows us to recognize and adapt to the subtle exchange.\n\nBy introducing carefully calibrated biochemical signals, we established a rudimentary dialogue with the organism. Since then it has begun redistributing nutrients through its networks and shielding crops from harmful microbes. Soon we realized that what we thought was an intrusion became soon a meaningful symbiosis with another lifeform sharing our gardens.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5708`

## arkship.1240.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1240.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们的每月库存盘点中，我们发现§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!资源系统中存在持续性的偏差。电力、消费品和其他物资的损耗量小幅超过了我们的记录使用量。专家们认为这可能是泄漏、故障，或者是数据上微小的误差。\n\n在进一步调查后，结果仍无定论。没有破口，没有故障，也没有超出可接受范围的低效。然而，数据依然如故。资源继续在毫无解释的情况下从系统中消失。方舟号上的某种东西正在消耗我们的资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4793`

### English

During our monthly stock takes, we have found a persistent discrepancy in the §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! resource systems. Small amount of electricity, consumer goods, and other supplies are being taken at levels exceeding our recorded usage. Experts suggest a leak or malfunction, or a slight discrepancy in the numbers.\n\nAfter investigating further, the results remain inconclusive. No breaches, no failures, no inefficiencies beyond acceptable thresholds. And yet, the numbers remain unchanged. Resources continue to vanish from the system without explanation. Something aboard the Arkship was consuming our resources.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5722`

造册之外的世代

### English

Unaccounted Generation

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5726`

## arkship.1245.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1245.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在方舟飞船一个无人监控的区域内，我们发现了一群生活在官方体制之外的年轻人。他们利用私自引流的电力、空气和食物，创造了自己的空间，并在不受监管的情况下进行实验、改造环境以及表达自我。\n\n研究表明，这是青少年发育过程中的自然现象。面对调查，他们表现得十分惊讶，并带有抵触情绪。他们声称只索取了少量的资源，且行事非常谨慎，足以避开即时检测。他们明确表示，无意放弃这片空间，并希望不被打扰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4797`

### English

In an unmonitored section of the Arkship, we discovered a group of young individuals living outside official systems. Drawing on diverted power, air, and food, they have created their own space, experimenting, modifying their surroundings, and expressing themselves beyond supervision.\n\n Research suggests that it is a natural part of the development process of adolescents. They appeared genuinely surprised by the investigation and acted rebelliously. They claimed to have taken only small amounts, carefully enough to avoid immediate detection. They made it clear that they have no intention of giving up this space, and wish to be left alone.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5727`

## arkship.1250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个被遗忘的维护区域，调查人员发现了一群仍在执行古老指令的过时劳工无人机。它们的日常运作似乎早于数次系统更新，导致它们在当前日志协议之外运行，且仅需极少资源即可维持运作。\n\n进一步检查揭示了它们持续活动的成果：大量精炼合金在多个周期中被细致地加工并储存起来。这些无人机一直在悄无声息地收集并优化资源，其规模已远远超出了当前的任何运作需求。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4801`

### English

In a forgotten maintenance sector, investigators discovered a cluster of outdated worker drones still operating under ancient directives. Their routines appear to predate several system updates, causing them to function outside current logging protocols while only requiring a small amount of resources to function.\n\nFurther inspection revealed the result of their continued activity: a substantial stockpile of refined alloys had been meticulously processed and stored over many cycles. The drones had been quietly gathering and optimizing resources far beyond any current operational requirement.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5732`

### English

## arkship.1255.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1255.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在方舟舰一个僻静的区域，我们发现了一个在官方系统之外运行的隐秘疗养所。被挪用的电力、消费品和水资源支撑着这个专为休养和恢复而设计的受控环境。\n\n在场的人对于被发现几乎没有表现出担忧，他们解释说，这个空间的意义在于脱离对产出和展示效率的持续关注，是从飞船日常生活中逃离的避风港。尽管方舟舰旨在满足所有需求，但仍有人在寻觅一个纯粹用于放松的地方。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4805`

### English

In a secluded section of the Arkship, we uncovered a hidden wellness retreat operating outside official systems. Diverted power, consumer goods, and water sustain this controlled environment designed for rest and recovery.\n\nThose present showed little concern at being discovered, explaining the space was meant to exist beyond constant need to focus on output and show off efficiency, an escape from the routines of ship life. Even though the Arkship was meant to fulfill every need, some still seek a place meant for pure relaxation.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5737`

### English

## arkship.1260.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1260.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在方舟舰一个僻静的区域，我们发现了一个未被记录的定期聚会社体。少量被挪用的资源被用于布置这些会议场所。\n\n成员们将这些会议描述为一种非正式的交流活动，核心是围绕方舟舰在收割作业期间收集的标本，例如从勘测星系中获取的矿物、矿石碎片和晶体结构。参与者们会检查并讨论他们的发现，比较成分并争论其起源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4809`

### English

In a quiet section of the Arkship, we uncovered an undocumented community gathering at regular intervals. The small amount of diverted resources had been used to accommodate these meetings.\n\nMembers described the sessions as an informal exchange centered around specimens collected during the Arkship's harvesting operations, such as minerals, ore fragments, and crystalline formations pulled from surveyed systems. Participants would examine and discuss their findings, comparing compositions and debating their origins.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5742`

### English

Contingency Hoard

## arkship.1265.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1265.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个密封的储藏室内，我们发现了一处私藏的补给点：各种消费品、氧气罐和能量电池。所有物资都经过精心囤积，并避开了官方库存系统的记录。\n\n责任人很快被找到，他们给出的解释很简单：未雨绸缪。他们辩解称，在一个生存完全依赖于稳定性的系统中，如果理所当然地认为稳定性会永远持续下去，那才是真正的失职。从这批囤积物资的规模来看，这显然是远超个人用途的长期计划。方舟舰上并非所有人都有信心它能永存。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4813`

### English

In a sealed storage compartment, we uncovered a private cache of supplies: consumer goods, air canisters, and power cells all carefully stockpiled and hidden from official inventory systems.\n\nThe individuals responsible were quickly found and offered a simple explanation: preparation. In a system where survival depends entirely on stability, they argued, it would be irresponsible to assume that stability is guaranteed forever. The scale of the hoard suggests long-term planning, far beyond personal use. Not all aboard the Arkship are confident that it will endure forever.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5747`

### 中文

全部回收

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4816`

### English

Total Reclamation

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5751`

## arkship.1270.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1270.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个封闭的处理区，调查人员发现了一个未登记的回收系统，该系统旨在将生物遗骸转化为可用材料。该系统一直在持续运行，远远超出了其预设的应急功能。\n\n尽管效率很高，但该过程耗资巨大。大量的能源、化学催化剂和加工材料被挪用，用于对有机物进行分解、消毒和提炼，将其转化为标准化产物，以便在方舟号内重复使用。方舟舰上的任何东西都不应被浪费。即便是死者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4817`

### English

In a sealed processing sector, investigators uncovered an unregistered reclamation system, one designed to convert biological remains into usable materials. The system has been operating continuously, far beyond its intended emergency function.\n\nWhile efficient, the process is resource-intensive. Large amounts of energy, chemical catalysts, and processing materials have been diverted to break down, sterilize, and refine organic matter into standardized outputs for reuse within the Arkship. Nothing on the Arkship should be wasted. Not even the dead.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5752`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5756`

## arkship.1275.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1275.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

沿着资源流失的痕迹，我们发现了方舟舰上一处长期被忽视的区域。显然，那里生活着一个脱离官方系统、与世隔绝的小型社区。他们的居所十分简陋，依靠窃取资源维持生存，但由于窃取的量极小，一直未被察觉。\n\n尽管处境艰辛，那里的环境却很稳定，维护得十分用心，并针对他们的需求进行了改造。显而易见，这是一种深思熟虑的生活方式。他们没有做出任何反抗，反而请求解释他们的选择。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4821`

### English

Following the traces of the disappearing resources, we found a long-overlooked section of the Arkship. Apparently there was a small isolated community living outside official systems. Their habitat was simple, sustained by siphoned resources, taken in amounts small enough to avoid detection.\n\nDespite their circumstances, the environment was stable, attentively maintained, and adapted to their needs. It was clear this was a very deliberate way of living. They offered no resistance and instead asked to explain their choice.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5757`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1280.name&lang=en)

### 中文

生活的其它之道

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4825`

### English

A Different Way of Living

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5762`

## arkship.1280.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1280.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

那群与世隔绝的人公开谈论了他们的决定。他们并非拒绝方舟舰，而是无法接受其中演变出的生活方式。在他们看来，生存已经变得过度优化：每一项行动都被衡量，每一份资源都被追踪，每一刻时光都被精算。\n\n他们描述了一种对方舟舰体制的不同见解。他们看重在不受持续监管的情况下做出选择的自由。他们声称，自己的生活方式虽然效率较低，但更加充实。我们的领导层中，有些人现在开始质疑，这类群体的存在究竟是对凝聚力的威胁，还是封闭系统中个性表达的必要体现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4826`

### English

The isolated group spoke openly about their decision. They did not reject the Arkship but they said that the way life within it had evolved. To them, existence had become overly optimized: every action measured, every resource tracked, and every moment accounted for.\n\nThey described a different approach to the mechanism of the Arkship. They valued the freedom to make choices outside of constant oversight. Their way of life was less efficient, but more fulfilling, they claimed. Some among our leadership now questioned whether such communities represented a risk to cohesion, or a necessary expression of individuality within a closed system.

### 中文

The following resources are collected:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_energy$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_minerals$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_food$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_alloys$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_consumer_goods$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_rare_crystals$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_exotic_gases$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $r_volatile_motes$

## concept_star_luminosity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aconcept_star_luminosity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

光度是指恒星所发出的辐射和光线的强度，影响着恒星的分类、恒星系温度以及宜居星球可能性。\n\n§E$luminosity_0$§!\n—$pc_black_hole$\n—$pc_t_star$\n—$pc_protostar$\n\n§E$luminosity_1$§! \n—$pc_m_star$ \n—$pc_m_giant_star$ \n\n§E$luminosity_2$§! \n—$pc_g_star$ \n—$pc_k_star$ \n\n§E$luminosity_3$§! \n—$pc_b_star$ \n—$pc_a_star$ \n—$pc_f_star$ \n\n§E$luminosity_4$§! \n—$pc_neutron_star$ \n—$pc_pulsar$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4870`

### English

Luminosity is the measure of how much radiation and light a star emits, influencing stellar classification, system temperature, and habitability potential. \n\n§E$luminosity_0$§! \n- $pc_black_hole$ \n- $pc_t_star$ \n- $pc_protostar$ \n\n§E$luminosity_1$§! \n- $pc_m_star$ \n- $pc_m_giant_star$ \n\n§E$luminosity_2$§! \n- $pc_g_star$ \n- $pc_k_star$ \n\n§E$luminosity_3$§! \n- $pc_b_star$ \n- $pc_a_star$ \n- $pc_f_star$ \n\n§E$luminosity_4$§! \n- $pc_neutron_star$ \n- $pc_pulsar$

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5818`

该物种诞生于$arkship_cap$，在世代循环中不断提炼知识，每一代都在上一代的基础上进行改进，以满足其船只的独特需求。

### 中文

这些机器专为居住在$arkship_cap$内而设计，持续监测其内部应力、流量和常规运作。不同的方舟舰设计会产生不同的模式，而它们会不断迭代优化自身行为，以适应其所居住的舰船。

### English

Designed to live within the $arkship_cap$, these machines continuously map its internal stresses, flows, and routines. Different arkship designs produce different patterns, and they iteratively optimize their behavior to match the vessel they inhabit.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5839`

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4947`

### English

Drifters and Settlers

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5908`

## nomads.7005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.7005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§!在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停泊了足够长的时间，船员与当地人已对彼此有了充分的了解。现在，双方都有少数人请求互换归宿：定居者渴望拥抱无垠的虚空，而漂泊者则向往脚下坚实的土地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4948`

### English

§Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§! has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to take measure of one another. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled folk eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground beneath their feet.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5909`

## nomads.7005.desc.forever_cruise

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.7005.desc.forever_cruise&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§!已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，以至于新鲜感开始喜忧参半。少数乘客在各个停靠港之间焦躁不安，请求永久下船定居；而下方，当地人则在订票柜台前排队，争抢船上的任何一个铺位，渴望亲身体验宣传册中承诺的种种奇观。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4949`

### English

§Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§! has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for the novelty to cut both ways. A handful of passengers, restless between ports of call, ask to be set ashore for good; below, locals queue at the booking desk for any berth aboard, eager to taste the wonders the brochures promised.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5910`

## nomads.7005.desc.servitor

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.7005.desc.servitor&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的活体陈设与[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的人口已开始在我们船体边界两侧进行温和的接触。他们中有些人请求登上§Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§!避难；我们中也有些人渴望感受开阔的天空。或许允许这场迁徙，能最大化有机体的福祉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4950`

### English

Our bio-trophies and the population of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] have begun gentle overtures across our hulls' boundary. Some of theirs ask sanctuary aboard §Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§!; some of ours wish to taste open sky. Perhaps we would maximize organic well-being by allowing the migration.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5911`

## nomads.7005.desc.same_species

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Anomads.7005.desc.same_species&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§!已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，船员与当地人都已认出彼此的血缘亲情。如今，双方各有少数人请求互换铺位：已定居的表亲渴望奔赴广阔虚空，漂泊者则被亲族所在的坚实土地所吸引。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4951`

### English

§Y[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]§! has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to recognize their kinship. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled cousins eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground among family.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5912`

## arkship.1300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的高级工程队提交了一份结构评估报告，该报告呼吁已不能再拖延。我们的家园急需修缮。\n\n该提案是全面的：分段轮流大修，从发电基础设施开始，然后依次进行耕作甲板、防御区和居住区。居民需要暂时搬迁。设施将停止运行。工程估算显示，根据工作进度，全面检修大约需要十到十一个标准年。\n\n这项工作将具有破坏性。但另一种选择是，这艘船每经过一个秒差距，可靠性就会降低一分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4987`

### English

The senior engineering corps aboard Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! has submitted a structural assessment that can no longer be deferred. Our home is in critical need of repair.\n\nThe proposal is comprehensive: a rotating section-by-section overhaul, beginning with the power generation infrastructure and working through the cultivation decks, the defense section, and the residential districts in sequence. Residents will need to be temporarily relocated. Facilities will be taken offline. Engineering estimates place the full overhaul at approximately ten to eleven standard years, depending on the pace of work.\n\nThe work will be disruptive. But the alternative is a vessel that grows less reliable with every parsec.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5957`

## arkship.1300.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1300.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的诊断子程序已标记出主结构子系统的关键阈值。方舟舰急需维修。\n\n修复协议要求对各区段进行轮流大修。发电节点、种植区、防御基础设施和居住区将依次离线进行全面重建。在此过程中，运行连续性将有所下降。预计完成时间：以标准运行速度计算，约一百三十个月。\n\n修复不可推迟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4988`

### English

Diagnostic subroutines aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have flagged critical thresholds across primary structural subsystems. The Arkship is in critical need of repair.\n\nRemediation protocols mandate a rotating sector-by-sector overhaul. Power generation nodes, cultivation sectors, defense infrastructure, and residential zones will each be taken offline in sequence for comprehensive reconstruction. Operational continuity will be degraded during the process. Estimated completion timeline: approximately one hundred and thirty months at standard operational tempo.\n\nRemediation cannot be deferred.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5958`

## arkship.1300.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1300.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

集体意识到方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的状况正在恶化：承重结构在不该弯曲的地方弯曲；电力管道正在腐蚀。数代人的累积疏忽已经达到我们无法再拖延的程度。\n\n我们需要一个全面的更新周期：逐段进行，从动力节点向外，依次经过补给舱、防御外壳和居住甲板。随着工程的进行，各个区段将被封闭，其居民将被迁离。更新周期将持续十到十一个标准年。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4989`

### English

The collective is aware of deterioration in Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!: load-bearing structures flex where they should not; power veins corrode. The accumulated neglect of generations has reached a threshold we can no longer defer.\n\nWe require a comprehensive renewal cycle: section by section, from the power-nodes outward through the feeding chambers, the defensive carapace, and the residential decks in sequence. Sections will be sealed and their inhabitants displaced as the work progresses. The renewal cycle will span ten to eleven standard years.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5959`

## arkship.1305.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1305.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

发电基础设施已通过认证并恢复满负荷运行。施工人员已将设备运往较低的农业层。\n\n种植平台将逐段停用。这不仅是一项结构性挑战，也是一项后勤挑战：食物储备需要精心管理，建筑残渣将在公共区域滞留数月。\n\n工程师们说，最难的部分不是焊接，而是等待。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4998`

### English

The power generation infrastructure has been certified and brought back to full output. Construction crews are already moving equipment down to the lower agricultural levels.\n\nThe cultivation decks will be taken offline section by section. It is not only a structural challenge but a logistical one: food stores will need careful management, and construction residue will linger in the common areas for months.\n\nThe hardest part, the engineers say, is not the welding. It is the waiting.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5969`

## arkship.1305.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1305.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

发电修复已通过认证并恢复到正常输出。运营范围现在转移到第二部门基础设施。\n\n指定区域将按顺序离线进行结构大修。受影响部门的运营输出在此过程中将按比例下降。\n\n修复工作继续在预计参数内进行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4999`

### English

Power generation remediation has been certified complete and nominal output restored. Operational scope now transfers to secondary sector infrastructure.\n\nDesignated zones will be taken offline in sequence for structural overhaul. Operational output in the affected sector will decline proportionally during the process.\n\nRemediation continues within projected parameters.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5970`

## arkship.1305.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1305.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

发电机组全面恢复供电。\n\n我们的注意力转向内部，看向维持殖民地运作的巨大供养仓。飞船上的培养槽和营养循环器官必须依次离线，进行结构翻新。食物储备已准备就绪，以弥补期间的不足。\n\n在殖民地的“胃”重建期间，它将依靠储备食物维生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5000`

### English

Power generation resumes at full impact.\n\nOur attention shifts inward, to the great feeding chambers that sustain the colony. The cultivation vats and nutrient-cycling organs of the ship must be taken offline in sequence for structural renewal. Food stores have been prepared to buffer the deficit.\n\nThe colony will feed from reserves while its stomach is rebuilt.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5971`

## arkship.1310.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1310.name&lang=en)

### 中文

防御区段

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5007`

### English

The Defense Section

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5979`

## arkship.1310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着种植甲板重建和粮食生产恢复正常，注意力转向了前线防御区。从武器舱到维修走廊，一切都已勘测完毕，都需要进行维修。\n\n在此阶段，海军战备将受到限制。负责确保飞船安全的船员们被要求暂时离开，因为他们的工作区域正在被拆开和重新组装。\n\n据大多数说法，他们对此表现出了非凡的耐心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5008`

### English

With the cultivation decks rebuilt and food production returning to normal, attention shifts to the forward defense section. From the weapons bays to maintenance corridors, everything has been surveyed, and all of it needs work.\n\nNaval readiness will be limited during this phase. The crews responsible for keeping the ship safe are being asked to step aside while their workspace is taken apart and put back together.\n\nThey have, by most accounts, been remarkably patient about it.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5980`

## arkship.1310.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1310.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

二级部门修复已完成。部门产出正恢复到运行基线。修复范围现已转向前方防御基础设施。\n\n武器舱、维护网络和安全部门设施将按顺序离线。在此阶段，海军战备指标将下降。\n\n修复工作按预计参数继续进行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5009`

### English

Secondary sector remediation is complete. Sector output is returning to operational baselines. Remediation scope now shifts to forward defense infrastructure.\n\nWeapons bays, maintenance networks, and security sector facilities will be taken offline in sequence. Naval readiness metrics will decline during this phase.\n\nRemediation continues within projected parameters.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5981`

## arkship.1310.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1310.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

饲养室得到更新，蜂群殖民地的饥饿感得以持续。\n\n现在，我们的注意力转向甲壳：构成舰船外部防御的武器电池、维修巢穴和兵营。所有这些都必须拆除重建。战斗准备状态将会减弱。\n\n集体接受这种暂时的脆弱性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5010`

### English

The feeding chambers are renewed and the colony's hunger sustained.\n\nOur attention now turns to the carapace: the weapons batteries, maintenance warrens, and barracks that form the vessel's outer defense. All must be stripped back and rebuilt. Combat readiness will diminish.\n\nThe collective accepts this temporary vulnerability.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5982`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1315.name&lang=en)

### 中文

生活区

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5016`

### English

The Living Quarters

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5989`

## arkship.1315.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1315.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

防御区已经检查完毕，加固并重新投入使用。负责这项工作的船员们看起来，如果非要说的话，松了一口气，终于又有事情可做了。\n\n现在进入最后阶段：城市区本身。构成方舟舰生命核心的住宅区、市政厅和商业走廊。其他一切都是基础设施。这是居民们称之为家的地方。\n\n施工围栏将最后一次竖起。胜利在望。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5017`

### English

The defense section has been inspected, reinforced, and returned to service. The crews working on it looked, if anything, relieved to have something useful to do again.\n\nNow comes the final phase: the city districts themselves. The residential blocks, civic halls, and commercial corridors that constitute the living heart of the arkship. Everything else was infrastructure. This is the place inhabitants call home.\n\nConstruction barriers will go up one last time. The end is in sight.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5990`

## arkship.1315.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1315.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

防御区段的修复已确认完成。海军战备指标正恢复到基线水平。行动范围现在转向住宅和市政区基础设施。\n\n单位处理通道将按顺序离线进行最终检修。受影响区域将需要人口疏散。\n\n修复工作进入最后阶段。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5018`

### English

Defense sector remediation is certified complete. Naval readiness metrics are returning to baseline. Operational scope now shifts to residential and civic district infrastructure.\n\nUnit processing corridors will be taken offline in sequence for final overhaul. Population displacement will be required in affected sectors.\n\nRemediation enters its final phase.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5991`

## arkship.1315.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1315.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

甲壳已经硬化，集体的准备状态也已恢复。\n\n更新现在转向其最后的工作：育婴室、公共筑巢地穴和连接通道，它们构成了飞船的生命核心。这些空间是殖民地睡觉、繁殖和聚集的地方。在我们从内部重建时，一些区域将被封闭。\n\n更新周期即将结束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5019`

### English

The carapace is hardened and the collective's readiness restored.\n\nThe renewal turns now to its final work: the brood chambers, communal nesting warrens, and bonding corridors that form the living heart of the vessel. The spaces where the colony sleeps, breeds, and gathers. Sections will be sealed as we rebuild from within.\n\nThe end of the renewal cycle draws near.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5992`

### 中文

### English

Sector Allocation Disputes

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:5999`

## arkship.1320.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1320.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于住宅层因结构调查而被封锁，工程团队已开始了一项令人头疼的任务，即在飞船的其余部分重新安置数千名居民。最初有序的流程已演变为相互竞争的排队、管辖权争议，以及至少一份关于无法进入水培舱一个特别受欢迎区域的正式投诉。\n\n飞船的社会协调员正在请求指导。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5026`

### English

With the residential levels sealed for structural survey, engineering teams have begun the unenviable task of redistributing thousands of inhabitants across the rest of the ship. What began as an orderly process has devolved into competing queues, jurisdiction disputes, and at least one formal complaint about lost access to a particularly beloved section of the hydroponics bay.\n\nThe ship's social coordinators are requesting guidance.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6000`

## arkship.1320.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1320.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

单位向可用作战区域的重新部署遇到了处理瓶颈。单位正在做出实时决策以弥补，导致优先级冲突。再部署节点的效率指标已下降。\n\n需要指导。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5027`

### English

The redistribution of units to available operational zones has encountered processing bottlenecks. Units are making real-time decisions to compensate, leading to clashing prioritization. Efficiency metrics have declined across redistribution junctions.\n\nGuidance is required.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6001`

## arkship.1320.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1320.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

子个体的迁移扰乱了蜂群的凝聚力。由于流离失所的子个体在过度拥挤的次要区域争夺筑巢区和工作分配，领地本能显现出来。在整个临时住所中都可以检测到压力和不安的信息素痕迹。\n\n蜂群需要指导。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5028`

### English

The displacement of drones has unsettled the colony's cohesion. Territorial instincts assert themselves as displaced drones contest nesting zones and work assignments in the overcrowded secondary areas. Pheromone traces of stress and agitation are detectable throughout the temporary quarters.\n\nThe colony requires direction.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6002`

## arkship.1325.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1325.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

拆除发电机区的导管套管后，发现了一些原始图纸中没有显示的东西：一段三米长的结构主梁，出现了严重的疲劳断裂。材料测定表明，这种损坏已经存在了几十年，但一直未被发现。\n\n扩大施工范围以解决损坏问题将需要额外的时间。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5033`

### English

Removal of conduit casings in the generator district revealed something none of the original schematics showed: a three-meter section of structural spine exhibiting advanced fatigue fracturing. Material dating suggests the damage has been present, undetected, for decades.\n\nExpanding the scope of construction to address the damage will take additional time.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6008`

## arkship.1330.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1330.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

未受持续翻新工程影响的居民抱怨不得不与搬迁人员共用住所。\n\n他们要求增加资源分配，优先使用娱乐设施，并立即移除一个自动化广播系统，该系统每三小时提醒他们，他们的不便是“暂时的且受到感谢的”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5038`

### English

Residents of sections unaffected by the ongoing refurbishment are complaining at having to share quarters with relocated individuals.\n\nThey are requesting expanded resource allocations, priority access to recreation facilities, and the immediate removal of an automated announcement system that reminds them, every three hours, that their disruption is 'temporary and appreciated.'

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6014`

## arkship.1330.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1330.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

由于人口重新分配，分配给过度拥挤的次级区域的单位凝聚力读数已显著下降。生产力产出低于最佳阈值。预测模型表明，如果不进行干预，这种趋势将恶化。\n\n已建议有针对性地分配额外资源以恢复基线凝聚力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5039`

### English

Cohesion readings among units assigned to overcrowded secondary zones have declined measurably since the population redistribution. Productivity outputs are tracking below optimal thresholds. Predictive models indicate the trend will worsen without intervention.\n\nA targeted allocation of additional resources has been recommended to restore baseline cohesion.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6015`

## arkship.1330.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1330.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

过度拥挤的次级筑巢区信息素应激水平自迁徙开始以来稳步上升。被迁集群和常驻种群之间的领土紧张关系显著加剧。随着本能骚动在受影响区域蔓延，蜂巢的集体生产力正在下降。\n\n已建议增加补充资源以缓解拥挤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5040`

### English

Pheromone stress levels in the overcrowded secondary nesting zones have risen steadily since the relocation began. Territorial tension between displaced clusters and resident populations is measurably elevated. The hive's collective productivity is declining as instinctive agitation spreads through the affected sectors.\n\nSupplemental resources have been recommended to ease the crowding.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6016`

## arkship.1335.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1335.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为赶上施工进度，首席工程师提议实行三班倒，24小时不间断施工。施工区域附近的住宅区报告称，噪音水平已导致居民连续十一天难以休息。三名施工人员已因疲劳相关事故接受治疗。\n\n施工队本身也出现了疲劳的迹象。虽然速度可能更快了，但负责人对疲惫的施工队所完成的工作质量并不抱太大信心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5052`

### English

To maintain the construction schedule, the lead engineer has proposed running three overlapping shifts around the clock. The residential decks adjacent to the work zone report noise levels that have made rest nearly impossible for eleven straight days. Three crew members have been treated for fatigue-related incidents.\n\nThe construction crews themselves are showing signs of strain. Faster, perhaps, but those in charge are not confident in the quality of work produced by exhausted crews.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6029`

## arkship.1335.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1335.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

为维持进度，已在所有活跃工区施工单位中提出连续作业周期。来自邻近居民区的噪声和振动数据显示，持续干扰已超过容忍阈值。已记录到多起设备运行故障。\n\n质量保证指标正与周期延长成比例下降。连续作业虽然更快，但错误率显著增加。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5053`

### English

To maintain schedule, a continuous-operation cycle has been proposed across all construction units in the active work zone. Noise and vibration data from adjacent residential sectors indicate sustained disruption above tolerance thresholds. Several unit operational failures have been logged.\n\nQuality assurance metrics are declining proportionally to cycle extension. Continuous operation is faster but increases error rates measurably.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6030`

## arkship.1335.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1335.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

为维持更新周期，活跃施工区域的无人机已被指示长时间运行。相邻筑巢区的振动和噪音水平已连续十一个周期超出可容忍阈值。几架无人机已出现疲劳性故障迹象。\n\n持续工作确实加快了施工速度，但群体的生物极限对工作质量造成了可衡量的损失。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5054`

### English

To maintain the renewal cycle, the drones in the active construction zone has been directed to operate for prolonged periods. Vibration and noise levels in adjacent nesting areas have exceeded tolerable thresholds for eleven consecutive cycles. Several drones have shown signs of exhaustion-related breakdown.\n\nContinuous labor drives construction faster, but the colony's biological limits impose a measurable cost in work quality.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6031`

## arkship.1340.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1340.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一根主电源导管在拆除旧外壳时破裂。整个区域，包括住宅层、次级医务室和两个食品加工单元，现在仅靠应急照明运行。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]认为，有可能在几个月内恢复全部电力。或者，可以通过绕过导管的路径，从相邻的发电机组获取电力。这种方法更快，但这会在电网中引入一个永久性的应急改动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5064`

### English

A primary power conduit has ruptured during removal of the old casing. The entire section, including the residential levels, the secondary medical bay, and two food processing units, is now running on emergency lighting only.\n\nOur [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] believe it will be possible to restore full power within a few months. Alternatively, the conduit's routing can be bypassed, drawing from an adjacent generator cluster instead. Faster, but it introduces a permanent workaround into the power grid.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6042`
