## arkship.1345.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1345.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

项目首席结构工程师提交了一份正式担忧：目前的工期虽然可以实现，但产出的工作成果[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]本人不会认证为合格。\n\n非关键连接点正在被密封而不是适当加固。公差裕度被设定为“可接受”而非“推荐”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5070`

### English

The project's lead structural engineer has submitted a formal concern: the current timeline, while achievable, is producing work [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] would not personally certify as complete.\n\nNon-critical junction points are being sealed over rather than properly reinforced. Tolerance margins are being set to 'acceptable' rather than 'recommended.'

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6049`

## arkship.1345.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1345.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

质量保证监督子程序已标记出一个结构性问题：当前的施工参数在最低容差阈值内运行，而非推荐规格。非关键连接节点正在被结项，而非优化。长期结构余量预测低于首选目标。\n\n已登记正式日志条目。未显示即时故障风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5071`

### English

The quality assurance oversight subroutine has flagged a structural concern: current construction parameters are operating within minimum tolerance thresholds rather than recommended specifications. Non-critical junction nodes are being finalized rather than optimized. Long-term structural margin projections are below preferred targets.\n\nA formal log entry has been registered. No immediate failure risk is indicated.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6050`

## arkship.1345.desc.hive

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5072`

### English

The current pace of refurbishment is producing work at the minimum viable threshold, not the recommended specification. Junction nodes are being sealed in place rather than properly reinforced. ## arkship.1350.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1350.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

首个完成大修的区段已被宣布结构上合格，并获准重新使用。这项工作确实令人印象深刻：新的框架、现代化的管道、以及绝不会一碰即碎的绝缘材料。\n\n工程团队渴望继续推进。居民们也迫不及待地想搬回来。然而，全套系统测试尚未完成。需要做出一个决定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5078`

### English

The first section to complete its overhaul has been declared structurally certified and cleared for reoccupation. The work is genuinely impressive: new framing, modernized conduits, insulation that doesn't crumble at the touch.\n\nThe engineering team is eager to push forward. Residents are clamoring to move back in. However, the full battery of systems tests hasn't been completed. A decision will need to be made.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6058`

## arkship.1350.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1350.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

一次重大结构翻修已经完成。初步认证表明该区段符合最低重新占用标准。全面的诊断测试规程仍未完成。重大入住后故障的可能性较低但并非可以忽略。\n\n无论是否完成诊断，都需要授权才能继续。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5079`

### English

A major structural refurbishment is complete. Initial certification indicates the sector meets minimum reoccupation standards. Full diagnostic testing protocols remain outstanding. Probability of significant post-occupancy failure is low but non-negligible.\n\nAuthorization is required to proceed with or without complete diagnostics.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6059`

## arkship.1350.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1350.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

首个完成结构更新的区段已通过初步检查。它达到了重新使用的最低门槛。其重建系统的完整生物验证周期尚未完成。重新使用后的故障概率很低，但并非可以忽略不计。\n\n从该区域撤离的无人机已在屏障处施压。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5080`

### English

The first section to complete its structural renewal has been cleared by initial inspection. It meets the minimum threshold for reoccupation. The full biological verification cycle for its rebuilt systems has not yet been completed. Failure probability after reoccupation is low, but not negligible.\n\nThe drones displaced from this section are already pressing at the barriers.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6060`

## arkship.1355.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1355.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

项目主管已经编制了最终的维修清单：在正式结构签收前还有四十七个未完成项目。清单上的项目范围很广，从重要的，例如后部区域的三个承重连接升级，到美观性的，包括十九处面板未对齐和一处通风格栅装反了。\n\n完成清单上的每一项都需要额外的时间。但这份清单之所以存在，正是因为这些事情很重要。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5086`

### English

The project supervisor has compiled the final list of repairs: forty-seven outstanding items before formal structural sign-off. The list ranges from the significant, such as three load-bearing junction upgrades in the aft section, to the cosmetic, including nineteen instances of misaligned paneling and one ventilation grille installed upside-down.\n\nCompleting every item on the list will take additional time. But the list exists precisely because these things matter.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6067`

## arkship.1355.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1355.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

质量保证协议已经生成了一份补救清单，其中包含四十七项待正式认证的项目。这些项目从结构重要性（如接点加固）到外观面板对齐都有涉及。\n\n全面完成将需要延长运营时间。只涵盖结构项目，形成一个次优化的分项认证是一个可选方案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5087`

### English

Quality assurance protocols have generated a remediation checklist of forty-seven outstanding items pending formal certification. Items range from structural significance, such as junction reinforcement, to cosmetic panel alignment.\n\nFull completion will require an extension of the operational timeline. Partial certification, covering structural items only, is an option.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6068`

## arkship.1355.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1355.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

维修工蜂已编制了一份最终清单：在最近完成的区段中，有四十七处胞元修复不完整。这些修复工作从承重连接处的关键结构加固，到表面胞元内衬和美容腔体修复，不一而足。\n\n全面完成将延长更新周期。我们也可以考虑只获得部分认证，仅涉及结构修复部分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5088`

### English

Repair drones have compiled a final manifest: forty-seven incomplete cell repairs across the most recently finished sections. They range from critical structural reinforcements at load-bearing junctions to surface-level cell-lining and cosmetic cavity work.\n\nFull completion will extend the renewal cycle. Partial certification, addressing structural repairs, is available.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6069`

## arkship.1360.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1360.name&lang=en)

### 中文

归乡

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5091`

### English

Homecoming

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6073`

## arkship.1360.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1360.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最新翻修部分的流离居民已经收到了他们迁回的日期。那些被封闭了数月的走廊再次开放，散发着新鲜复合材料和新绝缘材料的气味。那些在临时住所待了数月的婴儿们第一次看到了他们的家。\n\n船上的气氛是自翻修开始以来最好的。领导层意识到这种善意不会持久。问题是如何利用它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5092`

### English

The displaced residents of the most recently renovated section have been given their move-back date. The corridors that were sealed for months are open again, smelling of fresh composite and new insulation. Infants who spent months in temporary quarters are seeing their home section for the first time.\n\nThe mood aboard is the best it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that goodwill of this kind does not last. The question is how to make use of it.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6074`

## arkship.1360.desc.machine_ind

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1360.desc.machine_ind&lang=en)

### 中文

密封的走廊再次开放。下层甲板的脚手架正在拆除。对大多数人来说，这是回家。对一些人来说，却是别样的体验。\n\n在迁徙期间新近启动的单元正在进入那些仅存在于其数据库图纸中，但从未出现在其感官日志中的走廊。\n\n自翻新开始以来，热情达到了顶峰。领导层知道这不会持久。问题是如何利用它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5093`

### English

The sealed corridors are open again. Scaffolding comes down in the lower decks. For most, this is a homecoming. For some, it is something else.\n\nUnits that came online during the displacement period are entering corridors that appear in their schematics but have never appeared in their sensory logs.\n\nEnthusiasm is the highest it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that this will not last. The question is how to make use of it.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6075`

## arkship.1360.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1360.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

分配到修复期间临时作业区的单位正在返回其主要处理区域。受影响区域的基线操作参数正在恢复。效率指标呈上升趋势。\n\n飞船范围内已记录到可测量的凝聚力提升。此类提升是暂时的。分析表明有两种可行方法：将提升重定向以加速剩余的修复工作，或允许自然稳定并使凝聚力稳定在更高的基线水平。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5094`

### English

Units assigned to temporary operational zones during remediation are being returned to their primary processing areas. Baseline operational parameters are being restored across affected sectors. Efficiency metrics are trending upward.\n\nA measurable cohesion uplift has been registered across the vessel. Such spikes are transient. Analysis indicates two viable approaches: redirect the uplift toward accelerating remaining remediation work, or permit natural stabilization and allow cohesion to settle at an elevated baseline.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6076`

## arkship.1360.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1360.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

流离失所的工蜂正回流到它们修复好的区域。曾经散发着几个周期建筑材料气味的走廊，现在充满了熟悉的嗅觉标记。结合化学作用趋于稳定。领地紧张感消散。\n\n集体共鸣激增。蜂巢正在恢复原状，这种回归的能量是真实的。它可以被导向外部，进入剩余的建筑区。或者，也可以让它安定下来，给蜂群时间在工作恢复之前完全找回自我。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5095`

### English

The displaced drones are flowing back into their restored sections. Familiar scent-markers saturate corridors that smelled of construction compounds for cycles. Bonding chemistry stabilizes. Territorial tension dissolves.\n\nThe collective resonance has spiked. The hive is returning to itself, and the energy of that return is real. It could be directed outward, into the remaining construction zones. Or it could be allowed to settle, and the colony given time to fully find itself again before the work resumes.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6077`

## arkship.1360.a

## arkship.1365.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1365.name&lang=en)

### 中文

漫长等待

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5098`

### English

The Long Wait

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6081`

## arkship.1365.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1365.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

居民区翻新工程已进入最后阶段，但“最后”这个词的含义已经今非昔比。从市区迁出的居民在临时住所居住的时间已经超出了最初的估计。\n\n现在有要求提供额外资源：更好的临时家具、优先使用娱乐设施，以及少量额外资源分配。这并不能解决任何结构性问题。但它可能会让等待变得更容易忍受。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5099`

### English

The residential district renovation is in its final stage, but 'final' has stopped meaning what it once did. The inhabitants relocated from the city blocks have now been in temporary quarters for longer than the original estimate promised.\n\nA request has come through for supplemental resources: better temporary furnishings, priority access to recreational facilities, and a small additional resource allocation. It will not fix anything structural. But it might make the waiting bearable.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6082`

## arkship.1365.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1365.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

从居民区被迫搬离的人员凝聚力数据正低于可接受的阈值。最终改造阶段已超出其预计持续时间。预测模型显示，如不进行有针对性的资源干预，情况将持续恶化。\n\n补充拨款申请已提交审核。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5100`

### English

Unit cohesion data from displaced residential sector populations is trending below acceptable thresholds. The final renovation phase has exceeded its projected duration. Predictive models indicate continued decline without targeted resource intervention.\n\nA supplemental allocation request has been submitted for review.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6083`

## arkship.1365.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1365.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

最终居住区的信息素压力读数已超过可接受的阈值。上一次翻新阶段已超出其预计周期。长期脱离既定模式会扰乱结合化学并损害集体凝聚力，且随着时间推移情况会恶化。\n\n已请求额外资源分配以缓解拥挤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5101`

### English

Pheromone stress readings from the final residential sections have exceeded acceptable thresholds. The last renovation phase has extended beyond its projected cycle. Prolonged separation from established patterns disrupts bonding chemistry and undermines collective cohesion in ways that worsen with time.\n\nA supplemental resource allocation has been requested to alleviate the crowding.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6084`

## refurbishment_administrative_burden_desc

### 中文

管理长期搬离原住所的居民的福利项目给专业人员带来了巨大的压力。采购物流、投诉处理和分配管理正在分散技术人员的精力，使其无法专注于主要职责。

### English

Unauthorized Modifications

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6090`

## arkship.1370.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1370.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在住宅区中部拆除非承重墙时，装修工人发现了一些异常情况：几十年来未经授权的改动。隐藏的房间、私自搭建的壁龛、被改造成储藏室或居住空间的封闭走廊。这些都不在原始设计图中，而且其中一些还是承重结构。\n\n首席工程师正在请求决策。拆除所有不在原始计划中的部分是正确的做法。这将需要时间。绕过这些改动会更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将很难向未来的工程师解释。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5107`

### English

During demolition of non-load-bearing walls in the mid-residential sections, the renovation crews have discovered something unusual: decades of unauthorized modifications. Hidden rooms, self-constructed alcoves, sealed corridors repurposed as storage or living space. None of it is in the original schematics, and some of it is load-bearing.\n\nThe lead engineer is requesting a decision. Removing everything not in the original plans is the correct approach. It will take time. Working around the modifications is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will be difficult to explain to future engineers.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6091`

## arkship.1370.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1370.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

对住宅部门非结构性元素的拆解过程中，我们发现了大量未经授权的建筑改造。在多个区域发现了未经备案的隔断、通道改动和临时承重装置。这些都没有在原始设计规范中记录。\n\n完全拆除在结构上是正确的，但耗时。文档记录和变通路线可作为替代方案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5108`

### English

Deconstruction of residential sector non-structural elements has revealed extensive unauthorized architectural modifications. Off-record partitioning, access route alterations, and improvised load-bearing installations have been identified across multiple zones. None are documented in original design specifications.\n\nFull removal is structurally correct but time-consuming. Documentation and workaround routing is available as an alternative.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6092`

## arkship.1370.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1370.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

拆除中层居住区的内墙后，我们发现了数代未经授权的殖民地改造。隐蔽的洞穴、自行挖掘的通道、改作巢穴的密封空间，所有这些都完全不在飞船的正式结构中。其中一些是承重结构。正确移除是正确的做法，但耗时。绕开它们更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将给未来的巢穴管理员带来麻烦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5109`

### English

Demolition of interior walls in the mid-residential sections has uncovered generations of unauthorized colony modification. Hidden burrows, self-bored access tunnels, sealed chambers repurposed as nesting alcoves, and each entirely absent from the vessel's formal structure. Some are load-bearing. Proper removal is the correct approach but time-consuming. Working around them is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will trouble future nest-wardens.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6093`

## arkship.1375.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1375.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最后一层甲板已通过初步检查。下方部分的脚手架已开始拆除。从大多数方面来看，翻修工作已完成。\n\n工程主管要求进行全面的二次检查，之后[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]才会签署结构认证。他们承认，这在很大程度上只是一种形式。甲板几乎肯定没有问题。\n\n然而，“几乎”这个词往往会带来后果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5116`

### English

The last deck has passed its preliminary inspection. The scaffolding has already started coming down in the lower sections. By most measures, the renovation is complete.\n\nThe engineering supervisor has requested a full secondary inspection before [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] signs off on structural certification. It is, they acknowledge, largely a formality. The deck is almost certainly fine.\n\nHowever, 'almost' is a word that often bears consequences.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6101`

## arkship.1375.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1375.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

最终的住宅区已通过初步检查协议。低层区域的脚手架拆除工作已经开始。结构认证正等待完整的二次诊断协议。\n\n二次检查几乎是肯定是不会有问题的，但获得完全认证的是全面完工的正式先决条件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5117`

### English

The final residential sector has passed preliminary inspection protocols. Scaffolding removal has commenced in lower zones. Structural certification is pending full secondary diagnostic protocols.\n\nThe secondary inspection is a near certainty, but completion remains a formal prerequisite for full certification.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6102`

## arkship.1375.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1375.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

最终的巢穴甲板已通过初步检查。工蜂正在拆除低层的脚手架。从所有可观察到的迹象来看，翻修已完成。在最终认证前，还需要进行全面的二次验证循环。\n\n我们几乎可以肯定——但并非完全肯定——二次验证和初次检查的结果将保持一致。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5118`

### English

The final nesting deck has cleared its preliminary inspection. Drones are dismantling the scaffolding in the lower levels. By every observable measure, the renewal is complete. A full secondary verification cycle is necessary before final certification.\n\nWe are almost, but not entirely, certain it will confirm what the primary inspection found.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6103`

### English

## arkship.1380.desc.full

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.full&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的最后一个区段已完成清理、认证，并已归还给居民。虽然最初出于必要性我们对部分区域实行了破坏工程，但最终我们的工程铸就了一项伟大的成就。飞船给人的感觉焕然一新：不仅结构坚固，而且在某种程度上更像是它本应成为的飞船。\n\n工程兵团已提交最终报告，并附有几项强烈建议。如何利用这项工作的成果，将由领导层决定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5124`

### English

The last section of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been cleared, certified, and returned to its inhabitants. What began as a disruptive necessity has concluded as something approaching an achievement. The ship feels different: not just structurally sound, but somehow more like the vessel it was always supposed to be.\n\nThe engineering corps has submitted its final report with several strong recommendations. The choice of where to direct the fruits of this work belongs to leadership.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6110`

## arkship.1380.desc.partial

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.partial&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的检修已宣布完成。结构完整性评估证实，与基准相比，性能有了显著改善，尽管熟悉最初提案的人会注意到并非所有需求规格都已达成，也并非所有公差都已优化。\n\n项目取得了成果。但本可以做得更好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5125`

### English

The overhaul of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been declared complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm a meaningful improvement over baseline, though those familiar with the original proposal will note that not every specification was met, and not every tolerance was optimal.\n\nThe project delivered results. The results could have been better.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6111`

## arkship.1380.desc.rushed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.rushed&lang=en)

### 中文

方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的检修已完成。文件已签署，脚手架已拆除，施工组成员也已离开。\n\n结构审查委员会以某种外交辞令指出，最终产品在所有评估类别中都达到了最低认证标准。这艘船比以前更好了。至于它是否达到了最佳状态，工程兵团选择了不公开质疑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5126`

### English

The overhaul of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! is done. The paperwork is signed, the scaffolding is down, and the crews have moved on.\n\nThe structural review board has noted, with some diplomatic restraint, that the final product meets minimum certification standards across all assessed categories. The ship is better than it was. Whether it is as good as it could have been is a question the engineering corps has chosen not to ask aloud.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6112`

## arkship.1380.desc.full.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.full.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Target.GetName]§!的修复工作已完成。所有区域均已通过认证并恢复全面运行状态。结构完整性评估证实，在所有测量类别中，输出均超过修复前的基线。\n\n最终报告已记录。优化建议可供实施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5127`

### English

Remediation of §Y[Target.GetName]§! is complete. All sectors have been certified and returned to full operational status. Structural integrity assessments confirm outputs exceeding pre-remediation baselines across every measured category.\n\nFinal reporting has been logged. Optimization recommendations are available for implementation.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6113`

## arkship.1380.desc.partial.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.partial.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Target.GetName]§!的修复已确认完成。结构完整性评估证实，修复后情况较修复前基线有所改善。然而，有几个参数是在最低阈值而非建议规范下最终确定的。\n\n结果在可接受范围内。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5128`

### English

Remediation of §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been certified as complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm improvement over pre-remediation baselines. However, several parameters were finalized at minimum threshold rather than recommended specification.\n\nOutcomes are within acceptable range.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6114`

## arkship.1380.desc.rushed.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.rushed.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Target.GetName]§!的修复已记录为最终完成。结构审查子程序已认证该结果符合所有评估类别的最低标准。\n\n相对于基线的运行改进已确认。优化潜力未完全实现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5129`

### English

Remediation of §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been logged as finalized. The structural review subroutine has certified the outcome as meeting minimum standards across all assessed categories.\n\nOperational improvement over baseline is confirmed. Optimization potential was not fully realized.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6115`

## arkship.1380.desc.full.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.full.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Target.GetName]§!的翻新已完成。每个部分都经过验证、重建，并已归还给殖民地。集体以新的连贯性共鸣着，熟悉的重量如同一个再次完整的容器，从最深处的能源节点到最高的筑巢室都结构完好。\n\n我们完整了。殖民地选择将其新生的力量导向何处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5130`

### English

The renewal of §Y[Target.GetName]§! is complete. Every section has been verified, rebuilt, and returned to the colony. The collective resonates with new coherence, the familiar weight of a vessel that is once again fully itself, structurally sound from the deepest power-nodes to the highest nesting chambers.\n\nWe are whole. The colony chooses where its renewed strength is directed.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6116`

## arkship.1380.desc.partial.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.partial.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Target.GetName]§!的续建已宣布完成。结构评估证实，相较于该船之前的状态，它确实得到了改善。我们不安地意识到，并非所有规范都得到了满足，也并非所有结构裕度都得到了充分优化。\n\n殖民地变得更强大了。尽管它本可以更强大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5131`

### English

The renewal of §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been declared complete. Structural assessments confirm real improvement over the vessel's prior state. We are uncomfortably aware that not every specification was met and not every structural margin was fully optimized.\n\nThe colony is stronger. It could have been stronger still.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6117`

## arkship.1380.desc.rushed.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1380.desc.rushed.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[Target.GetName]§!的翻新已经完成。脚手架已拆除，区域已开放，被转移的工蜂已返回指定位置。我们不安地意识到，我们在所有评估类别中仅达到了最低认证标准。\n\n翻新达到了其目的。至于它是否发挥了其潜力，我们选择不去深究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5132`

### English

Whether it achieved its potential is something we choose not to dwell on.

## arkship.1385.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1385.name&lang=en)

### 中文

舱体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5192`

### English

The Pod

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6207`

## arkship.1385.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1385.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的远程扫描仪发现了一个在系统边缘漂浮的物体。进一步检查发现其外表下存在精确的几何不一致，以及厚厚岩石外壳下埋藏的休眠能量信号。\n\n这是一个来源不明的救生舱，其外部经过伪装，以躲避广阔太空中的探测。未检测到任何主动传输，但舱内仍存在微弱的生命维持痕迹。无论里面是什么，都已经漂浮了很长时间。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5193`

### English

Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.\n\nA survival pod of unknown origin, its exterior was camouflaged to evade detection across vast stretches of space. No active transmissions were detected, but faint life-support traces persisted within. Whatever lay inside had been adrift for a very long time.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6208`

## arkship.1385.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1385.a&lang=en)

### 中文

让我们看看里面有什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5194`

### English

Let's see what's inside.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6209`

## arkship.1385.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1385.b&lang=en)

### 中文

就把这石头当石头看吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5195`

### English

Let the rock be a rock.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6210`

## arkship.1390.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1390.name&lang=en)

### 中文

吾之挚爱

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5196`

### English

Dearly Beloved

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6212`

## arkship.1390.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1390.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

矿物外壳之下，我们发现了一个严重受损的休眠舱。舱内有一名乘员，早已死亡。此人的身体披着华丽的仪式长袍，不适合太空旅行。看来此人是被仓促地强行塞进去的。\n\n休眠舱内部有明显的暴力痕迹。几处内部束缚装置曾被强行使用。这个容器并非避难所，而是一个囚牢。只找到了两件物品：一组坐标和一封密封的信件。上面刻着简单的铭文：\n\n§H“致吾爱。”§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5197`

### English

Beneath the mineral shell, we uncovered a badly damaged stasis pod. Inside we discovered a single occupant, already deceased. Their body was draped in flowing ceremonial vestments, not suited for spacefaring. It appears they were forced inside in haste.\n\nThe pod's interior bore unmistakable signs of violence. Several internal restraints had been forcibly engaged. This vessel was no sanctuary; it was a prison. Only two artifacts could be recovered: a set of coordinates, and a sealed message. It bore a simple inscription: \n\n§H"For my Beloved."§!

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6213`

## arkship.1390.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1390.a&lang=en)

设置前往该坐标的航线。

### English

Set course for the coordinates.

我们不应该在这上面浪费时间。

### English

We should not waste our time on this.

## arkship.1395.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1395.name&lang=en)

### 中文

最后幸存者

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5200`

### English

Last Survivor

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6217`

## arkship.1395.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1395.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终于抵达了由恢复的坐标所指向的休眠舱。在里面，我们发现了另一个生物，它还奄奄一息。\n\n身体损伤非常严重。长期的休眠失败让[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]濒临死亡。两个休眠舱显然很久以前就已分离，从未抵达目的地。\n\n我们已经稳定住了这个外星人，它要求我们称呼[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]为[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]。完全康复仍遥遥无期。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5201`

### English

We have finally arrived at the capsule indicated by the recovered coordinates. Within, we discovered another being, this one still barely alive.\n\nThe physical damage is severe. Prolonged stasis failure has left [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] on the verge of death. The two pods had clearly been separated long ago, their destination never reached.\n\nWe have stabilized the alien, who has asked us to call [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]. Full recovery remains far from certain.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6218`

## arkship.1395.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1395.a&lang=en)

### 中文

确保[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe]能够康复。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5202`

### English

Ensure [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe] recovers.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6219`

## arkship.1400.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1400.name&lang=en)

### 中文

大屠杀

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5203`

### English

The Massacre

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6221`

## arkship.1400.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1400.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词是在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录的：\n\n§H“发生了一场大屠杀。整个家庭被抹去。根据官方通告，那是一个敌对帝国的袭击。但那是一个谎言。当权者自己策划了这一切，一个捏造的暴行，只为了一场毫无意义的战争辩护。我的爱人和我找到了证据。内部指令。未篡改的日志。\n\n“我们发布了它。我们预料到了后果。我们没有预料到的是流放。”§!\n\n休眠舱数据库虽然有所损坏，但该记录可恢复。这份记录现在掌握在我们手中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5204`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"There was a massacre. Whole families, erased. It was presented as an attack by a rival empire. But that was a lie. Those in power had orchestrated it themselves, a fabricated atrocity to justify a senseless war. My beloved and I found the proof. Internal directives. Unaltered logs.\n\n"We released it. We expected consequences. What we did not expect was exile."§!\n\nCorrupted but recoverable records from the pod's data banks are already in our possession.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6222`

## arkship.1400.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1400.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们找到了你爱人的留言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5205`

### English

We found a message from your beloved.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6223`

## arkship.1405.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1405.name&lang=en)

### 中文

血腥的战争

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5206`

### English

A Bloody War

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6225`

## arkship.1405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：\n\n§H“舰队已然逼近，我们早在他们抵达之前就看到了。自我们拒绝[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]的臣服要求以来，他们已经对我们发动了多年的战争。我们的军队实力悬殊，根本无法匹敌。\n\n“最终，我的父母将他们的希望寄托在这些休眠舱上。他们把我和我所爱的人强行送入虚空，我们的生存渺茫，我们的重逢只能听天由命，只希望能重新开始。”§!\n\n对休眠舱系统进行调查后，我们发现了许多战时工程数据。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5207`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"The fleets were already on approach, we saw them long before they reached us. [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] had waged war against us for years, ever since we refused their demands for vassalage. Our forces were hopelessly outmatched.\n\n"In the end, my parents placed their faith in these capsules. They forced my beloved and me into the void, our survival uncertain, our reunion left to chance with only the hope that we might begin anew."§!\n\nA survey of the pod's systems has turned up engineering data from the war period.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6226`

## arkship.1410.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1410.name&lang=en)

### 中文

危险的发现

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5209`

### English

A Dangerous Find

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6229`

## arkship.1410.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1410.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了其陈述：\n\n§H“我们的帝国曾以尊重生命和死亡为荣。我们的宗旨是延长生命，并减轻生死之间的过渡，但绝不是完全超越它。通过机械飞升实现永生，是对我们信仰的亵渎。这种知识本不该被掌握。但好奇心在民众中蔓延开来。当它无法再被遏制时，统治当局认为风险不可接受。\n\n“他们选择了抹除。我们的帝国被摧毁以埋葬真相。只有我和我的爱人幸免于难，被迫进入这些休眠舱，注定在生与死之间漂泊。”§!\n\n休眠舱的数据核心也已解密。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5210`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"Our empire once took great pride in honoring both life and death. Our purpose was to prolong existence and ease the passage between them, but never to transcend it entirely. Immortality, through synthetic ascension, was an abomination to our beliefs. Such knowledge was never meant to be possessed. But curiosity spread among the population. When it could no longer be contained, the ruling authority deemed the risk unacceptable.\n\n"They chose erasure. Our empire was destroyed to bury the truth. Only my beloved and I were spared, forced into these pods, condemned to drift between life and death."§!\n\nThe pod's data core has also been decrypted.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6230`

## arkship.1415.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1415.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录下了这份自述：\n\n§H“我有个同事。一个朋友，至少我是这么认为的。我们一起工作了好几年。当我被任命领导这个项目时，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe]向我表示了祝贺。\n\n“一个月后，我和我的爱人被捕了。莫须有的罪名。没有审判。我还没来得及问为什么，我们就被关进了休眠舱。我现在明白了，野心不需要理由。它只需要一个机会。”§!\n\n来自休眠舱内部系统的个人日志为我们提供了帝国治理的详细记录。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5213`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"I had a colleague. A friend, or so I believed. We had worked together for years. When I was appointed to lead the project, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe] offered congratulations.\n\n"A month later, my beloved and I were seized. Fabricated charges. No trial. We were put into the pods before I had finished asking why. I know now that ambition does not need a reason. It only needs an opportunity."§!\n\nPersonal logs from the pod's internal systems have given us a detailed record of the empire's governance.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6234`

## arkship.1420.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1420.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的陈述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：\n\n§H“一种无情的病毒席卷了我们的帝国。我们的人民迅速而无情地死去。据信它起源于我们庞大的垃圾填埋场之一，这是我们自身过度和粗心大意的后果。我所爱的人和我在末日来临之前选择与我们的人民站在一起。\n\n“但我的父母介入了。违背我们的意愿，我们被迫进入这些休眠仓，被抛弃。这项技术本应保存我们。看来它失败了。”§!\n\n已回收休眠仓生命维持系统中的生物残留物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5216`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"A relentless virus swept through our empire. Our people perished swiftly and without mercy. It is believed to have originated from one of our vast landfill complexes, a consequence of our own excess and carelessness. My beloved and I chose to remain to stand with our people until the end.\n\n"But my parents intervened. Against our will, we were forced into these pods and cast away. The technology was meant to preserve us. It seems it failed."§!\n\nBiological residue from the pod's life support systems has been recovered.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6238`

The Hidden Deal

## arkship.1425.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1425.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在康复期间完整记录了[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的叙述：\n\n§H“我的父母知道[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]即将苏醒。为了获得它的青睐，他们不惜一切代价达成了一项交易。我们四分之一的人口被献祭，以换取力量。我和我的爱人发现了他们的阴谋。\n\n“但很少有人听信，而那些听信的人则被灭口。我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入虚空，如同之前许多人一样，被抛弃了。”§!\n\n休眠舱密封舱室中的文件已被发现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5219`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"My parents knew that [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] was on the verge of awakening. Desperate to secure its favor, they struck a bargain. A quarter of our population was offered in exchange for power. My beloved and I uncovered their design.\n\n"But few listened, and those who did were silenced. We were forced into these pods and cast into the void, discarded, as so many others had been before us."§!\n\nDocumentation from the pod's sealed compartments has been uncovered.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6242`

### 中文

禁忌的结合

### English

Forbidden Union

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6245`

## arkship.1430.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1430.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了他的陈述：\n\n§H“我并非因我所做之事而被流放。我是因我所爱之人而被流放。\n\n“我们的人民正在交战。我们已交战了数代。在我们人民眼中，我们的结合是一种无法被忽视的逾矩。我们拒绝分开，相信我们的结合或许能展示和平的价值。\n\n“我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入无尽的虚空。但我们的爱无法被割裂。”§!\n\n在该休眠舱中发现了两位流亡者之间的私人通信。阅读它们令人深受鼓舞。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5222`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"I was not exiled for what I had done. I was exiled for who I loved.\n\n"Our people were at war. We had been, for generations. In the eyes of our people, our bond was a transgression, one that could not be ignored. We refused to part, believing that our bond might demonstrate the value of peace.\n\n"We were forced into these pods and cast into the relentless void. But our love could not be sundered."§!\n\nPrivate correspondence between the two exiles was found in the pod. Reading it was inspiring.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6246`

虚空中的低语

Whispers in the Void

## arkship.1435.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1435.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的自述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：\n\n§H“它最初只是思绪边缘的一个存在。后来我听到了声音。低语声一直跟着我，随着时间的推移变得越来越清晰，说的是一些零碎的词句。我的人民害怕我变成了什么样子，但我的爱人一直在我身边。\n\n“我们一起被迫进入这个逃生舱，被抛入虚空，在任何可能触及我心智的东西扩散之前就被移走了。即使现在，我仍然能听到它。低语着。”§!\n\n逃生舱的传感器日志揭示了大量有趣的数据。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5225`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:\n\n§H"It began as a presence at the edge of thought. Then I heard the voice. The whispers followed me, growing clearer with time, speaking in fragments. My people feared what I had become, but my beloved stayed by my side.\n\n"Together, we were forced into this pod and cast into the void, removed before whatever had touched my mind could spread. Even now, I still hear it. Whispering."§!\n\nThe pod's sensor logs have revealed an intriguing amount of data.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6250`

### 中文

最后的遗言

### English

Final Words

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6253`

## arkship.1440.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarkship.1440.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的状况迅速恶化。就在其临终前不久，我们解密了伴侣舱发出的加密信息。信息内容如下：\n\n§H“我的挚爱，\n\n如果你听到这段话，那么命运对你比对我更仁慈。请知道，即使在虚空中，我也从未孤单，我始终与你同在。”§!\n\n信息结束后不久，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的生命体征停止了。自从苏醒以来，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的表情第一次如此平静。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5228`

### English

[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s condition deteriorated rapidly. Shortly before their passing, we decrypted the sealed message from the companion pod. The transmission reads:\n\n§H"My dearest,\n\n"If you hear this, then fate has been kinder to you than it was to me. Know that, even in the void, I was never alone, I carried you with me, always."§!\n\nMoments after the message concluded, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s vital signs ceased. For the first time since awakening, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] expression was at peace.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6254`

## ap_eternal_vigilance_nomads_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aap_eternal_vigilance_nomads_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

示弱招致攻击。与我们的方舟舰对峙的代价必须高昂，以至于几乎没人愿意承受这份代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5247`

### English

To display weakness is to invite attack. The price of facing our arkships must be so high that as few as possible are prepared to meet it.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6281`

## civic_machine_servitor_forever_cruise_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_machine_servitor_forever_cruise_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

诞生于一个崇尚奢华的时代，这台机械智能曾是豪华星际游轮上殷勤周到的主人。它的航程早已超越了最初乘客的生命，却依然宠溺着每一代新人，仿佛这场巡游才刚刚开始。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nomads_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5265`

### English

Conceived in an era when excess was a virtue, the Machine Intelligence served as the ever-attentive host of a lavish interstellar cruise liner. Its voyage has long outlasted its original guests, yet it continues to pamper each new generation as if the cruise had only just begun.

Source: `localisation/english/nomads_1_l_english.yml:6300`
